### [1] [A Cone-Constrained Bilinear Decomposition for Total Scaled-Gradient Variation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00036)
*Haibin Su,Chunlin Wu,Huibin Chang,Zhifang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于双线性分解的策略来求解总量尺度梯度变差（TSGV）正则化器驱动的图像恢复问题，通过将非线性加权梯度解耦为锥约束或球约束的等价优化问题，并采用交替最小化方法（AMM）结合MM策略求解，在KKL框架下建立了全局收敛性保证，实验证明在高噪声水平下PSNR和SSIM优于或媲美代表性变分方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TSGV正则化器虽能有效保持图像中的边缘和角点，但其高度非凸非线性的特性带来严重的计算挑战：现有方法要么对参数敏感，要么缺乏收敛保证。因此需要设计一种既能保持TSGV优越的边缘/角点保持能力，又具备收敛保证和稳定性的求解算法。

Method: 提出一种定制的双线性分解，将TSGV正则化器中的非线性加权梯度解耦，根据缩放函数的选择将原问题转化为由锥约束或球约束支配的等价优化问题。其中锥约束在刻画边缘和角点保持行为中发挥核心作用。采用配备MM（majorization-minimization）策略的交替最小化方法（AMM）求解该重构问题，无需步长调节即可保证能量单调递减。同时通过分析约束在图像奇点附近的渐近行为，对边缘保持特性给出了几何解释，并在Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz（KL）框架内建立了到临界点的全局收敛性。

Result: 在高斯去噪和非视域（NLOS）成像上的大量数值实验表明，所提方法在PSNR和SSIM指标上与代表性变分方法竞争或优于它们，尤其在高噪声水平下表现突出；同时在密集和稀疏扫描下均改善了结构重建质量。

Conclusion: 该工作不仅从理论上保证了TSGV优化问题的全局收敛性，还通过几何解释深化了对边缘保持机制的理解，为处理高度非凸非线性的图像恢复问题提供了一种计算可行且具备理论保障的新框架。

Abstract: The total scaled-gradient variation (TSGV) regularizer, derived from sparse modeling of piecewise-linear structures, has been shown to preserve edges and corners in image restoration. However, its highly nonconvex and nonlinear nature poses severe computational challenges, as existing methods often suffer from parameter sensitivity or lack convergence guarantees. To overcome this, we propose a tailored bilinear decomposition that decouples the nonlinear weighted gradient in the TSGV regularizer. This approach yields an equivalent optimization problem governed by cone or sphere constraints, depending on the chosen scaling function. In particular, the cone constraint plays a central role in characterizing edge- and corner-preserving behavior. We solve this reformulation using the alternating minimization method (AMM) equipped with a majorization--minimization strategy, ensuring a monotonic decrease in energy without step-size tuning. Furthermore, we provide a geometric interpretation of the edge-preserving properties of these constraints by analyzing their asymptotic behavior near image singularities. We establish the global convergence of the proposed method to a critical point within the Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz framework. Extensive numerical experiments on Gaussian denoising and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging show that the proposed method achieves PSNR and SSIM competitive with or superior to representative variational methods, especially at high noise levels, and improves the structural reconstruction under dense and sparse scanning.

</details>


### [2] [Qwen-Drive-1.0: An Initial Step towards a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00111)
*Xin Zhou,Zongchuang Zhao,Zhibo Yang,Mingsheng Li,Humen Zhong,Shuai Bai,Du Chu,Ruizhe Chen,Zhaohai Li,Jun Tang,Qiuyue Wang,Mingkun Yang,Jiazhao Zhang,Dayiheng Liu,Dingkang Liang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Qwen-Drive-1.0是一个面向自动驾驶的视觉语言基础模型，在保留预训练VLM架构的基础上，通过外部鸟瞰图(BEV)感知头实现3D目标检测、语义占据预测和BEV地图分割，并通过计划专家(Planning Expert)生成未来自车轨迹。采用分阶段训练策略结合驾驶监督与通用视觉语言数据，在保持通用能力的同时实现强3D感知和竞争力的运动规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶需要统一的视觉语言基础模型来同时处理3D感知、视觉问答和运动规划，但现有模型往往偏重单一任务，难以在统一框架下兼顾驾驶专有能力与通用视觉语言能力。本文旨在构建一个集成的VLM基础模型，在统一架构下实现多模态驾驶能力。

Method: (1) 保留预训练VLM架构，在其上集成3D感知、VQA和运动规划；(2) 外部BEV感知头联合执行3D目标检测、语义占据预测和BEV地图分割，作为共享表征中3D信息的探针并提供可检查的显式接口；(3) Planning Expert基于共享VLM表征生成未来自车轨迹；(4) 分阶段训练策略：结合驾驶监督数据与通用视觉语言数据，既获取驾驶专有能力又保留广泛的视觉理解与指令跟随能力。

Result: 实验表明模型在3D感知和驾驶场景理解上表现强劲，同时大幅保留了通用视觉语言能力；在开环、伪闭环和闭环等多种评测设定下均展现出极具竞争力的运动规划性能。

Conclusion: Qwen-Drive-1.0验证了在统一VLM框架下同时实现强3D感知、驾驶场景理解与通用多模态能力是可行的，为自动驾驶视觉语言基础模型的后续发展奠定了初步基础。

Abstract: We present Qwen-Drive-1.0, an initial step towards a vision-language foundation model for autonomous driving. Qwen-Drive-1.0 retains the architecture of the pretrained vision-language model (VLM) and integrates 3D perception, visual question answering, and motion planning within a unified framework. An external bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception head jointly performs 3D object detection, semantic occupancy prediction, and BEV map segmentation. It serves as a probe of the 3D information accessible from the shared representations and provides an explicit, inspectable interface to 3D scene structure. A Planning Expert conditions on shared VLM representations to generate future ego trajectories. A staged training recipe combines driving supervision with general-purpose vision-language data to acquire driving-specific competence while helping preserve broad visual understanding and instruction-following capabilities. Experiments demonstrate strong 3D perception and driving scene understanding while largely preserving general vision-language capability. Comprehensive evaluations across open-loop, pseudo-closed-loop, and closed-loop settings further show highly competitive motion-planning performance.

</details>


### [3] [ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00188)
*Xionghao Wu,Yijun Yang,Shiyang Zhou,Haoze Sun,Jianhui Liu,Songsong Yu,Jiyao Zhang,Wenbo Li,Bo Wang,Guoqing Ma,Lin Song,Renjie Liao,Shenghe Zheng,Wei Tang,Xiaojuan Qi,Yanwei Li,Yuan Zhang,Zhuotao Tian,Haoyang Huang,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZimaBlue是一个从大规模人类与机器人第一视角视频中学习通用世界动作模型（WAMs）的可扩展框架，采用三阶段训练课程（因果具身视频预训练、视频-动作中间训练、目标机器人微调）并引入异步Slow-Fast双系统架构，在实现30Hz实时控制的同时，将真实机器人零样本成功率从36.1%提升至77.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作面临根本性的扩展挑战：鲁棒泛化需要广泛的身体经验，但带有动作标签的机器人轨迹数据采集成本高昂且多样性天然受限。第一视角视频提供了更具可扩展性的具身体验来源，但如何将这种丰富但缺少动作标签的经验转化为有效的机器人控制是核心难题。

Method: ZimaBlue采用三阶段训练课程：(1) 在大规模人类和机器人第一视角视频上进行因果具身视频预训练；(2) 通过统一的动作表示，在异构机器人轨迹上进行视频-动作中间训练，将学习到的视觉动力学与真实机器人动作对齐；(3) 针对目标机器人进行部署前的微调特化。此外，采用异步Slow-Fast双系统架构：高容量Slow世界模型提供通用时空表示，轻量级Fast分支实现30Hz动作预测。

Result: 在真实机器人零样本评估中，训练数据从仅目标机器人数据扩展到超过120,000小时的具身视频后，成功率从36.1%提升至77.8%。在多个基准测试上表现优异，尤其在未见任务上展现出显著增益。

Conclusion: ZimaBlue验证了大规模无动作标签的具身视频可以作为机器人操作泛化能力的有效扩展来源，且通过异步双系统架构能够在保持实时控制能力的同时充分利用高容量的世界模型，为机器人操纵学习提供了一条可扩展的实用路径。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation faces a fundamental scaling challenge: robust generalization demands broad physical experience, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are expensive to collect and inherently limited in diversity. Egocentric videos offer a far more scalable source of embodied experience, capturing object interactions, contact dynamics, tool use, and long-horizon behaviors across diverse environments. The central challenge is how to convert this abundant but action-free experience into effective robot control. We introduce ZimaBlue, a scalable framework for learning generalizable World Action Models (WAMs) from large-scale video. ZimaBlue follows a three-stage training curriculum: it first performs causal embodied video pre-training on large-scale human and robot egocentric videos, then grounds the learned visual dynamics in heterogeneous robot trajectories through video-action mid-training with a unified action representation, and finally specializes the model to a target robot for deployment. To make generative WAMs practical for real-time control, ZimaBluefurther adopts an asynchronous Slow-Fast dual-system architecture, where a high-capacity Slow world model provides generalizable spatiotemporal representations and a lightweight Fast branch enables 30 Hz action prediction on NVIDIA RTX 4090. On real-robot zero-shot evaluations, scaling from target-robot data alone to over 120,000 hours of embodied video improves success from 36.1% to 77.8%. ZimaBlue further delivers strong performance across multiple benchmarks, with particularly pronounced gains on unseen tasks.

</details>


### [4] [A Lagrangian View of Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00198)
*Peyman Milanfar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自下而上的拉格朗日（粒子中心）力学推导方法，替代了Flow Matching等显式时间生成模型常用的自上而下欧拉（最优输运）推导框架。通过分析连续去噪器的局部泰勒展开，推导出最优单步生成所需的目标身份守恒不变性条件，进而得到准线性对流偏微分方程。利用特征线法解析求解该PDE，可得到与Flow Matching一致的直线轨迹。该几何视角将去噪器的雅可比矩阵视为轨迹曲率的主要来源，从数学上解释了直线流为何支持大步长采样，以及经验模型为何需要蒸馏来展平相交特征线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的显式时间生成模型（如Flow Matching和Rectified Flow）通常采用自上而下的欧拉视角，通过最优输运和连续性方程推导，关注概率质量的宏观输运。本文旨在提供一种替代性的自下而上力学推导，从拉格朗日（粒子中心）视角出发，解释直线轨迹为何能实现单步生成以及曲率产生的根本原因。

Method: 作者以连续去噪器为出发点，通过局部泰勒展开分析其行为，提出目标身份守恒这一严格不变性条件作为最优单步生成的必要条件。在此条件下推导出控制方程——一个准线性对流偏微分方程。随后利用特征线法对该PDE进行解析求解，得到与Flow Matching一致的直线轨迹。该框架将轨迹曲率归因于去噪器的雅可比矩阵。

Result: 解析求解表明，所推导的PDE的特征线即为Flow Matching中的直线轨迹，验证了两种推导路径的等价性。同时，理论分析表明去噪器雅可比矩阵是轨迹弯曲的直接来源，这从数学上解释了直线流之所以允许极大步长，以及经验模型需要蒸馏来消除特征线交汇的原因。

Conclusion: 本文建立了显式生成模型的拉格朗日力学基础，将Flow Matching的直线轨迹解释为守恒律方程的解析解。该几何框架为理解生成模型轨迹的曲率来源提供了新的数学工具，并阐明了蒸馏在展平特征线、实现快速采样中的核心作用。

Abstract: Modern explicit-time generative models, such as Flow Matching [Lipman et al., 2023] and Rectified Flow [Liu et al., 2023], are typically derived top-down via Optimal Transport and the continuity equation. This standard Eulerian approach focuses on the macroscopic transport of probability mass. In this paper, we present an alternative, bottom-up mechanical derivation grounded in a Lagrangian (particle-centric) perspective. By analyzing the local Taylor expansion of a continuous denoiser, we motivate a strict invariance condition required for optimal, singlestep generation: the conservation of target identity. Enforcing this condition yields a governing quasi-linear advection Partial Differential Equation (PDE). We demonstrate that solving this PDE via the Method of Characteristics analytically yields the straight-line trajectories of Flow Matching. This geometric perspective isolates the Jacobian of the denoiser as the primary source of trajectory curvature, providing a direct mathematical explanation for why straight-line flows enable massive step sizes, and why empirical models require distillation to flatten intersecting characteristics.

</details>


### [5] [Distributed Implicit Harm: A Compositional Safety Blind Spot in MLLM-Based Video Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00206)
*Ruotong Wang,Zihao Zhu,Siwei Lyu,Xin Tao,Baoyuan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了"分布式隐含伤害"(DIH)的概念，指视频中由看似无害的组件组合而成、需整体解读才能感知的有害含义。作者开发了一个多智能体合成框架生成超过9000个DIH视频（覆盖时序分布和跨模态分布两类），并对30多个MLLM进行基准测试，发现包括前沿模型在内均存在严重的检测缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视频审核中存在"组合性安全盲区"：由良性组件构成的视频在整体解读时可传达有害含义。此类视频缺乏组合性危害标注、无法通过局部视觉线索/关键词/单模态信号检索，且现有安全数据集中缺失此类样本，亟需系统性的数据构建和模型能力评估。

Method: 作者首先定义DIH两种代表性类型：时序维度分布危害(DIH-T)和音视频跨模态分布危害(DIH-M)。然后开发多智能体合成框架，将个体无害组件组合成有害场景，生成带显式推理标注且多样化的DIH视频数据集（9000+视频，涵盖纯视觉和音视频设置）。最后在30多个MLLM上进行基准测试，并额外收集真实社交媒体DIH视频进行验证。

Result: 超过30个MLLM（包括前沿专有模型和领先开源系统）在检测DIH-T和DIH-M时均表现出显著且一致的缺陷。最强前沿模型也常失败：它们能正确评估单个组件，但无法识别由组件组合涌现的有害含义。在真实社交媒体DIH视频上的评估也观察到同样的失败模式。

Conclusion: DIH是视频审核中一个实际存在且尚未充分探索的挑战。现有MLLM普遍缺乏对组合性危害的推理能力，亟需进一步的研究来提升模型在分布式隐含危害检测上的表现。

Abstract: Despite their growing use in video moderation, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit a compositional safety blind spot: videos composed of seemingly benign components can convey harmful meaning when interpreted as a whole. We refer to this phenomenon as Distributed Implicit Harm (DIH), where harm arises from relations among components distributed along a decomposition axis of the video, rather than from any single explicit cue. Among many possible axes, we study two representative cases: temporally distributed harm across visual segments (DIH-T) and cross-modal harm between audio and visual streams (DIH-M). Studying and mitigating DIH at scale requires data that is difficult to collect: such videos lack compositional harm annotations, evade retrieval based on local visual cues, keywords, or single-modality signals, and are consequently absent from existing safety datasets. To bridge this gap, we develop a multi-agent synthesis framework that composes individually benign components into harmful scenarios and generates diverse DIH videos with explicit reasoning annotations, yielding a dataset of over 9,000 videos spanning visual-only and audio-visual settings. Benchmarking over 30 MLLMs spanning frontier proprietary models and leading open-source systems reveals substantial and consistent deficits in detecting both DIH-T and DIH-M. Notably, this failure persists even among the strongest frontier models: they often correctly assess individual components in isolation but fail to recognize the harmful meaning that emerges from their composition. We further evaluate these models on a manually collected set of real-world DIH videos from social media and observe the same failure mode, highlighting DIH as a practical and underexplored challenge for video moderation.

</details>


### [6] [Beyond Language Priors: Diagnosing and Fixing Visual-Origin Hallucinations in Multimodal LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00231)
*Peiyang Xu,Xiaopei Zhu,Jun Zhu,Xiaolin Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过定量分析揭示了多模态大语言模型(MLLM)中物体幻觉的另一成因——视觉起源幻觉，并提出对抗性对比微调(ACFT)方法，通过最小对抗扰动构建正负样本对进行对比学习，仅用COCO数据集0.9%的数据即实现多项基准的SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将MLLM中的物体幻觉主要归因于语言先验（如文本共现统计的过度依赖），但作者认为存在被忽视的补充性成因：视觉起源幻觉，即幻觉源于错误的视觉特征提取以及图像与文本嵌入之间的错位对齐，因此需要量化验证并提供针对性解决方案。

Method: 1) 通过余弦相似度分析和Smooth Grad-CAM熵测量进行诊断，发现幻觉样本表现出更低的图像-文本相似度(0.158 vs -0.122)和反转的注意力模式；2) 提出对抗性幻觉属性翻转(AHAF)过程，施加最小、针对性的对抗扰动来翻转图像的幻觉属性，从而构建完美对齐的正负样本对；3) 提出ACFT方法，利用AHAF构造的样本对进行对比性微调；AHAF同时作为诊断探针，揭示MLLM视觉表示紧邻幻觉决策边界。

Result: ACFT仅需COCO数据集0.9%的数据、零推理开销，在POPE、MME及四个描述级幻觉基准上，跨LLaVA、MiniGPT-4和Qwen2.5-VL三种架构均取得SOTA性能。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 视觉起源幻觉是MLLM物体幻觉的重要补充成因，视觉表示紧邻幻觉决策边界使模型极易被对抗扰动引入幻觉；ACFT通过对抗性对比微调高效地校准视觉与文本嵌入，以极小数据量与零额外推理成本实现鲁棒的幻觉抑制。

Abstract: Existing research on object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) predominantly attributes the problem to language priors such as over-reliance on textual co-occurrence statistics. We challenge this view by presenting quantitative evidence for a complementary, under-explored cause: visual-origin hallucination, where hallucinations arise from incorrect visual feature extraction and misalignment between image and text embeddings. Through cosine similarity analysis and Smooth Grad-CAM entropy measurements, we show that hallucinated samples exhibit systematically lower image-text similarity (average 0.158 vs. -0.122) and inverted attention patterns, where attention is dispersed when the target object is present but wrongly concentrated when it is absent. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose Adversarial Contrastive Fine-Tuning (ACFT). ACFT uses an Adversarial Hallucination Attribute Flipping (AHAF) procedure, involving minimal, targeted adversarial perturbations that flip an image's hallucination attribute, to construct perfectly aligned positive-negative pairs, which are then used for contrastive fine-tuning. AHAF simultaneously serves as a diagnostic probe, revealing that MLLM visual representations lie dangerously close to hallucination decision boundaries. Requiring only 0.9% of the COCO dataset and adding zero inference overhead, ACFT achieves state-of-the-art performance on POPE, MME, and four description-level hallucination benchmarks across LLaVA, MiniGPT-4, and Qwen2.5-VL. Code is available at https://github.com/zxp555/ACFT_MM

</details>


### [7] [Beyond Blind Compliance: Benchmarking Task Verification in OCR Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00232)
*Yue Zhou,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VeriOCRBench基准，包含1,800个样本，用于评估多模态大语言模型在OCR场景中的"任务验证"能力——即模型在回答前需判断图像前提、文本前提和问题是否共同构成可执行的任务。该基准引入1,600个陷阱注入的无效任务覆盖8种陷阱类型和4个验证维度（视觉、上下文、事实、逻辑），外加200个无陷阱对照样本。评估15个主流MLLMs揭示了持续的盲目服从、诊断失败和提示诱发的过度拒绝问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在OCR文档理解和文本丰富的视觉推理基准上表现良好，但现有评估假设所有任务都是有效且可回答的。然而真实OCR场景中，问题可能依赖不可读文本、遮挡证据、不存在的视觉目标、矛盾前提或缺失变量。在回答前，模型应能做"OCR接地任务验证"，判断图像前提、文本前提和问题是否共同定义可执行的任务，这一可靠性差距尚未被系统研究。

Method: 作者构建VeriOCRBench：从8个OCR相关数据集中选取源图像，覆盖8个真实世界图像领域，包含1,800个人工验证样本。其中1,600个为陷阱注入的无效任务，覆盖8种陷阱类型和4个验证维度（视觉、上下文、事实、逻辑），另有200个无陷阱对照样本用于衡量过度拒绝。采用视觉原子事实（VAF）锚定的流水线构建，并进行完整人工审计，支持对任务验证、根因诊断和过度拒绝的解耦评估。

Result: 对15个主流MLLMs的评估显示：模型普遍存在"盲目服从"（blind compliance）现象——即使任务无效仍尝试回答；根因诊断失败率较高；同时存在提示诱导的过度拒绝（over-refusal）。这暴露了当前OCR推理系统中的关键可靠性差距。

Conclusion: 当前MLLMs在OCR场景中的任务验证能力严重不足，需要在回答前引入可靠的验证机制来识别无效任务，以缩小与真实世界可靠OCR推理需求之间的差距。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on OCR-centric document understanding and text-rich visual reasoning benchmarks. Yet existing evaluations largely assume that every task is valid and answerable. In real-world OCR scenarios, this assumption often fails: questions may rely on illegible text, occluded evidence, nonexistent visual targets, contradictory premises, or missing variables. We study this reliability gap as OCR-grounded Task Verification: before answering, a model should determine whether the Image Premise (IP), Textual Premise (TP), and Question (Q) jointly define an executable task.

  It contains 1,600 trap-injected invalid tasks across 8 trap types and four verification dimensions---Visual, Contextual, Factual, and Logical---plus 200 trap-free controls for measuring over-refusal. Built with a Visual Atomic Fact (VAF)-anchored pipeline and full human auditing, VeriOCRBench enables decoupled evaluation of task verification, root-cause diagnosis, and over-refusal. Evaluating 15 leading MLLMs reveals persistent blind compliance, diagnosis failures, and prompt-induced over-refusal, exposing a critical reliability gap in current OCR reasoning systems.
  The code is available at: https://github.com/zy001122/Beyond-Blind-Compliance.

</details>

Abstract: Long-tail autonomous driving failures are often framed as rare-object recognition errors. We argue that this view is incomplete: the decision-critical question is not only whether a model recognizes an unusual object, but whether it infers how that object changes the ego vehicle's feasible high-level actions. We formalize this problem as decision-level driving affordance prediction, where a model maps a front-view image, ego-motion history, and navigation command to a structured longitudinal--lateral meta-action. To evaluate this capability, we introduce CoLT-Drive, a 3,536-sample counterfactual long-tail benchmark that inserts rare objects into otherwise fixed driving scenes and measures whether models predict acceptable action pairs. To improve deployable small VLMs, we propose KPA, a knowledge-preserving adaptation framework that combines structured perception-to-decision prompting, SLERP-based expert merging, and RegMoE, a regime-aware LoRA mixture-of-experts module. Abstract: Most advances in keypoint descriptions address monomodal settings, where image variations arise from viewpoint, illumination, or contrast changes. Multimodal scenarios involve images produced by fundamentally different sensing processes, such as multispectral imaging, RGB-depth, satellite imagery, or medical imaging, causing the same structures to appear differently. A common solution to cross-modal description is to train descriptors for each modality pair, which requires retraining whenever the modalities change, or to train large models, which incur a significant increase in runtime. Instead, we propose CrossFeat, a framework that enables an existing monomodal descriptor to operate across modalities. Our method learns a crossing function in descriptor space that maps features from one modality to a representation compatible with another. To preserve the structural information captured by the original descriptor, CrossFeat introduces a geometry-appearance disentanglement such that only appearance is altered while the geometric properties are preserved. Experiments across multiple domains and datasets demonstrate improved performance in multimodal matching.

*Ce Zhang,Jing Bi,Jinxi He,Jianshu Zhang,Jingyang Lin,Yunzhong Xiao,Minghao Fu,Yaqi Xie,Zhentao Xie,Weicong Chen,Katia Sycara,Ming Zhou*

TL;DR: 本文提出StreamScout，一个面向流式视频理解的适应性推断框架。该框架在上下文中仅维护轻量级文本时间线，查询时通过渐进式注入最多三种逐级增强的视觉视图（近期帧概览、均匀回溯、查询显著性检索）来动态决定"何时停止"与"是否升级"。通过蒸馏（StreamScout-S）和强化学习（StreamScout-R）优化停止/升级策略，在三个骨干网络和三个流式基准上显著超越现有方法，同时大幅降低推理成本与token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频理解系统主要关注在受限记忆中保留什么内容，但对所有查询采用相同的固定成本记忆访问机制，忽视了不同查询所需证据量的巨大差异。作者认为，为每个查询自适应决定记忆访问深度与决定记忆存储内容同等重要。

Method: StreamScout采用三层级联的适应性推断框架：(1) 在流展开过程中仅在上下文中维护轻量级文本时间线；(2) 查询时渐进式添加三种视觉视图——近期帧概览、过去流的均匀回溯、查询显著性检索；(3) 每个阶段若证据充分则立即回答，否则升级至下一视图。策略优化方面，StreamScout-S通过辅助集上探测级联并用知识蒸馏得到的经验能力边界来训练轻量级LoRA适配器；StreamScout-R则在蒸馏基础上引入强化学习，让模型探索超越模仿蒸馏决策的停止行为。

Abstract: Streaming video understanding requires answering questions that arrive at arbitrary moments over an unbounded video stream. Existing systems primarily focus on what to retain in a bounded memory, yet access that memory using the same fixed-cost procedure for every query, despite substantial variation in the evidence required. We argue that deciding how deeply to access memory for each query is as important as deciding what the memory should store. To this end, we introduce StreamScout, an adaptive inference framework that maintains only a lightweight textual timeline in context as the stream unfolds. At query time, StreamScout progressively augments the timeline with up to three increasingly informative visual views: a glance at recent frames, a uniform look-back over the past stream, and query-salient retrieval. At each stage, the model answers immediately if the available evidence is sufficient; otherwise, it escalates to the next view. To improve this stop-or-escalate policy, we probe the cascade on an auxiliary set and distill the model's empirical competence boundary into supervision for a lightweight LoRA adaptation, yielding StreamScout-S. We further refine the policy through reinforcement learning, allowing the model to explore stopping behaviors beyond imitation of the distilled decisions, yielding StreamScout-R. Across three backbones and three streaming benchmarks, StreamScout and its variants consistently outperform prior streaming methods while substantially reducing inference cost and token consumption; on OVO-Bench, for instance, StreamScout-S improves Qwen3-VL-8B by 14.65 points while using 59% fewer tokens than uniform sampling and answering in 1.04 s on average.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 实验结果支持闭环阈值感知训练在高召回选择性排除任务中的有效性，表明该方法能够在不牺牲癌症检测灵敏度的前提下实现更高的病例排除率。

Abstract: Reducing the review of clearly cancer-negative screening mammograms could lower radiologist workload without compromising cancer detection. On NLBS, dismissal reached 19.74\% and 21.70\%, while the cross-entropy baseline did not meet either recall target. On RSNA, dismissal improved from 7.04\% to 14.31\% and from 13.49\% to 19.69\%. In external RSNA$\to$NLBS evaluation, the proposed model achieved dismissal rates of 12.95\% and 19.87\% at the 98\% and 95\% recall targets, respectively. These results support closed-loop threshold-aware training for high-recall selective dismissal.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: Hebbian联想机制与学习型记忆路由相结合，能够在视觉Transformer中有效组织快速、持久与整合三个时间尺度的在线视觉经验，为持续视觉学习提供了一种层次化记忆系统方案。

Abstract: Vision Transformers provide strong visual representations but typically rely on slowly updated parameters, limiting their ability to organize newly acquired information across different memory timescales. This work proposes \textit{Hierarchical Hebbian Memory}, a three-level memory architecture composed of rapid Working Memory, persistent Routed Episodic Memory, and slower Semantic Memory. A learned controller regulates memory contribution, read and write routing, plasticity, retention, and consolidation. A causal read-before-write lifecycle ensures that the current outcome cannot influence the prediction it supervises. With Swin-Tiny, the hierarchical model reaches 97.39\% accuracy on Omniglot and 95.37\% final accuracy on CORe50 when combined with experience replay. After intervening distractors, Episodic Memory retains approximately 0.96 cosine similarity with stored associations, while Working Memory falls to approximately 0.05. These results show that Hebbian association and learned memory routing can jointly organize online visual experience across rapid, persistent, and consolidated memory timescales within Vision Transformers.

</details>

*Vida Adeli,Soroush Mehraban,Jacob Rommann,Harrison Sanborn,Cole Clifford,Babak Taati*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Puppeteer，一种姿态感知、物体接地的人类共语手势扩散模型，在因果潜在空间中操作，将长手势分解为结构化基元，通过因果VAE编码为时间有序的潜在token，并在此空间中执行条件扩散，以语音信号、运动历史、初始姿态参考和物体几何为条件生成物理一致的手势，同时支持手势中间插补和手势补全等任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语音驱动的手势生成模型主要强调音频与手势的对齐，但未显式考虑姿态约束或周围物体，未能捕捉身体手势与物理空间之间的内在关联。

Method: (1) 将长手势分解为结构化基元；(2) 学习因果变分自编码器(causal VAE)将其编码为仅依赖过去的时间有序潜在token；(3) 在因果潜在空间中执行条件扩散，以语音、运动历史、初始姿态参考和物体几何为条件；(4) 提出新的评估指标；(5) 创建SceneGes合成3D数据集以支持物体接地的手势生成。

Abstract: Generating co-speech gestures that are temporally coherent, semantically aligned with speech, and grounded with surrounding objects remains challenging. Prior speech-driven gesture models emphasize audio-gesture alignment but do not explicitly account for posture constraints or surrounding objects, failing to capture the inherent correlation between body gestures and the physical space. We present Puppeteer, a posture-aware, object-grounded co-speech gesture diffusion model operating in a causal latent space. We decompose long gestures into structured primitives and learn a causal variational autoencoder that encodes them into temporally ordered latent tokens, each depending only on the past. Abstract: Graphic designers often blend visual concepts to communicate multiple ideas within a single image, leveraging positive and negative space to create balance, emphasis, and aesthetic appeal. TL;DR: 本文提出 Veronese soft-argmax 方法：通过将直线参数化为单位范数齐次向量并应用 Veronese 映射嵌入到对称矩阵空间 Sym²(R³) 中，解决 Hough 空间中软 argmax 因 Z₂ 双重覆盖（Möbius 条结构）导致的几何撕裂问题。同时证明等距加权 Veronese 嵌入上的 L₂ 损失等于射影空间中直线的弦距离平方，提供几何精确的训练目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hough 空间 H=S¹×R 中的方向-偏移对 (θ,ρ) 与 (θ+π,-ρ) 描述同一条无向直线，因此 H 双重覆盖无向直线空间 H/Z₂（Möbius 条），该空间无全局线性结构。现有 soft-argmax 概率加权平均操作需要全局线性空间，直接作用于覆盖空间 H 会将几何上相邻的直线撕裂开。因此需要一个 Z₂ 不变的直线线性嵌入，使 soft-argmax 在其上良定义。

Result: 在基于 Hough 变换的网络中验证了 Veronese soft-argmax 在全部可分辨直线上的表现，确认了均匀且无缝（seam-free）的恢复效果。理论推导证明等距加权 Veronese 嵌入的 L₂ 损失等于射影空间中直线的平方弦距离，从而获得几何精确的训练目标。

Conclusion: Veronese soft-argmax 通过在对称矩阵线性空间中嵌入直线商空间，为 Hough 空间中可微的直线提取提供了数学上良定义的解决方案，兼具 Z₂ 不变性与几何连续性，并配套了具有明确几何意义的损失函数。

Abstract: From horizon detection to fibre structures in X-ray imaging, many vision tasks recover lines via peak detection in Hough space $H=S^1\times\mathbb{R}$, the domain of orientation-offset pairs $(θ,ρ)$. Differentiable pipelines extract coordinates via \emph{soft-argmax}, a probability-weighted average that is only meaningful in a globally linear space. However, $(θ,ρ)$ and $(θ+π,-ρ)$ describe the same undirected line, so $H$ double-covers the space of undirected lines $H/\mathbb{Z}_2$: a Möbius strip, obtained by identifying each pair under $\mathbb{Z}_2$ action. Soft-argmax operates on the cover $H$, but since $H/\mathbb{Z}_2$ admits no linear structure, it tears geometrically adjacent lines apart. Thus we need a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-invariant embedding of lines into a linear space, on which soft-argmax is well-defined. We achieve this by parametrising lines via unit-norm homogeneous vectors $\ell=(1+ρ^2)^{-1/2}(\cosθ,\sinθ,-ρ)^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^3$ and applying the Veronese map $v_2(\ell)=\ell\ell^{\top}$ that satisfies $v_2(\ell)=v_2(-\ell)$. </details>

Last but not the least, we introduce Rescale, a model-agnostic post-processing agent for localized scale correction without modifying the source generator. Abstract: Neuroradiologists rarely read a brain MRI in isolation, yet automated brain-MRI report generation has been built almost entirely for single studies. Abstract: Current 4D generation paradigms are often bottlenecked by a sequential decoupling design: video is generated first, followed by 3D reconstruction, leading to high interaction latency. Unlike traditional frame-by-frame emission and delayed geometry recovery, Streaming4D generates temporal video blocks and immediately triggers reconstruction for each completed block, enabling parallel execution between synthesis and geometric updates. This approach allows the world representation to evolve online with the video stream, reducing feedback latency while preserving geometric fidelity. </details>

Abstract: Global welfare often depends on the correct interpretation of aerial and satellite imagery. In structured vision problems such as gesture recognition, facial expression categorization, and medical image analysis, discriminative information lies less in individual pixels and more in spatial relationships between semantic parts. Abstract: Physically Plausible Video Generation (PPVG) seeks to synthesize videos consistent with physical principles, yet remains challenging due to underspecified natural language conditioning. Advanced chain-of-thought (CoT) frameworks augment prompts with physical knowledge. However, such prompts describe physical phenomena holistically, overlooking intermediate states and transition dynamics. In this paper, we reformulate PPVG as event-centric generation by representing physical evolution as a chain of causally connected and physically constrained events. Our framework comprises three key modules: (1) Physics-driven Event Chain Reasoning. This module decomposes physical phenomena into causally connected events represented by evolving scene graphs. Formula-derived physical quantities are bound to relevant objects and interactions, characterizing the direction and magnitude of each event transition. (2) Transition-aware Routed Keyframe Conditioning. This module routes each event to a specialized keyframe synthesis operator for appearance variation or object transformation. Consecutive keyframes are injected as residual guidance during denoising, enabling smooth visual transitions between event-boundary states. (3) Physics-injected Contrastive Semantic Guidance. This module constructs physics-informed positive and counterfactual negative prompts for classifier-free guidance, steering generation toward plausible dynamics and away from physics-violating counterparts. We identify cross-scale coupling mismatch as a new forensic signal, where scale refers to the level of abstraction (semantic dynamics vs. pixel-level residuals): in natural videos, macro-level temporal dynamics and micro-level residual patterns are intrinsically coupled by the unified imaging physics pipeline, whereas AI generators, whose training objectives do not explicitly preserve this joint distribution, systematically violate this coupling. We propose RIFT (Representation Inconsistency Forensics on Trajectories), an orthogonal forensic framework that addresses this through three interlocking components: a macro stream that builds a dynamic baseline of expected temporal evolution via differential geometry and persistent homology on learned manifold trajectories, a micro stream that acts as a sensitive forensic probe via steganalytic filtering and temporal modeling, and a coupling divergence module that measures the conditional dependency between the two streams. At the spatial refinement stage, coarse-scale attention maps preselect globally relevant interactions to pre-sparsify fine-scale attention, enabling non-local refinement beyond isolated patches without the quadratic cost of dense attention. Abstract: Flow Matching provides an efficient generative prior for image restoration by learning continuous transport between source and data distributions. Such corrections may disrupt the source-clean endpoint coupling implicitly encoded by the pretrained flow, making the corrected endpoint pair incompatible with the current state. To address this issue, we propose ReBridge-Flow, a posterior bridge re-coupling method. Specifically, given the current state, ReBridge-Flow first decodes the corresponding local source and clean endpoints. It then incorporates measurement information through clean-side anchoring and synchronously re-couples the source endpoint, yielding a measurement-aware endpoint pair with improved local bridge compatibility. The re-coupled endpoints further define a posterior-informed transport direction for advancing the sampling process. We propose MeRoPE (Metric Rotary Position Embedding), a norm-preserving relative camera encoding for attention. MeRoPE encodes relative orientations between calibrated viewing rays with orthogonal rotation blocks, maps raw metric displacements into multi-frequency rotary phases, and adds a disparity-anchored correspondence prior along the epipolar arc. Abstract: Remote sensing visual models have continuously advanced various interpretation tasks. However, the research process behind model improvement still heavily relies on manual expertise, requiring extensive trial-and-error iterations in model design, data processing, and performance diagnosis. Existing agent-based approaches mainly focus on task execution and workflow orchestration, while lacking the capability of autonomous research iteration for continuous performance optimization. To address this issue, we propose RingMoClaw, an experience-inspired self-evolving multi-agent framework for remote sensing visual interpretation. RingMoClaw integrates a research branch, a quality-control branch, and a dual-stream dynamic experience bus to establish a closed-loop optimization process covering strategy generation, experiment execution, independent review, and experience accumulation. The heterogeneous Critic mechanism provides stage-wise diagnosis and feedback, while the dual-stream experience bus incorporates external knowledge and internal experimental experience to guide strategy evolution and eliminate ineffective searches. Conclusion: 场景文字识别的"饱和"结论具有误导性——高平局准确率掩盖了系统性的稀有输入性能崩溃。核心瓶颈不在于模型容量或训练策略，而在于自回归解码器固有的词汇先验偏差。解决此类组合性长尾问题需要架构层面的变革（如转向CTC解码），而非单纯的参数扩展；这也暗示了需要精细的压力测试基准来取代单一聚合指标，以便正确评估识别器的分布外泛化能力。

</details>

Abstract: InfRared Small Target Detection (IRSTD) is a challenging task. Relying solely on pixel-level information, vision-only methods struggle to distinguish targets from clutter. ### [54] [One Prompt Is Enough: Watermark Laundering Through Foundation Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01249)
*Jidong Yang,Qi Li,Wei Zong,Yang-Wai Chow,Willy Susilo,Huaike Yu,Chunpeng Wang,Suo Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统性地揭示并形式化了一种新型的不可见水印攻击范式——"水印清洗"（watermark laundering），即攻击者只需将含水印图像提交给公开的基础图像模型并附加一个重建提示，即可获得视觉保真度极高的输出，同时使隐藏水印无法被可靠解码。作者通过联合payload-保真度评估框架，在6个OpenAI和Google图像编辑模型、3种代表性水印方案、1800个重建输出上进行了全面评估，发现OpenAI模型造成最强的payload破坏，而Nano Banana 2在DwtDct方案上即使在高保真重建下仍表现出脆弱性。实验表明该效果主要由重建通路本身而非特定对抗指令引起，且与传统攻击（压缩、模糊、裁剪等）相比构成截然不同的攻击接口，因此基础模型重建应被视为不可见水印评估中缺失的鲁棒性条件。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Vision-language models are evaluated by aggregate accuracy on multimodal benchmarks, a practice that implicitly assumes the model uses its visual input. We name this phenomenon the Visual Insensitivity Gap and quantify it with a per-sample Visual Sensitivity Index (VSI). The gap is a property of samples, not of models: VSI ranks correlate across models (grand-mean Spearman rho=+0.40, permutation p<10^-3), so the same samples are flagged insensitive by VLMs sharing no architectural detail beyond a contrastively pretrained vision tower. The mechanism is concrete: on the insensitive samples, a linear probe on each model's own vision tower distinguishes perturbed from clean images at 0.72--0.79 accuracy, yet the model's argmax token changes on only 2%--11% of the same samples, an encoder--LLM gap above 0.65 on every model. Abstract: Obtaining labeled data for semantic segmentation in applied settings (e.g., autonomous driving, industrial waste sorting) is expensive and often infeasible at scale. Abstract: Modifying the illumination of driving images is a fundamental challenge, as most datasets are captured at specific times of day. To address this, we propose HELIOS, a novel image relighting approach that relies on unlabeled real-world datasets without requiring any paired images for training. Our approach integrates albedo-based conditioning into a cycle-consistent diffusion pipeline to prevent identity collapse and ensure accurate domain translation. To handle low-visibility nighttime conditions, we introduce a robust albedo distillation strategy that transfers structural stability from the daytime domain. Abstract: Reliable evaluation of automated coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) report generation requires standardized multicentre benchmarks and clinically structured metrics. Report pairs are compared at the finest shared anatomical level, and the contributions of different clinical components are weighted based on expert assessments. We estimated these weights using 70 expert-scored cases and evaluated clinical alignment in a non-overlapping set of 30 cases. CSM$_{\text{CCTA}}$ showed a strong correlation with radiologist scores (Pearson's $r=0.97$, $p<0.001$), exceeding the next-best metric, FORTE ($r=0.70$), by 0.27, and agreed with expert preferences in 115 of 160 pairwise comparisons (71.9\%). In the multicenter benchmark, the CCTA-trained C2RG model achieved the highest CSM$_{\text{CCTA}}$ scores across all four hospitals, although its performance remained far from optimal. In contrast, CCTA-irrelevant reports accounted for up to 98.7\% of the outputs from generalist models. Together, the benchmark provides a standardized setting for model comparison, while CSM$_{\text{CCTA}}$ enables clinically structured evaluation of finding agreement and anatomical specificity. These results support a more clinically aligned and anatomically resolved approach to evaluating CCTA report generation. Code is available at https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/OpenMedIA/CSM_CCTA.

Abstract: While feed-forward 3D reconstruction (3R) offers efficient end-to-end modeling, its application in large-scale UAV mapping is hindered by the prohibitive memory cost of Transformer attention. Current scalable streaming 3R methods assume temporally and spatially continuous inputs, rendering them ineffective for the weakly ordered or unordered image streams common in cross-strip UAV operations. To address this, we propose On-the-Fly3R, a training-free, progressive online 3D reconstruction framework for large-scale UAV images that upgrades various 3R backbones for large-scale UAV scenarios. Our method enables reconstruction from unordered inputs via retrieval-guided dynamic subset construction, which adaptively selects spatially relevant images. To further improve the robustness, a validation-rejection-retry mechanism is designed to guarantee global consistency, performing a pre-integration consistency check and automatically rejecting misaligned images and retrying with alternative subset. Finally, inspired by VSLAM, pose graph optimization based on the retrieval loop closure is employed to mitigate camera drift. Evaluations on several UAV benchmarks show that our On-the-Fly3R successfully scales various 3R models to over 5,000 images across square-kilometer UAV scenes, delivering substantially superior accuracy compared to several SOTA streaming 3R methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Sh1nZzz/On_the_Fly3R

Based on this observation, we propose ASSERT, a training-free sampler that uses higher stochasticity early and smoothly transitions to deterministic denoising.   <summary>Details</summary>

Cast shadows and contact shading usually lie outside the user-provided instance mask M_obj, so a frozen Fill model that edits only that mask leaves the object's photometric footprint on nearby surfaces. Abstract: Mixed-format medical visual question answering (VQA) requires stable option selection and machine-readable free-text output.   <summary>Details</summary>
