### [230] [When Tokenization is Secretly Output Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01386)
*Tanja Baeumel,Josef van Genabith,Simon Ostermann*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出应将分词（tokenization）视为输出监督而非仅输入预处理：在自回归模型中，分词粒度决定了单个前向传播中模型需完成的任务，从而影响学习难度、训练动态和内部表征。通过数值推理中的输入/输出分词解耦实验验证了这一观点，并调查发现120篇近期*CL论文中仅约10%报告数值分词方式，69%在不报告的情况下跨分词（即监督）体制比较模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分词被默认视为输入预处理决策，但现有文献虽记录分词持续影响模型性能，却缺乏原则性的理论解释。作者认为理解分词如何影响模型任务本身（而非仅输入表示）对公平比较模型和解释性能差异至关重要。

Method: 采用受控实验，创新性地将输入分词与输出分词解耦，聚焦数值推理任务；对比输出分词变化对任务性能、训练动态和模型内部表征的影响，并与输入分词的影响进行对照；同时开展120篇近期*CL论文的文献调查以量化该问题在实践中的忽视程度。

Result: 实验结果支持输出监督观点：任务性能、训练动态和模型内部表征的差异由输出分词诱发，而基本不受输入分词影响。文献调查显示仅约10%的论文报告所评估模型的数值分词方式，69%的论文在不同分词（即监督）体制间比较模型却未报告这一点。

Conclusion: 分词应被框定为输出监督决策：不同分词策略的模型不仅在输入表示上不同，本质上是在不同任务上训练的。跨分词策略的模型比较可能反映的是任务定义差异而非模型能力差异，研究者应报告并考量这一因素。

Abstract: Tokenization in language models is treated by default as an input preprocessing decision. We argue that this framing is incomplete: in autoregressive models, tokenizer granularity determines what the model must resolve in a single forward pass, and therefore the supervision signal it receives. This affects both the difficulty of the learning problem and the representations that emerge inside the model. We test this in a controlled experiment on numeric reasoning with a novel decoupling of input and output tokenization. As the output supervision view predicts, differences in task performance, training dynamics, and model internals are induced by output tokenization and largely invariant to input tokenization. This may matter in practice, because models with different tokenization strategies differ not only in input representation but in the task they were trained on. Comparisons between models may thus partly reflect task definition rather than ability. A survey of 120 recent *CL papers on numeric reasoning confirms that this is rarely acknowledged: only about 10% report the numeric tokenization of the models they evaluate, while 69% compare across tokenization, and thus supervision, regimes without reporting it. While prior work documents that tokenization consistently affects model performance, there is no principled account of why. We argue that framing tokenization as output supervision provides that account.

</details>


### [231] [From Rollouts to Recipes: Self-Contained Post-Training for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01422)
*Yifei Li,Lingling Zhang,Muye Huang,Zihan Ma,Jiashuai Liu,Jun Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Self-Routing框架，基于模型自身rollout的正确性与置信度，将每个样本动态路由到GRPO、自蒸馏、正则化或跳过四种优化策略，替代传统的统一训练配方。实验表明在数学推理任务上持续优于统一GRPO、统一OPSD及固定混合等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大语言模型的后训练对所有样本采用单一训练配方，忽略了模型自身rollout揭示的不同样本级学习状态。一刀切的训练方式缺乏自适应性，无法针对处于不同学习阶段的样本进行差异化优化。

Method: Self-Routing采用行为条件化的后训练框架，利用rollout正确性和置信度判定每个样本的行为状态，据此将样本路由至四种策略之一：GRPO、on-policy自蒸馏、正则化或直接跳过。该框架无需外部教师、额外标注或额外采样，完全依赖模型自身反馈。

Result: 在Qwen3和Qwen3.5骨干网络上进行数学推理实验，Self-Routing一致优于统一GRPO、统一OPSD、固定混合以及更简单的路由基线。进一步分析显示路由分布随训练动态变化，并且有效减少了对低信号或已稳定样本的不必要更新。

Conclusion: 基于样本行为状态的自适应训练路由是比统一配方更有效的后训练策略，能够更高效地分配训练资源，同时提升数学推理性能。

Abstract: Post-training large language models usually applies a single training recipe to all samples, even though the model's own rollouts reveal different sample-level learning states. We propose Self-Routing, a behavior-conditioned post-training framework that uses rollout correctness and confidence to decide how each sample should be optimized. Depending on its behavior state, a sample is routed to GRPO, on-policy self-distillation, regularization, or skipping, allowing training to adapt without external teachers, extra annotations, or additional sampling. Experiments on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 backbones show that Self-Routing consistently improves over uniform GRPO, uniform OPSD, fixed mixtures, and simpler routing baselines. Further analyses show that the routing distribution changes over training and reduces unnecessary updates on low-signal or already stable samples.

</details>


### [232] [GlossoGen: Emergent Language in Complex Multi-Agent LLM Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01491)
*Elias Stengel-Eskin,Newton Sander,Carlos Bonetti,Sasha Boguraev,James Bowler,Hale Sirin,Simon Kirby*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍GlossoGen平台，用于研究多LLM智能体在复杂场景中的语言进化。在SaveVeyru场景中，研究发现LLM智能体之间确实发生语言进化，产生的语言具有组合性和形态能产性，但偏离英语先验以致人类无法理解。研究识别出效率压力、模型强度和死亡后聚合阶段等关键因素，并发现强模型是新型语言涌现的必要条件，而弱模型可以学习已涌现的语言。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体之间交互速率不断增长，这引发了关于多LLM智能体环境中语言进化的关键问题，对安全性和可监控性以及LLM的语言学解释都有重要影响。此前语言进化仅在人类中被证实，作者希望探究当前LLM是否具有累积文化进化的潜力。

Method: 构建GlossoGen平台和SaveVeyru场景，要求具有部分信息的智能体在压力下进行通信。通过对比LLM智能体的语言产出与英语先验的偏离程度，并操纵效率压力、模型强度、postmortem阶段等因素来系统检验语言进化的条件。

Result: 语言进化确实发生在LLM智能体之间；语言具有组合性和形态能产性并偏离英语先验；效率压力、模型力量和后mortem阶段是进化必需；新智能体可仅通过使用学会新语言且主动参与学习；强模型是语言涌现所需条件，弱模型可学习已涌现语言。

Conclusion: 当前LLM具有此前仅在人类中证实的累积文化进化潜力，混合智能体群体能够发展出超越其最低共同能力的能力，这对多智能体系统的设计和监控具有重要启示。

Abstract: The growing rate at which LLM agents interact with one another raises key questions about language evolution in multi-LLM-agent settings, with implications for safety and monitorability as well as for linguistic accounts of LLMs. To address these questions, we introduce GlossoGen, a novel platform for studying multi-agent language evolution in complex scenarios. Within GlossoGen, we build the SaveVeyru scenario, which requires agents with partial information to communicate under pressure. We find that language evolution does occur between LLM agents, that the resulting languages are compositional and morphologically productive, and that they deviate from the LLMs' English prior in ways that render them incomprehensible to humans. Moreover, we identify several qualities essential to this evolution: pressure towards efficiency; the strength of the models backing the agents; and access to a "postmortem" stage in which agents can agree on linguistic conventions. Importantly, we observe that different conditions govern the transmission of language to new agents. Specifically, we find that agents learn new languages from usage alone, take an active role in this learning, and that while stronger models are required for novel language emergence, weaker models can learn an existing language once it has emerged. Taken together, our results indicate that current LLMs have the potential for cumulative cultural evolution -- previously attested only in humans -- with mixed populations of agents developing capacities that go beyond their lowest common denominator.

</details>


### [233] [Knowledge Distillation During Mid-Training Favors Reasoning over Factual Recall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01532)
*Jacqueline He,Howard Yen,Shuyue Stella Li,Margaret Li,Hanqing Zeng,Yinglong Xia,Benyu Zhang,Zhuokai Zhao,Qiang Zhang,Pang Wei Koh,Luke Zettlemoyer,Wen-tau Yih*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文揭示了基于Logit的知识蒸馏在中训练阶段与预训练阶段的行为存在根本差异，并提出Switch Distillation目标函数，通过教师预测熵作为路由信号，仅在教师高置信度的token上进行蒸馏，否则回退到交叉熵损失。该方法在推理、知识与常识任务上持续优于现有蒸馏目标，且在中训练后仍保持优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏（尤其是前向KL蒸馏）对小语言模型在不同训练阶段（预训练与中训练）收益是否一致尚不清楚。作者发现前向KD在预训练阶段同时提升推理与事实回忆，但在中训练阶段反而减缓事实回忆获取，这一阶段依赖性源于教师在不同数据域上的置信度不对称以及学生知识状态的演化。需要设计一种能缓解该失衡的蒸馏目标。

Method: 首先通过受控实验建立前向KL蒸馏在不同训练阶段的差异行为，追溯其根因在于教师对程序性数据与知识密集型数据的置信度不对称，及学生早期获取低熵事实知识的状态。随后提出Switch Distillation：以教师预测熵为轻量路由信号，对教师高置信度的token执行蒸馏，其余token回退到标准交叉熵损失。

Result: 相比标准NTP，Switch Distillation在推理性能上达到1.61-1.71倍，知识与常识性能达到1.13-1.19倍，且保留了96.7-96.8%的事实回忆。在post-training之后，事实回忆差距被弥合，同时在推理上保持1.25-1.32倍、知识常识上保持1.13-1.20倍的增益，且在不同教师规模下均优于现有蒸馏目标。

Conclusion: 前向KD的训练阶段依赖性源于教师置信度与数据域分布的不匹配，Switch Distillation通过教师熵这一简单的路由信号，在中训练阶段实现了推理与事实回忆之间的平衡，且其收益在post-training后依然保持，为大型语言模型中训练阶段的知识蒸馏提供了一种高效且稳健的范式。

Abstract: Logit-based knowledge distillation (KD) is used to train smaller language models (LMs) via supervision from stronger teachers, but whether its benefits are consistent across training stages remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we find that forward Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation--the standard KD formulation--with post-trained teachers behaves fundamentally differently during mid-training, an intermediate phase of self-supervised learning on curated corpora. Surprisingly, while forward KD simultaneously improves reasoning and factual recall during pre-training relative to standard next-token prediction (NTP), it instead slows factual recall acquisition during mid-training despite continued reasoning gains. We trace this stage dependence to an asymmetry in teacher confidence across data domains and the student's evolving knowledge state: teachers are more confident on procedural than knowledge-intensive data, while students acquire low-entropy factual knowledge earlier in training. To mitigate this imbalance, we propose Switch Distillation, a simple mid-training objective that distills on tokens where the teacher is confident, using teacher predictive entropy as a lightweight routing signal, and otherwise falls back to cross-entropy. Switch Distillation consistently outperforms existing distillation objectives across teacher sizes. Relative to standard NTP, it achieves 1.61-1.71x the reasoning performance and 1.13-1.19x the knowledge and commonsense performance while preserving 96.7-96.8% of factual recall. Crucially, these benefits persist after post-training: Switch Distillation closes the factual recall gap while maintaining 1.25-1.32x and 1.13-1.20x gains in reasoning and knowledge and commonsense, respectively.

</details>


### [234] [SDARE-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Conversational Stigma Detection and Response in Dyadic and Group Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01548)
*Stephanie Fong,Yiwen Jiang,Zimu Wang,Hongxi Yang,Yaling Shen,Hiu Weh Naomi Chow,Heung Ying Lai,Xiangyu Zhao,Qingyang Xu,Zhongxing Xu,Jiahe Liu,Guilherme C. Oliveira,Vincent Lee,Zongyuan Ge,Dominic Dwyer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了SDARE-Bench，这是首个基于场景的基准测试，用于评估LLM在污名检测和开放式响应生成方面的能力。通过在1138个双人对话和1388个群组对话中进行实证评估，发现8个LLM普遍难以识别污名成分，在群组设置中污名表达率显著更高，在构建的群体压力场景下污名表达率平均高达97.5%。研究揭示了污名响应是LLM在复杂社交对话情境中的系统性安全漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于可能影响社会判断的建议寻求和决策场景，但现有基准缺乏针对污名（stigma）的系统评估。已有的通用领域评估依赖静态提示和固定格式任务，忽略了对真实日常沟通中关键的情景对话背景和受众效应（audience effects），因此无法全面捕捉LLM在污名相关社会互动中的表现。

Method: 提出了SDARE-Bench基准，包含1138个双人对话查询和1388个群体对话场景，涵盖污名检测和开放式响应生成两大任务。对8个LLM进行实证评估；开放式响应的评估使用一个在1392条人工标注响应上训练的分类器；此外还设计了群体压力设置以测试LLM在从众压力下的污名表达倾向。

Result: 8个LLM在污名成分识别上表现普遍较弱，尤其在群体对话中表现更差。在开放式响应生成中，群体情境下的污名表达显著高于双人情境，且表现出更弱的污名抵抗力和更不切实际的建议。在人为构建的群体压力下，污名表达率急剧上升至平均97.5%的惊人水平。

Conclusion: 污名响应是LLM反复出现的安全漏洞，尤其是在社交复杂度较高的对话情境中。这一发现强调了需要针对社会性对话场景开发更稳健的LLM安全评估与防护机制。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in advice seeking and decision making that may affect social judgements. Despite stigma's profound effects on people and communities, benchmarks remain scarce. Existing general-domain evaluations typically rely on static prompts and fixed-format tasks, overlooking conversational contexts and audience effects in everyday communication. To address these gaps, we introduce SDARE-Bench, the first scenario-based benchmark evaluating both stigma detection and open-ended response generation in LLMs, comprising 1,138 dyadic queries and 1,388 group dialogue. Empirical results across 8 LLMs consistently demonstrate poor identification of stigma components, especially in group dialogues. In open-ended response generation, stigma expression was substantially higher in group settings than in dyadic, with weaker resistance to stigma and more unrealistic advice. Responses were evaluated using a classifier trained on 1,392 human annotated responses. In constructed group pressure settings, stigma expression rates further increased to a striking average of 97.5%. Our findings identify stigma response as a recurring LLM safety vulnerability, especially in socially complex conversational contexts.

</details>


### [235] [A systematic Approach to constructing a Chance-and-Risk Matrix for Semiconductor Supply Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01563)
*Ema Salkić,Alexander Fichtl,Philipp Ulrich,Hans Ehm,Marta Bonik,Georg Groh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端流水线，从半导体公司的公开企业披露文件中持续提取、结构化并排序风险与机遇情报，利用LLM抽取信息、构建知识图谱、去重，并通过三层排序机制（算法公式+LLM相关性调整+专家验证）进行优先级排序。在五家跨价值链公司上验证，产出76,207条评分条目，92.6%通过独立有效性检查，风险排序与专家判断的Spearman相关系数为0.55，机遇为0.72。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体供应链面临地缘政治紧张、地理集中和快速技术变革带来的不断升级的风险，但目前缺乏可扩展的系统来从公开企业披露中持续提取、结构化和排序风险情报，已有方法无法满足此需求。

Method: 构建端到端流水线：(1)检索半导体公司的企业披露文件；(2)利用LLM抽取其中描述的风险与机遇；(3)构建知识图谱，将每条条目链接至类别、来源和相关事件；(4)合并重复项；(5)采用三层排序机制：算法公式、LLM相关性调整和专家验证，最终生成按重要性排序的风险/机遇矩阵。

Result: 在五家覆盖价值链不同环节的公司上应用，流水线产出76,207条评分条目，独立检查确认92.6%有效。自动化排序与专家判断的平均Spearman相关系数：风险为0.55，机遇为0.72。生成的风险矩阵识别出贸易限制是跨公司最突出的共同风险。

Conclusion: 该流水线能够可扩展地从公开披露中提取并排序供应链风险情报，其排序结果与专家判断具有中等至较强的一致性，且能有效识别主导性跨公司风险，为半导体供应链风险管理提供系统性工具。

Abstract: Semiconductor supply chains face escalating risks from geopolitical tensions, geographic concentration, and rapid technological shifts, yet no scalable system continuously extracts, structures, and prioritizes risk intelligence from public corporate disclosures. We present an end-to-end pipeline that retrieves corporate documents for semiconductor companies and uses large language models (LLMs) to extract the risks and opportunities they describe. It organizes these into a knowledge graph linking each item to its category, sources, and related events, then merges duplicates and ranks them with a three-layer mechanism combining an algorithmic formula, an LLM relevance adjustment, and expert validation. Applied to five companies across the value chain, the pipeline produces 76,207 scored items, of which an independent check finds 92.6% valid. The automated rankings match expert judgment at an average Spearman correlation of 0.55 for risks and 0.72 for opportunities, and the resulting matrices identify trade restrictions as the dominant cross-company risk.

</details>


### [236] [From Confusion to Clarity: Confusion-Aware Retrieval and Knowledge Injection for Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01564)
*Manish Gupta,Chaitanya Giri,Jayasimha Talur*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个无需微调的框架，通过识别模型难以区分的标签对、扩充候选集以纳入易混淆标签、并生成针对性区分规则，帮助LLM在大量相似标签的分类任务中提升性能，在三个基准上Macro F1最高提升10.0个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在处理具有大量语义相似标签的分类任务时表现不佳，因为标签间的细微差别通常依赖领域知识且无法通过预训练获得。现有的top-K候选检索方法虽然缩减了候选规模，但当两个相似的标签同时出现在候选中时，模型缺乏足够的信号来正确区分它们，导致分类准确率受限。

Method: 提出一个三阶段框架：(1)识别模型难以区分的标签对（confusable label pairs）；(2)扩充候选集以纳入这些易混淆标签；(3)生成针对性的规则来区分相似候选标签。整个框架无需微调，生成的规则可以迁移到更小、更便宜的模型上使用。

Result: 在WOS、Flipkart、LEDGAR三个基准测试上，该方法相比检索基线在Macro F1上最高提升10.0个百分点；通过跨模型迁移，小模型（2B–20B参数）最高可获得11.5个百分点的提升。

Conclusion: 该研究证明，通过显式识别并处理易混淆标签对、生成可迁移的区分规则，可以有效提升LLM在大规模相似标签分类任务上的表现，且无需昂贵的微调成本，生成的规则对较小模型同样有效。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) struggle to classify text into taxonomies with many semantically similar labels, as the distinctions are domain-specific and not captured by pre-training. To handle large label spaces, a common approach retrieves top-$K$ candidate labels by embedding similarity and prompt the LLM to choose among them. However, top-$K$ retrieval reduces the number of candidates but does not help the model tell similar ones apart. When two similar labels both appear as candidates, the model lacks the signal to choose correctly between them. We propose a framework that (1) identifies which label pairs the model struggles to distinguish, (2) expands the candidate set to include confusable labels, and (3) generates targeted rules to differentiate between similar candidates. The framework requires no fine-tuning, and the generated rules transfer to smaller, cheaper models. On three benchmarks (WOS, Flipkart, LEDGAR), our approach improves Macro F1 by up to 10.0pp over retrieval baselines, with smaller models (2B--20B) gaining up to 11.5pp via cross-model transfer.

</details>


### [237] [From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01572)
*Olga Tsymboi,Dmitrii Stoianov,Ramil Latypov,Danil Taranets,Daniil Dryabin,Mikhail Gashkov,Viktor Zelenkovskiy,Aleksandr Fida,Gleb Alektorov,Nikita Gulyakov,Arthur Babkin,Aleksandr Medvedev,Pavel Gein,Anatolii Potapov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在数据驻留约束下通过整合多个自托管LLM为单一模型来优化GPU资源的方法。通过生产错误分析识别三方面质量问题（指令遵循、函数调用、内部任务分布），分别训练独立的GRPO专家并使用两阶段SLERP合并，最终以约7倍小的模型在内部Arena、指令遵循和函数调用基准上超越大模型基线，吸收了平台50%流量（每月1.16亿请求）同时降低服务成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驻留合规要求企业自托管LLM，但持续引入新模型而非淘汰旧模型会导致服务模型池碎片化，使有限的GPU资源被分散占用。作者希望通过将200多个内部应用的流量整合到单一模型上，通过缩小质量差距来提升GPU利用率并降低成本。

Method: （1）沿三个维度（指令遵循、函数调用、内部任务分布）分析生产错误，识别质量差距；（2）使用按生产流量分层的离线基准进行质量追踪，通过确定性验证器或校准LLM评判打分；（3）避免对所有目标联合优化（会产生跨领域奖励干扰），而是为每个维度独立训练GRPO专家，再通过两阶段SLERP（球面线性插值）合并；（4）每个专家针对特定失败模式（语义塌缩、过度调用、冗长黑客）进行领域特定修复。

Result: 在非推理模式下，该方案用比基线小约7倍的模型参数量在各项基准上均超越基线：内部Arena得分69.6对65.8，指令遵循0.85对0.83，函数调用0.79对0.77，同时提升了通用对话基准。该模型吸收了平台50%流量（每月1.16亿请求），服务成本大幅降低。

Conclusion: 通过按错误维度拆分训练专家再经SLERP合并的方法，能够在数据驻留但模型资源受限的条件下，以显著更小的模型实现对大模型的质量超越，并有效整合内部流量以节省GPU资源和服务成本。

Abstract: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.

</details>


### [238] [Scaling Near-Optimal SFT-RL Annotation Budget Allocation from Small to Large LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01573)
*Jingtan Wang,Arun Verma,Xiaoqiang Lin,Zhengyuan Liu,Nancy F. Chen,Daniela Rus,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM后训练中如何在监督微调(SFT)和强化学习(RL)之间分配固定标注预算的问题。作者提出用"近最优区域"这一概念替代寻找单一最优分配比，实证发现该区域即使在较小的容差(2-10%)下也很宽，且随模型规模扩大而变宽，并能从小规模代理模型可靠迁移到大规模目标模型，从而提出了用小规模模型实验来确定可迁移近最优区域的实际策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM后训练阶段如何在有限的标注预算下分配SFT与RL是尚未解决的问题。现有工作仅描述宽泛趋势（如低数据量下SFT占优），缺乏原则性的分配框架，也未验证最优比例是否在不同模型规模间可迁移。这阻碍了实际大规模模型训练时的预算优化决策。

Method: 将SFT-RL预算分配问题框定为近最优性问题：不再寻找单一最优比例，而是刻画在指定性能容差范围内所有可行分配的"近最优区域"。通过跨模型规模、任务、模型家族以及偏好式off-policy和奖励监督式on-policy两类RL方法进行系统实验，验证该区域的宽度、随规模的变化趋势以及从小代理模型到大目标模型的迁移性。

Result: 近最优区域即使在小容差(2-10%)下也较宽；该区域随模型规模扩大而变宽；从小规模代理模型到大规模目标模型转移可靠。此外还分析了SFT与RL数据的标注成本不对称性对近最优区域位置的影响。以上结论在多个任务、模型家族以及两类RL方法中均一致成立。

Conclusion: 实践中无需对大模型进行穷举式的SFT-RL分配搜索，仅需在小规模代理模型上进行实验即可识别出可迁移的近最优分配区域，从而在预算分配决策上实现高效的规模外推。

Abstract: How to divide a fixed annotation budget between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) during LLM post-training remains an open problem. Existing work characterizes only broad trends (e.g., SFT dominates in low-data regimes), lacks a principled allocation framework, and does not examine whether the optimal ratio transfers across model sizes. We frame this problem in terms of near-optimality: rather than seeking a single optimal SFT-RL ratio, we characterize the near-optimal region, the set of allocations within a specified tolerance of peak performance. Empirically, this region is wide even for small tolerances (2-10%), widens with model scale, and transfers reliably from small proxy models to large target models. This yields a practical strategy: small proxy-model experiments suffice to identify a transferable near-optimal region, eliminating the need for exhaustive large-scale search. Our results hold consistently across tasks, model families, and both preference-based off-policy and reward-supervision on-policy RL methods. We further analyze how the asymmetry in annotation costs between SFT and RL data shifts the near-optimal region.

</details>


### [239] [Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01575)
*Maksim Evdokimov,Matvey Ivanov,Dmitrii Tsiupin,Olga Tsymboi,Anatolii Potapov,Aleksandr Ivanov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个部署在受监管行业中的文档理解系统，基于35B总参数、3B激活参数的Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) VLM，在单张H100上即可运行，通过难度感知的数据筛选管道进行微调，在质量调整成本分析中比人工基线降低超80%成本，比最优开源模型降低超50%成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受监管行业中每年需从数亿文档中提取结构化字段，但成本高昂：定制OCR流水线仅覆盖部分工作流、隐私规则禁止使用外部模型、现有开源VLM在达到质量标准时的服务成本甚至高于人工标注。因此需要一种既满足质量门槛又经济可行的文档理解方案。

Method: 采用MoE架构VLM（35B总参数/3B激活），在内部生产数据与开放域文档混合数据上进行微调。数据通过难度感知（Difficulty-Aware）管道筛选，以确保布局多样性、事实可提取性和跨模型一致性。模型通过提示（prompting）方式服务异构工作流，仅需单张H100即可推理。

Result: 该模型在质量上超越了所有可部署（非推理型）基线，包括大至一个数量级的模型。基于生产遥测校准的成本分析显示，相比人工基线预期成本降低超80%，相比最优竞品开源模型降低超50%，而更大的基线模型在经济上不可行。

Conclusion: 通过MoE架构与难度感知数据筛选的有效结合，可以在受监管行业中以经济可行的方式实现高质量、多工作流的文档理解，为大规模文档结构化提取提供了一种可部署且成本远优于现有方案的路径。

Abstract: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation. We present a deployed document-understanding system built on a Mixture-of-Experts VLM (35B total, 3B active), fine-tuned on in-house production data mixed with open-domain documents curated by a Difficulty-Aware pipeline for layout diversity, fact-extractability, and cross-model consistency. Fitting on a single H100 and serving heterogeneous workflows via prompting, the model leads all deployable (non-reasoning) baselines up to an order of magnitude larger. A quality-adjusted cost analysis, with confirmation and correction costs calibrated from production telemetry, shows it reduces expected costs by over 80% against the human baseline and by more than 50% against the best competing open-source model, while larger baselines remain economically unviable.

</details>


### [240] [StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01591)
*Ke Yang,Chenglong Wang,Michel Galley,Chandan Singh,Jeevana Priya Inala,ChengXiang Zhai,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出StudentSim，一个通过池化训练加个体特化将稀疏学生数据转化为个性化模拟器的训练框架，并配套StudentSimEval标准化评估协议（覆盖60名学生、三大领域）。实验证明StudentSim在行为保真度和引导响应性两项指标上均优于GPT-5.4，且作为奖励模型训练出的象棋导师获得专家更高评价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI导师需要针对每个学生的特点进行调整，但从真实学习者收集"哪种指导适合哪个学生"的证据稀疏、缓慢且昂贵。学生模拟器可以作为代理信号，但现有方法存在明显局限：状态跟踪模型无法理解解释或纠正，LLM角色扮演虽然流畅但不匹配所模拟学生的真实能力。

Method: StudentSim采用两阶段训练框架：先对所有学生的数据进行池化训练（pooled training），再针对每个学生进行个体特化（per-student specialization），从而从稀疏的个体数据中构建个性化模拟器。同时提出StudentSimEval标准化评估协议，涵盖象棋、第二语言英语写作和数学三个领域共60名学生，测量行为保真度（F）和引导响应性（R）两项指标。

Result: 在全部三个领域中，StudentSim在两个指标上均优于GPT-5.4。以象棋为例，StudentSim达到F=0.51和R=0.91，而GPT-5.4仅为0.23和0.72，Maia2为0.45和0.27。作为概念验证，将StudentSim作为导师强化学习的奖励模型，训练出的象棋导师在准确性、引导质量和个性化方面均优于无强化学习基线和以GPT-5.4模拟器作为奖励的训练结果，获得专家更高的评分。

Conclusion: StudentSim证明了通过池化训练加个体特化可以有效构建既匹配学生真实反应又能响应教师引导的个性化学生模拟器，为AI导师的开发提供了更可靠的训练信号来源，代码已开源。

Abstract: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. Across all three domains, StudentSim outperforms GPT-5.4 on both metrics. In chess, StudentSim reaches F=0.51 and R=0.91, compared with 0.23 and 0.72 for GPT-5.4 and 0.45 and 0.27 for Maia2. As a proof of concept, using StudentSim as a reward model for tutor reinforcement learning produces a chess tutor that expert humans rate as more accurate, better-guided, and more personalized than a no-RL baseline and a tutor trained against a GPT-5.4 simulator reward. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim.

</details>


### [241] [The Rise of Verbal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01597)
*Kshitij Tayal,Arun Sharma,Genta Indra Winata,Anirban Das,Sambit Sahu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次提出了"言语强化学习"(VRL)的统一框架，将自然语言作为反馈通道来改进语言智能体，并围绕反馈发挥作用的时机和所修改的对象，将其划分为三大支柱：语言作为基础信号、语言作为深思反馈、语言作为学习信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言正日益成为改进语言智能体的重要反馈渠道，能够以人类和模型都能理解的形式传达意图、偏好和因果结构。然而，该领域缺乏统一的理论框架来系统化整理和组织这些不同的研究方向。

Method: 作者围绕单一轴（语言反馈在智能体生命周期中何时生效以及修改什么内容）构建分类体系，将现有工作组织为三大支柱：(1) 语言作为基础信号——语言定义任务本身（目标、状态、奖励结构）；(2) 语言作为深思反馈——测试时引导推理，无需更新模型参数；(3) 语言作为学习信号——基于语言的反馈通过训练塑造模型参数。在每个支柱内综合代表性工作并区分关键子类别。

Result: 提出了一个统一的言语强化学习分类学框架，系统整合了该领域现有工作，揭示了语言在塑造智能体行为中发挥的多种不同角色，并指出了构建更强大、更对齐的智能体所面临的挑战与机遇。

Conclusion: 该分类学展示了言语强化如何重塑智能体开发范式，同时明确了该领域未来的研究挑战和方向，为构建更强大且与人类对齐的语言智能体奠定了基础。

Abstract: Natural language is emerging as a primary feedback channel for improving language agents, capable of conveying intent, preferences, and causal structure in forms interpretable by both humans and modern language models. We call this paradigm Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL) and offer the first unified account of it. We organize the field around a single axis, \textit{when} verbal feedback takes effect in an agent's lifecycle and \textit{what} it modifies, yielding three pillars: (1) \textbf{Language as Grounding Signal}, where language defines the task itself by specifying goals, states, and reward structures; (2) \textbf{Language as Deliberative Feedback}, where natural language guides reasoning at test time without the need to update model parameters; (3) \textbf{Language as Learning Signal}, where language-based feedback shapes model parameters through training. Within each pillar, we synthesize representative work, distinguish key subcategories of approaches, and outline the distinct role language plays in shaping agent behavior. Together, this taxonomy shows how verbal reinforcement is reshaping agent development, while also defining the challenges and opportunities for building more capable and aligned agents.

</details>


### [242] [CordisBench: Can Language Models Reason About Component Lifecycles in Dynamic Agent Harnesses?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01600)
*Damien Sileo,Dimitri Kachler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了CordisBench，一个包含1,200道题目的基准测试，用于评估语言模型在动态agent插件生命周期（依赖关系与清理）推理中的能力。实验显示模型在小规模系统中表现良好，但随着交互数量增加可靠性下降，尽管增加推理努力可带来改善，但成本高昂且可通过有限参考语义避免。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型驱动的动态agent harness允许模型修改影响自身执行的软件，但这种灵活性引入了新的推理负担：局部插件更改可能通过依赖关系和清理操作传播影响。现有基准缺乏对这一生命周期推理能力的系统性评估，因此需要构建一个专门的基准来衡量模型在此场景下的推理能力。

Method: CordisBench将受控的形式化设置与基于Cordis运行时执行的程序相结合，构建了1,200道题目。任务包括：识别受影响组件、预测指定teardown顺序后的状态、判断在全部或部分顺序下成立的条件、以及选择能够成功执行的重配置。论文在三个效率导向模型上以低推理努力进行评测，并使用2到32次相关交互的规模控制以及确定性的任务特定评分。

Result: 模型通常能较好处理小规模系统，但随着相关交互数量的增加，可靠性下降，尤其在预测最终状态和跨teardown顺序推理方面。增加推理努力对部分模型有显著提升。成本方面，GPT-5.6 Luna在16次交互子集上平均每个问题使用近3,000个推理token（中等推理努力）。对于一个独立的有限参考语义，在所有528个可执行问题上与Cordis执行的每次观测和动作结果均一致，表明额外成本是可以避免的。

Conclusion: 动态agent生命周期推理对当前语言模型仍是挑战，尤其在交互增多和跨顺序推理时。虽然增加推理努力能带来收益，但成本不菲，而一个简单的有限参考语义可以提供确定性保证，提示未来的方向应结合可靠的语义执行来辅助模型推理。

Abstract: Dynamic agent harnesses let language models change the software that shapes their own execution. This flexibility brings a new reasoning burden: a local plugin change can propagate through dependencies and cleanup. We introduce CordisBench, a 1,200-question benchmark of this lifecycle reasoning. It combines a controlled formal setting with programs executed against Cordis, a runtime that manages component dependencies and cleanup, and asks models to identify affected components, predict state after a specified teardown order, determine which conditions hold under all or some orders, and choose reconfigurations that succeed when executed. Across these tasks, we evaluate three efficiency-oriented models at low reasoning effort with 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, or 32 relevant interactions, using deterministic task-specific scoring. Models usually handle small systems well but grow less reliable as more interactions become relevant, especially when predicting final state and when reasoning across teardown orders. Additional inference effort recovers marked gains for some models. The cost is nontrivial: on our 16-interaction subset, GPT-5.6 Luna uses nearly 3,000 reasoning tokens per question at medium effort. For these controlled instances, that cost is avoidable: an independent finite reference semantics agrees with Cordis execution on every observation and action outcome used for scoring across all 528 executable questions.

</details>


### [243] [Beyond Scores: Understanding LLM-as-a-Judge Mechanisms in Summarization Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01604)
*Himil Vasava,Ming Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过扰动分类法、受控生成管线和四实验因果分析套件,对LLM评估器(Themis和Prometheus)的NLG质量评分内部机制进行机理解剖,发现其采用两阶段评估管线:低层(layer 15以下)执行局部错误比较并路由至最终输入位置,高层由MLP级联整合信号并写入评分,决策在残差流晚期层结晶。与基础模型对比揭示了微调特有的两个机制(抑制低层MLP贡献、结晶层提前两层),表明微调是在已有基座上"雕刻"而非从零构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评估器被广泛用作评分工具和训练信号,但其内部评分机制仍是一个黑箱,缺乏对其如何进行质量评估的机理性理解,因此需要从机制层面揭开其评分过程的内部运作。

Method: 采用三种方法:(1)八攻击扰动分类法,覆盖可读性和充分性两个NLG质量维度;(2)生成配对干净/损坏摘要的管线,具有受控错误强度和显式token级修改映射;(3)四实验组合:因果追踪、logit-lens词汇投影和注意力头切除,应用于Themis(Llama-3-8B)和Prometheus(Mistral-7B)两个评估器。

Result: 发现两个评估器均采用结构化两阶段评估管线:layer 15以下注意力执行局部错误比较并路由信号到最终位置;其上方MLP级联整合信号并写入评分,决策在Themis的L=26和Prometheus的L=25的尖锐晚期层结晶。Llama-3-8B基础模型复现了路由架构和结晶但缺乏阶段分离,隔离出微调安装的两个机制(抑制最后位置L15以下MLP贡献,结晶深度提前两层),证明微调是雕琢已有基底而非从零构建。

Conclusion: NLG质量LLM评估器存在可解释的两阶段机制化评估管线,微调仅对基础模型既有结构进行定向修改(两个具体机制),而非重新构建评估流程;该发现为理解评估器可靠性及设计更可解释的评估模型提供了理论基础。

Abstract: LLM-based evaluators of natural language generation (NLG) quality are widely deployed as scoring tools and as automated training signals, yet the internal procedure by which they assign a rating remains poorly understood. We investigate this procedure mechanistically through an eight-attack perturbation taxonomy across the Readability and Adequacy dimensions of NLG quality, a generation pipeline that produces paired clean and corrupt summaries with controlled error intensity and explicit token-level modification maps, and a four-experiment battery of causal tracing, logit-lens vocabulary projection, and attention-head knockout applied to Themis (Llama-3-8B) and Prometheus (Mistral-7B). Both evaluators implement a structured, coherent evaluation pipeline operating in two stages: below layer 15, attention performs local error comparison and routes the result to the final input position; above it, the MLP cascade integrates the signal and writes the rating, with the decision crystallizing in the residual stream at a sharp late layer (L = 26 on Themis, L = 25 on Prometheus). Furthermore, a base-model control at the same scale (Llama-3-8B) reproduces the routing architecture and crystallization but not the stage separation, isolating the two mechanisms that fine-tuning specifically installs, suppression of below-L15 MLP contribution at the last position and a two-layer advance of the crystallization depth, indicating that fine-tuning sculpts an existing substrate rather than building the pipeline from scratch. We release the source code and data at https://github.com/himil-v/judge-mech

</details>


<div id='cs.CR'></div>

### [244] [AgentProv: Auditing Agentic LLM API Providers via Tool-use Policy Probes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00052)
*Xun Wang,Bihe Zhao,Michael Backes,Franziska Boenisch,Adam Dziedzic*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出AgentProv，一种基于动作（工具调用）通道的身份审计方法，用于检测商业LLM API中被静默替换或包装的模型，克服了传统基于文本输出通道审计在代理场景下的结构性脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业LLM API声称提供特定基础模型，但实际上游后端可能被静默替换、量化或包装以节省部署成本。现有审计都依赖文本输出通道来判断模型身份，这在代理（agentic）场景下存在根本缺陷：(1) 现代服务栈（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini等）在模型调用工具时只暴露结构化动作而非文本；(2) 提供商注入的系统提示会扭曲文本分布，导致基于文本的测试误报，冤枉诚实的提供商。

Method: AgentProv利用近期agentic后训练将工具使用内化到权重中的特性，通过模型的分类工具调用分布（categorical tool-call distribution）对部署模型进行指纹识别，并使用MMD（最大均值差异）置换检验来判定模型身份。

Result: AgentProv逮获了所有被替换的模型（在630个评估的检查点对上达到100%），同时将系统提示注入下的假阳性率控制在7%（相比之下MET为67%，RUT为53%）。在第三方API端点上，AgentProv与MET的分歧与一个独立的token计数侧信道一致，该侧信道可检测提供商注入的系统提示。

Conclusion: 通过基于动作通道而非文本通道进行身份审计，AgentProv为agentic LLM API提供了更可靠的身份验证方法，对系统提示注入具有更强的鲁棒性，是首个针对proxy场景的动作级身份审计方案。

Abstract: Commercial LLM APIs advertise a specific foundation model, but the served backbone may be silently substituted, quantized, or wrapped, for example to save deployment costs. All existing audits decide backbone identity from the text-output channel, which is structurally fragile for agentic APIs because modern serving stacks (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Cloudflare Workers AI, LangGraph) discard text and expose only structured actions when the model calls a tool, and provider-injected system prompts can distort text distributions enough that text-channel tests falsely accuse honest providers of substituting the claimed model. We observe that recent agentic post-training internalizes tool-use directly into the weights, opening a new audit channel that the serving stack still exposes and that is largely invariant to deployment context. We introduce Agentic Provenance (AgentProv), the first action-based identity audit for agentic LLM APIs: AgentProv fingerprints a deployed model through its categorical tool-call distribution and decides identity via an MMD permutation test. AgentProv catches every substituted model (100% on 630 evaluated checkpoint pairs), while holding the false-positive rate under system-prompt injection at 7% (vs. 67% for MET and 53% for RUT). On third-party API endpoints, AgentProv's disagreements with MET are consistent with an independent token-count side-channel that detects provider-injected system prompts.

</details>


### [245] [A Formal Analysis of Agent Payment Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00060)
*Ke Jiang,Mohan Yu,Yuan Chang,Mohit Kumar Jangid,Jianyu Niu,Cong Wang,Yinqian Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文在Tamarin形式化验证框架中系统分析了四种代理支付协议（x402、MPP、ACP、AP2），通过86个验证案例识别出18个共享安全原则，发现了40个此前未记录的形式一致性缺陷，并通过实现级PoC和可执行追踪验证了关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理支付协议作为自主商务的关键交易层，将用户意图、委托授权、凭证使用、结算和履约分散到多个参与者和阶段，产生了任何单一消息或参与者都无法强制执行的安全依赖。然而这些安全保证在演进中的规范、模式和参考实现中大多仍是隐式的，缺乏系统性的形式化分析。

Method: 作者在Tamarin中形式化了四种代表性代理支付协议（x402、MPP、ACP、AP2），基于代理支付生命周期的通用抽象构建源码支撑模型，捕捉各协议的角色、状态、信任假设和生命周期转换。通过源码支持的验证问题和反例轨迹来暴露缺失的绑定、状态约束和跨阶段对应关系，将发现整合为18个共享安全原则，对每种保留的违规行为构造最小强化参考模型并重新验证预期属性，同时评估x402新发现跨三个实现的表现。

Result: 在86个验证案例中复现了46个已知或校准案例，并识别出40个此前未记录的形式一致性发现。通过三个x402实现的评估和十个代表性发现的实现级PoC、SDK/模式级见证以及覆盖五个安全原则的源码对齐可执行追踪进行了验证。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，委托授权必须与其跨参与者、状态和协议阶段产生的经济和服务效应保持一致，这是代理支付协议安全的关键保障。

Abstract: Agent payment protocols are emerging as a key transaction layer for autonomous commerce, enabling AI agents to purchase goods and services and execute payments on users' behalf. Unlike conventional payment flows, they distribute user intent, delegated authority, credential use, settlement, and fulfillment across multiple actors and stages, creating security dependencies that no single message or participant can enforce. Yet these guarantees remain largely implicit across evolving specifications, schemas, and reference implementations, with little systematic formal analysis.
  We formalize four representative agent payment protocols: x402, MPP, ACP, and AP2 in Tamarin. Using a common abstraction of the agent payment lifecycle, we construct source-grounded models that capture each protocol's roles, state, trust assumptions, and lifecycle transitions. Rather than assuming a complete property taxonomy, we use source-backed verification questions and counterexample traces to expose missing bindings, state constraints, and cross-stage correspondences, consolidating them into 18 shared security principles. Across 86 verification cases, our analysis reproduces 46 known or calibration cases and identifies 40 previously undocumented formal-consistency findings. For each retained violation, we isolate the missing protocol relation, construct a minimally strengthened reference model, and reverify the intended property. We further evaluate the new x402 findings across three implementations and validate ten representative findings through implementation PoCs, SDK/schema-level witnesses, and source-aligned executable traces spanning five security principles. Our results show that delegated authorization must remain consistent with its resulting economic and service effects across actors, states, and protocol stages.

</details>


### [246] [Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Industrial Cybersecurity: A Review of Methods, Operational Integration, and Research Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00171)
*Amr S. Mohamed,Charlotte Fritz,Ahmad Mohammad Saber,Yiqun Ma,Ratinder Kaur,Mohammed Al-Darwbi,Daniela Friedrich,Deepa Kundur*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对工业网络安全中的可解释人工智能（XAI）技术进行了全面综述，重点聚焦于工业安全运营中心（SOC）环境和运营安全工作流程，分析了XAI方法家族（特征归因、代理模型、基于规则的解释和可视化技术）在工业用例中的适用性，并讨论了运营、法规和安全要求以及关键挑战和未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着IT与OT的融合，工业系统的网络攻击面不断扩大，AI/ML技术被广泛应用于工业SOC中以增强威胁检测与响应。然而，这些AI系统的"黑盒"决策过程缺乏透明度，给运营信任、法规合规和事件响应带来了挑战。因此，需要引入XAI来提升AI驱动网络安全系统的可解释性和透明度。

Method: 采用系统性综述方法，从多个维度进行分析：(1) 考察AI在工业SOC工作流程中的作用及所利用的运营数据类型；(2) 梳理XAI主要方法家族，包括特征归因方法、代理模型、基于规则的解释和可视化技术；(3) 分析这些方法对工业用例的适用性；(4) 讨论区别于传统IT环境的运营、法规和安全要求。

Result: 识别了工业环境中XAI应用面临的关键挑战，包括标注数据集的稀缺、模型可靠性问题、可解释性与性能之间的权衡、以及将XAI工具集成到SOC工作流程中的困难。同时指出了工业系统与传统IT环境在运营、法规和安全要求上的差异性。

Conclusion: 提出了开放研究方向和未来机遇，强调需要开发可信赖的、运营可行的、面向工业特定领域的XAI赋能网络安全解决方案，以推动工业环境下AI驱动安全系统的落地与信任建立。

Abstract: The increasing digitalization of industrial infrastructure and the convergence of information technology (IT) and operational technology (OT) have expanded the cyberattack surface of industrial systems. To address the growing complexity of cyber threats, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) techniques are increasingly deployed within industrial cybersecurity operations, particularly in Security Operations Centers (SOCs). While these approaches improve anomaly detection, threat analysis, and automated response, their opaque decision-making presents challenges for operational trust, regulatory compliance, and incident response. EXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has emerged as a promising paradigm to improve the transparency and interpretability of AI-driven cybersecurity systems and decisions. This paper provides a comprehensive review of XAI techniques in industrial cybersecurity, focusing on industrial SOC environments and operational security workflows. We examine the role of AI in industrial SOC workflows, the types of operational data leveraged in industrial environments, and the benefits and limitations of AI-based threat detection. We then review major families of XAI approaches, including feature attribution methods, surrogate models, rule-based explanations, and visualization techniques, and analyze their applicability to industrial use cases. We further discuss the operational, regulatory, and safety requirements that distinguish industrial systems from traditional IT environments. Key challenges are examined, including limited labeled datasets, model reliability, explainability-performance tradeoffs, and the integration of XAI tools into SOC workflows. Finally, we identify open research directions and opportunities for developing trustworthy, operationally viable, and domain-specific XAI-enabled cybersecurity solutions for industrial environments.

</details>


### [247] [DUPIN: Attack Learning Is Still Needed! Demonstrating Few-Shot after Unsupervised Pretraining Is A Nimble Forensics Learner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00259)
*Chanwoo Bae,Hailun Ding,Shiqing Ma,Xiangyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: DUPIN是一种基于学习的新型攻击取证方法，在大量审计事件（来自来源图）上进行无监督预训练，然后通过少量带标签的攻击示例进行少样本微调，以提升检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于学习的攻击取证方法依赖大量标注数据，而真实场景中标注攻击样本稀缺且昂贵。作者希望利用海量易获取的未标注审计日志，通过预训练加少样本学习的方式降低对标注数据的依赖，提升APT攻击检测的可扩展性和实用性。

Method: DUPIN采用两阶段学习框架：(1) 在来源图形式上的大量审计事件上进行无监督预训练（覆盖38-52天的审计日志，共7.3TB数据）；(2) 少样本学习阶段，仅使用少量带标签的攻击样例进行微调，以增强检测能力。

Result: 在25个APT攻击活动、跨四个不同数据源的评估中，DUPIN相比多种基线方法展现出优异性能，并支持规模化评估。

Conclusion: DUPIN通过大规模无监督预训练结合少样本微调，有效解决了攻击取证中标注数据稀缺问题，实现了规模化、可扩展的APT攻击检测。

Abstract: We propose a novel approach to learning-based attack forensics called DUPIN. DUPIN performs unsupervised pre-training on an enormous amount of audit events in the form of provenance graphs. It then proceeds to a few-shot learning stage, leveraging a small number of labeled attack examples to fine-tune its detection capabilities. We pretrain DUPIN on up to 38 - 52 days of audit logs (7.3TB total) and evaluate it against various baselines on 25 APT campaigns across four different data sources, facilitating the scalable evaluation.

</details>


### [248] [Delegation Without Trust: An Empirical Gap Analysis of Identity, Authorization, and Runtime Governance in Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00267)
*Panduranga Sai Varma Dantuluri,Jyotirmoy Sundi*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出自治LLM代理必须在不信任模型（untrusted-model）假设下评估安全，并给出了多代理委托的安全威胁模型、八项安全需求、现有框架缺陷分析，以及一个能封堵所有威胁的授权代理（authorization broker）实现，已在VotalAI的LLM Shield中生产落地。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自治LLM代理日益代表用户持有凭证、调用工具并派生子代理，而驱动代理的组件是可被对手劫持的语言模型，传统分布式系统中的授权问责问题因此变得紧迫且基本未解决。现有系统的授权通常把关在模型内部或依赖宽泛的bearer凭证，无法对抗提示注入，亟需从系统层面重构授权模型。

Method: 作者（1）构建以四种对手为核心的威胁模型——confused deputy、token theft与replay、prompt-injection权限提升、被攻陷子代理，并推导出治理代理系统必须满足的八项安全需求；（2）实测默认代理运行时及LangGraph、CrewAI、AutoGen和MCP四种广泛框架，验证现状缺口；（3）实现一个授权代理（authorization broker）作为治理边界，通过集中式授权决策、最小权限、令牌加固等机制封堵威胁，并进行对抗性评估。

Result: 默认运行时在四种威胁下全部失守；四种框架中三种无内置隔离、一种仅部分覆盖，现有标准无法满足全部八项需求。所实现的授权代理封堵全部四种威胁，承受11次直接攻击而不失守，拒绝20万伪令牌中0通过，在2000个随机场景中将受陷子代理可达操作从8100个压至均值1.5个，且每次决策仅约2.6微秒，相对模型推理可忽略。原理已在VotalAI的LLM Shield中生产实现。

Conclusion: LLM代理的安全必须以不信任模型为前提，即让完全被提示注入的代理也无法超出被显式委托的权限。通过将授权从模型内部剥离为独立的系统级代理并能以微秒级成本执行，可以同时达成强大的对抗安全与可忽略的性能开销，且该方案已具备生产可行性。

Abstract: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly act on a user's behalf: they hold credentials, call tools and services, and spawn sub-agents that act further on their behalf. This turns a long-standing distributed-systems question -- who is authorized to do what, on whose authority -- into an urgent and largely unsolved problem, because the component driving each agent is a language model an adversary can hijack. We argue that agent security must be evaluated under an untrusted-model assumption: a correct system is one in which a fully prompt-injected agent still cannot exceed the authority explicitly delegated to it. Against this standard we make three contributions. First, we give a threat model for multi-agent delegation centered on four adversaries -- confused deputy, token theft and replay, prompt-injection privilege escalation, and compromised sub-agents -- and derive eight security requirements a governed agent system must meet. Second, we show the gap is real: a default agent runtime modeling common practice (broad bearer credentials, authorization gated inside the model) fails all four threats, and across four widely used frameworks -- LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) authorization model -- three provide no built-in confinement and one only partial; no existing standard alone covers the requirement set. Third, we implement and adversarially evaluate an authorization broker that closes the gap. It blocks all four threats; it resists 11 direct attacks on its design and accepts 0 of 200,000 forged tokens; it confines a compromised sub-agent to its delegated task (a mean of 1.5 reachable actions versus all 8,100 under bearer delegation, across 2,000 randomized scenarios); and it enforces at microsecond cost (about 2.6 microseconds per decision), negligible against model inference. These principles are also realized in production in VotalAI's LLM Shield.

</details>


### [249] [Workload Identification with Physical Side Channels for AI Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00309)
*Simone Gargiulo,Gabriel Kulp*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文展示外部观察者可通过测量NVIDIA H200 GPU的物理功耗（~10 MHz采样）来识别其运行的工作负载类别，在930条五秒真实轨迹上以97%准确率区分训练与推理及非AI计算，并针对对抗性规避策略（如LoRA稀释）进行了检测器加固测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI计算验证是国际AI治理政策中首批切实可行的切入点，但监管机构需要在不依赖运营商配合的情况下判断前沿实验室的计算使用是否符合协议。传统的片上NVML遥测可被伪造或重放，因此需要一种独立可观测的物理信道来验证GPU工作负载类别。

Method: 作者在NVIDIA H200上以约10 MHz采样率记录930条五秒功耗轨迹，覆盖17个开源LLM家族和25种非AI工作负载。通过分析功耗频谱特征（AI工作负载频谱能量主要低于~20kHz，训练可通过内存瓶颈的优化器更新识别），训练分类器区分训练、推理和非AI计算。随后将GPU操作者视为对抗方，设计了四种规避策略（包括稀释LoRA），生成680条对抗轨迹，并采用留出策略的加固检测器进行测试。

Result: 在未见过的模型家族上，区分训练/推理/非AI计算准确率达97%，宏平均F1分数为0.955。加固检测器对四种规避策略中的三种能以≥99%的检出率捕获训练，第四种（稀释LoRA）检出率为48%-88%，加入额外救援规则后可提升至≥98%。

Conclusion: 研究表明物理功耗信道可以独立于运营商合作地对GPU工作负载类别进行可靠验证，为AI治理提供了首个具有对抗鲁棒性的验证手段。虽然对抗评估尚不全面，但提供了初始洞见和可用于开发更强规避机制的数据集。

Abstract: AI compute verification is one of the first tangible and tractable points for international policy aimed at AI governance. Determining whether frontier labs, or any operator, comply with agreements requires the regulating authority to discern how their compute is used. The elementary building block of AI compute is the GPU, and any activity it executes leaves a physical trace. Here, we show that an external observer can identify the class of the workload running on an NVIDIA H200 from its power draw. Unlike on-chip NVML telemetry, which can be spoofed or replayed, such a physical channel can in principle be observed independently of operator cooperation. We recorded $930$ five-second traces at $\sim 10$ MHz, covering seventeen open LLM families and twenty-five non-AI workloads. Over this corpus we separate training from inference and from non-AI computation with an accuracy of $97\%$ and a macro-averaged F1 score of $0.955$, evaluated on model families unseen during training. AI workload spectral content predominantly lies below $\sim 20$kHz and training is particularly recognizable through the memory-bound optimizer update. The GPU operator is then treated as adversarial and able to reshape the physical computation itself. Four evasion strategies are tested to disguise training as inference, producing an additional 680 adversarial traces. A detector hardened against evasion strategies, with the tested strategy held out, catches training $\geq 99\%$ of the time for three of the four strategies. The fourth, diluted low-rank adaptation (LoRA), is detected $48$--$88\%$ of the time with a hardened classifier, rising to $\geq 98\%$ with an additional rescue rule. While these attacks are not a comprehensive evaluation against adversarial behaviour, they offer initial insights beyond genuine activities and a dataset for developing and testing stronger evasion mechanisms.

</details>


### [250] [A Version Space Approach for Digital Circuit Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00609)
*Mitchell A. Thornton*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的"版本空间"计数方法，应用于两个看似无关的数字电路分析问题：概率组合等价性检验（基于修改Haar谱系数计数布尔函数）和逻辑锁定网表的密钥计数（基于门级因子图计数与预言机查询一致的密钥）。方法核心是重参数化为块和，将嵌套系数间的依赖转化为局部性，通过求和-乘积递推在多项式时间内精确计算幸存函数/密钥数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多数字电路问题具有相同结构：隐藏对象与观测一致，需要计数存活的候选者并决定下一个观测。2002年提出的概率组合等价性检验方法仅解决了两个特例，一般情形需要指数级枚举；逻辑锁定密钥计数也面临同样的计数困境。作者意图证明这两个问题本质上是同一个方法，并闭合2002年遗留的开放问题。

Method: 将候选（布尔函数或密钥）视为版本空间，观测（谱系数或预言机响应）逐步移除候选。关键创新是将问题重参数化为块和（block sums），把嵌套系数间的依赖转换成局部结构，从而可用求和-乘积（sum-product）递推在多项式时间内精确计数幸存函数。对单元系数、系数对及所有祖先闭集推导出封闭形式，并将2002年工作中独立性近似的误差表达为可计算的格指标。

Result: 所有公式均通过穷举枚举验证，并复现了2002年的实验表格。在第二个应用中，同样的递推在门级因子图上运行，对TrustHub混淆发布集的七十个实例，每次存活的熵都低于广告声称的密钥长度。

Conclusion: 两个应用本质上是同一个方法：见证者提供观测，每个观测移除候选，版本空间被精确计数。这在理论上闭合了2002年留下的一般情形计数问题，在实践中也统一了概率等价性检验与逻辑锁定密钥分析这两个研究领域。

Abstract: Many questions about a digital circuit take the same form. A hidden object is consistent with a set of observations, and one wants to know how many remain consistent and which observation to make next. The set of surviving candidates is the version space, and its size, on a logarithmic scale, measures how much the observations have settled. This paper develops the version-space view as one method and applies it to two circuit-analysis problems usually treated as unrelated. The first is probabilistic combinational equivalence checking, where the candidates are Boolean functions and the observations are modified-Haar spectral coefficients. A method proposed in 2002 posed this counting problem and solved only two special cases, leaving the general case an enumeration exponential in the number of observations. We close it. A reparameterization onto block sums turns the dependence among nested coefficients into locality, a sum--product recursion counts the surviving functions exactly in time polynomial in the truth-table size, closed forms follow for a single coefficient, a coefficient pair, and every ancestor-closed set, and the error of the independence approximation the 2002 work resorted to equals a computable lattice index. Every formula is checked against exhaustive enumeration and reproduces the 2002 tables. The second application is key counting for logic-locked netlists, where the candidates are keys and the observations are oracle responses. The same recursion, run over the gate-level factor graph, computes the number of keys still consistent with a set of queries; across seventy instances of the TrustHub obfuscation release the surviving entropy falls below the advertised key length every time. The two applications are one method: a witness supplies observations, each removes candidates, and the version space is counted exactly.

</details>


### [251] [OreProof: Verifiable Provenance with Limited Disclosure for Critical-Minerals Supply Chains Using Zero-Knowledge Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00340)
*Oleksandr Hrabar,Hossein Arshadi Soufiani,Henry M. Kim,Chien-Chih Chen,Ali Vazirizadeh,Hjalmar Turesson*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文报告了一项设计科学研究OreProof——一个面向关键矿产（以黄金为实例）的可追溯性平台原型。该平台通过混合链上/链下数据模型、Groth16零知识证明、Merkle批量锚定管道及UNTP对齐的可验证凭证，在公共zkEVM测试网上解决了"可验证性与披露意愿"之间的结构性矛盾。实验表明，相比透明基线，可推断的机密属性从四类中的三类降至零，同时批量锚定大幅提升吞吐量。文章贡献包括原型工件和四项初始设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关键矿产供应链存在结构性张力：监管方与买家要求可验证的溯源信息，但上游参与者不愿披露供应商身份、品位/产量和价格等敏感数据，而这些数据看似是验证所必需的。作者旨在解决这一"可验证性—披露"权衡问题。

Method: 采用设计科学研究方法，构建OreProof原型：针对黄金供应链，设计混合on-chain/off-chain数据模型实现链上/链下分层存储；利用Groth16零知识证明实现选择性披露；采用Merkle批量锚定管道优化上链吞吐；在公共zkEVM测试网上签发符合UNTP标准的可验证凭证。以此验证零知识证明在保障可验证性的同时最小化机密属性泄露。

Result: 在定义攻击者模型下，与透明基线相比，可直接推断的机密属性从四类中的三类降至零；批量锚定显著提升了系统吞吐量。证明技术能有效保障可验证性的同时压低敏感信息泄露风险。

Conclusion: 作者提出四项初步设计原则：(1) 对承诺数据做证明而非直接暴露原始数据；(2) 仅对可验证的来源签发凭证，对混合类商品标注未知输入；(3) 从一开始就签发符合标准的可验证凭证；(4) 按供应链角色划分披露权限。这些原则指引未来可追溯性平台在合规验证与上游披露意愿之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Critical-minerals supply chains face a structural tension: regulators and buyers demand verifiable provenance, yet upstream actors are hesitant to disclose supplier identities, assay grades/yields, and prices that verification appears to require. We report a design science account of OreProof, a prototypical traceability platform addressing this verifiability-disclosure trade-off. Instantiated for gold, OreProof combines a hybrid on-chain/off-chain data model, Groth16 zero-knowledge proofs for selective disclosure, a Merkle-batched anchoring pipeline, and UNTP-aligned verifiable credentials on a public zkEVM testnet. Against a transparent baseline, directly inferable confidential attributes fell from three of four categories to none under a defined attacker model, while batched anchoring substantially improved throughput. Our contributions are the artifact prototype as well as four nascent design principles: prove over committed data rather than exposing it; credential only verifiable origin and flag unknown inputs for blended commodities; emit standards-aligned credentials from the outset; and partition disclosure by supply-chain role.

</details>


### [252] [JENGA: Exploiting Counter-Based RowHammer Countermeasures to Break Real-Time Predictability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01077)
*Valentin Abgrall,Marcello Traiola,Ruben Salvador,Maria Méndez Real,Alessandro Palumbo,Angeliki Kritikakou*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文研究RowHammer硬件计数器缓解措施（以PRAC为例）对实时系统最坏情况执行时间（WCET）的影响，提出名为JENGA的攻击使受害者任务执行时间超出预期WCET达200%，并推导出考虑缓解延迟的安全分析边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RowHammer安全漏洞催生了多种硬件和软件缓解措施，但这些防御的效果通常以平均性能评估，这对安全关键实时系统是不够的——此类系统最关心最坏情况行为。现有研究缺失RowHammer缓解措施对WCET影响的系统性分析。

Method: 以DDR5标准化的Per-Row-Activation-Counter（PRAC）为案例，分析其对实时任务时序行为的影响；提出JENGA攻击，利用攻击者控制的任伤操纵RowHammer计数机制内部状态以延长受害者任务执行时间；在gem5和Ramulator 2.0仿真环境中实现JENGA，并推导安全分析边界以将缓解诱导延迟纳入WCET分析。

Result: 在TACLeBench工作负载上的评估表明，JENGA攻击可使任务延迟达其WCET的200%，导致初始时间安全假设失效；据此推导了适用于受硬件计数器保护的DRAM系统（如PRAC-N）的WCET安全分析界限。

Conclusion: RowHammer缓解机制本身可被利用来破坏实时系统的时间可预测性，必须在WCET分析中显式考虑此类缓解诱导延迟，才能保障安全关键实时系统的端到端安全性。

Abstract: Safety-critical real-time systems must satisfy multiple dependability requirements, notably time predictability and security. In such systems, tasks must complete within bounded and known execution times, typically characterised through Worst-Case Execution Time (WCET) analysis. At the same time, DRAM-based platforms are increasingly sensitive to the RowHammer read-disturbance security vulnerability, which has motivated the development of numerous hardware and software countermeasures in both academia and industry. However, the impact of these defences is generally evaluated in terms of average-case performance, a metric that is insufficient for safetycritical real-time systems, where worst-case behaviour is the primary concern. In this paper, we study the impact of RowHammer countermeasures based on hardware counters on the timing behaviour of real-time systems. We use a Per-Row-Activation-Counter (PRAC) countermeasure as a case study, standardised for recent DDR5 memories, and show that it can introduce significant timing variations. Based on this observation, we introduce JENGA, an attack in which an attacker-controlled task manipulates the internal state of the RowHammer countermeasure mechanism to increase the execution time of a victim real-time task beyond its expected WCET. We implement JENGA in a gem5 and Ramulator 2.0 simulation environment and evaluate its impact on TACLeBench workloads. We show that such an attack can delay tasks up to 200% of their WCET, making the initial timesafety assumptions unsafe. To address this issue, we derive a safe analytical bound that accounts for mitigation-induced delays in WCET analysis for DRAM systems protected by hardware countermeasures, such as PRAC-N.

</details>


### [253] [NeuroPriv: Adversarial Representation Learning for Privacy in Wearable EEG Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00390)
*Sarmistha Sarna Gomasta,Bhawana Chhaglani,Prashant Shenoy*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文以EEGMAT为例，展示了可穿戴EEG系统中常用的紧凑频谱/空间特征不仅能支持认知任务分类（平衡准确率0.788），还会泄露参与者性别（0.858）、年龄（0.789）和身份（0.692）等敏感信息，威胁神经隐私。通过隐私感知表征学习，可将任务性能保持在0.781的同时，将性别、年龄和身份推断准确率分别降至0.563、0.467和0.206。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴EEG系统用于认知监测和神经评估等应用时，通常假设仅传输紧凑的频谱或空间特征而非原始EEG信号即可提供足够的隐私保护。然而该假设未经验证，这些紧凑特征可能仍会泄露大量敏感信息，对用户的神经隐私构成实质性风险。

Method: 以EEGMAT作为典型案例，对紧凑EEG特征进行认知状态分类以及性别、年龄和主体身份推断测试；随后采用隐私感知表征学习（privacy-aware representation learning）来在保持任务性能的同时降低敏感属性推断的可行性，并进行显式的隐私审计。

Result: 紧凑EEG特征在认知状态分类上达到0.788的平衡准确率，但同时分别以0.858、0.789和0.692的平衡准确率泄露性别、年龄和身份信息。经隐私感知表征学习后，任务性能保持0.781，而性别、年龄、身份推断准确率分别降至0.563、0.467和0.206。

Conclusion: 可穿戴EEG系统即使只传输紧凑特征也存在显著的隐私泄露风险，需要采用目的受限（purpose-limited）的表示方法并对神经健康系统进行明确的隐私审计，以保障用户神经隐私。

Abstract: Wearable EEG systems may expose sensitive information beyond their intended health function, creating substantial risks to neuroprivacy. In this work, we show that commonly used EEG features can reveal participant identity and demographic attributes in addition to supporting the intended cognitive task. Wearable EEG is increasingly being explored for cognitive monitoring, neurological assessment, and longitudinal digital-health applications, yet many systems assume that transmitting compact spectral or spatial features instead of raw EEG provides sufficient privacy protection. Using EEGMAT as a motivating case study, we find that compact EEG features achieve a balanced accuracy of 0.788 for cognitive-state classification while enabling gender, age, and subject-identity inference with balanced accuracies of 0.858, 0.789, and 0.692, respectively. We further show that privacy-aware representation learning preserves task performance at 0.781 while reducing these inference accuracies to 0.563, 0.467, and 0.206. These findings motivate purpose-limited representations and explicit privacy auditing in wearable neurohealth systems.

</details>


### [254] [Federated Trust for Embodied Robot Capability Marketplaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00404)
*Xue Qin,Simin Luan,Cong Yang,Zhijun Li*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"联邦信任"（federated trust）模型，作为机器人技能市场（robot capability marketplaces）中软件包安全验证的替代方案。与集中式PKI（单一证书权威、单一透明度日志）不同，每个部署的bridge维护本地信任目录，使用Ed25519分离签名信封和SSH风格信任文件进行安装时本地集合成员检查。系统实现了运行时治理层，包含CLI、注册表服务器、每bridge安装门禁和80个测试，在5000次对抗试验中严格模式拒绝100%的恶意发布者、篡改、伪造和撤销签名者攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人技能市场（机器人技能的"应用商店"）正成为LLM驱动机器人机群的部署载体。默认的云原生"此包是否安全安装？"答案是集中式PKI：单一证书权威、单一透明度日志、单一信任根。作者论证这对具身机器人机群是错误模型，因为其面临异构监管制度、气隙（air-gapped）部署、极小的操作者人手规模，以及信任错误发布者会带来物理世界后果。

Method: 提出联邦信任模型：每个已部署的bridge维护自己的本地信任目录（可接受的签名者）；签名者用嵌入在分离的Ed25519签名信封中的公钥标识自己；安装时验证是本地集合成员检查而非对证书权威的网络往返。密码学原语刻意使用标准方案（Ed25519分离签名和SSH风格信任文件），贡献在于架构承诺——这种组合特别适配具身机器人机群。实现包括：五子命令CLI、注册表服务器、每bridge安装门禁及80个测试。

Result: 多部署评估表明：相同注册表流在不同信任目录的bridge上产生发散性的安装裁决（这是设计的关键属性）。在5000次对抗试验中，严格模式门禁拒绝100%的恶意发布者、篡改、伪造和撤销签名者攻击，并在最小版本固定扩展下拒绝96.6%的降级尝试。同硬件对比Sigstore-Cosign和python-TUF，联邦信任的每次验证成本处于两者之间，每发布者存储占用低于两者。

Conclusion: 集中式PKI不适合具身机器人机群的安全验证场景。联邦信任通过本地信任目录和标准密码学原语的组合，提供了适合异构监管、气隙部署和小规模运营的现实模型，既保证了强大的安全性能（严格模式几乎完全拒绝所有攻击向量），又具有优于现有方案的资源效率。

Abstract: Robot capability marketplaces, the "app store for robot skills," are emerging as the deployment vector for LLM-driven robot fleets. The default cloud-native answer to "is this package safe to install?" is centralised PKI: one certificate authority, one transparency log, one root of trust. We argue this is the wrong model for embodied robot fleets, where operators face heterogeneous regulatory regimes, air-gapped deployments, tiny operator headcounts, and physical-world consequences for trusting the wrong publisher. We present federated trust: each deployed bridge maintains its own local trust directory of acceptable signers; signers identify themselves with a public key embedded in a detached Ed25519 signature envelope; install-time verification is a local set-membership check rather than a network round trip to a certificate authority. The cryptographic primitives are deliberately standard (Ed25519 detached signatures and SSH-style trust files); the contribution is the architectural commitment that this composition fits embodied robot fleets specifically. We implement the model in a runtime governance layer with a five-subcommand CLI, a registry server, a per-bridge install gate, and 80 tests. A multi-deployment evaluation shows the same registry stream producing divergent install verdicts on bridges with different trust directories, the load-bearing design property. Across 5000 adversarial trials, the strict-mode gate rejects 100% of rogue-publisher, tampered, forged, and revoked-signer attacks, and 96.6% of downgrade attempts under a minimum-version pin extension. A same-hardware comparison against Sigstore-Cosign and python-TUF locates federated trust's per-verify cost between the two and its per-publisher storage footprint below both.

</details>


### [255] [Don't Trust the Code, Check Its Effects: Runtime Refinement for Regenerated Systems Code Under an Adversarial Generator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00430)
*Jinhao Hu,Ashvin Goel,Laurent Bindschaedler*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文针对不可逆系统代码（如设备驱动）的再生场景，提出通过固定可信中介者（mediator）而非再生成的代码来持有所有效果的权威性，使生成的代码只做规划而无法直接执行操作，从而在不信任生成器的情况下保证安全。作者通过参考监视器的实例化，定义了"可中介性包络"（mediability envelope）的六个条件来刻画这种中介是否可行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作利用LLM从规范生成系统代码，将实现视为可丢弃的、可按需再生的工件。但这类工作存在于"宽恕性"（forgiving）环境中——组件的外部可观察效果可恢复、生成器是诚实的，可通过重执行来验证信任。本文转向"不可宽恕"（unforgiving）环境：效果不可逆（如设备写命令）、生成器可能具有对抗性，此时事后重执行无法校验效果，且证明在假设不成立时会静默失败。

Method: 核心立场是拒绝赋予生成的代码执行任何效果的权威。生成的代码仅负责规划（planning），而一个固定的可信中介者（mediator）拥有所有效果的所有权，仅当规范原本会产生该效果时才执行之。由于保证依赖于中介者而非生成代码，因此该保证在代码再生后依然成立。作者将这一方案实例化为再生成设备驱动程序的参考监视器（reference monitor），并提出六个条件刻画"可中介性包络"：可读性（legibility）、规范输入可观测性（spec-input observability）、可关联性（correlatability）、完备性（completeness）、结果可枚举性（outcome enumerability）以及显式持久性（explicit durability），这六个条件共同决定中介方式是否可行。

Result: 本文的主要成果是提出了一个在对抗性生成器与不可逆效果环境下的安全架构框架，并通过参考监视器的形式实现确保安全保证独立于再生成的代码本身。所定义的六个条件为评估和判定"可中介性"提供了可操作的判据体系。

Conclusion: 在不可宽恕环境中，唯一安全的方式是剥夺生成代码的执行权威，将效果执行权集中于固定可信的中间层。这种信任模型保证了安全属性在代码不断再生成的过程中持续有效，而可中介性包络中的六个条件则界定了此类安全中介可行的边界。

Abstract: Recent work uses large language models to generate systems code from specifications, treating the specification as the durable artifact and the implementation as disposable. Regenerating the implementation specializes it to each workload and device. However, that work lives in a forgiving setting: a component's externally visible effects, its writes and device commands, are recoverable, and the generator is honest, so trust is discharged by re-execution. We target the unforgiving setting: systems code whose effects are irreversible, produced by a generator that may be adversarial. There, re-execution cannot check an effect after the fact, and a proof fails silently when its assumptions do. We take the position that the only safe way to operate here is to deny the generated code the authority to act. The generated code only plans, while a fixed trusted mediator owns every effect and performs one only when the specification would have produced it. Because the guarantee lives in the mediator, not the code, it survives regeneration. We instantiate this as a reference monitor for regenerated device drivers, and characterize the mediability envelope, six conditions on the effect vocabulary: legibility, spec-input observability, correlatability, completeness, outcome enumerability, and explicit durability. They decide when such mediation is possible.

</details>


### [256] [Capability-Gated Language Models: Security Composes, Utility Does Not](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00445)
*Patrikas Vanagas,Augustas Mačijauskas,Laurynas Lopata*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出"能力门控部署"(capability-gated deployment)概念，在单一权重集内实现按主体(principal)的访问控制，通过稀疏秩门控(sparse rank gating)基于嵌套因子分解机制实例化，配置构成格结构（meet累积限制、join合并权限）。安全属性可组合（在单调启发假设下可证），但效用属性不可组合（无害画像组合会导致保留率与流畅度损伤，且不存在组合界）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署的LLM安全防护（安全微调、过滤、遗忘）在权重之外按主体差异化：不同过滤器、分层、制品版本；但在单一权重集内，每个请求都面对相同的模型配置。作者希望将按主体的访问控制内化到一组权重中，实现细粒度的、可组合的权限管理。

Method: 1. 定义能力门控部署：在一组权重内实现按主体的访问控制，配置构成格（lattice）——meet累积限制、join合并联盟权限；2. 用稀疏秩门控在现有嵌套因子分解机制上实例化；3. 使用单遍归因(one-pass attribution)引导画像搜索；4. 所有结果从预先登记的held-out划分中一次性读取；5. 安全组合性在单调启发(monotone-elicitation)假设下逐点证伪验证。

Result: 在两个谱系(lineages)中，中位held-out meet加深了抑制(suppression)；经多重检验校正后仍存活的效应更强。安全属性可组合（meet下可证）；但效用属性不可组合——单独无害的画像组合后会导致保留率(retention)和流畅度(fluency)损伤，且不存在组合上限界。

Conclusion: 安全(security)在能力门控部署下是可组合的，但效用(utility)不具备可组合性：能力门控可以实现可证明的安全组合，而效用损失会随画像组合无界累积，这对实际部署中画像的选取与组合策略提出了警示与约束。

Abstract: Deployed language model safeguards (safety fine-tuning, filtering, unlearning) vary by principal only outside the model weights: filters are reconfigured, tiers are multiplied, and artefacts are reissued; inside one set of weights every request meets the same model configuration. This motivates us to define capability-gated deployment: per-principal access control inside one set of weights, whose configurations form a lattice - meets accumulate a principal's restrictions and joins pool a coalition's reach. We instantiate it by sparse rank gating over an existing nested-factorisation mechanism, guide profile search with one-pass attribution, and read every result once from a pre-registered held-out split. Security composes: provably at meets under a monotone-elicitation assumption we falsify pointwise. In two lineages the median held-out meet deepens suppression; the one effect surviving correction strengthens it. Utility does not: individually harmless profiles can compose to retention and fluency damage, and no compositional bound exists.

</details>


### [257] [Does Reasoning Mitigate Backdoor Attacks? A Neuro-Symbolic Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00464)
*Marco Antonio Corallo,Andrea Agiollo,Mauro Conti,Alberto Giaretta*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地评估了神经符号（NeSy）AI模型在后门攻击下的对抗鲁棒性，通过对比DeepProbLog框架与基线神经网络在8种后门设置和4个推理任务下的表现，发现NeSy模型虽然在平均意义上比纯神经网络更鲁棒，但其鲁棒性高度依赖于推理过程的严格性及其与攻击目标的兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经符号AI作为新兴的可信AI范式，其神经-符号集成过程常被视为"天然鲁棒"（robust-by-design），但其对抗安全性（特别是后门攻击）尚未被系统研究。神经与符号集成带来的额外复杂度可能构成新的攻击入口，因此需要对NeSy模型的对抗鲁棒性进行深入调查。

Method: 作者进行了首个针对NeSy模型的后门攻击系统性评估：以最流行的NeSy框架DeepProbLog为代表，与基线神经网络进行对比，涵盖8种后门攻击设置和4种推理任务，通过严格控制推理过程的严格性变量来考察其对鲁棒性的影响。

Result: 实验结果表明：NeSy模型在平均意义上确实比纯神经网络对手更鲁棒，但鲁棒性并非普遍成立——它在很大程度上取决于推理过程的严格程度以及该推理机制与所选对抗攻击目标的兼容性，二者不匹配时NeSy的鲁棒优势会显著下降。

Conclusion: NeSy模型并非天然免疫后门攻击，其鲁棒性受推理约束和攻击目标匹配度的显著影响。该研究填补了NeSy对抗安全评估的空白，并开源了实验代码以供复现和后续研究。

Abstract: Neuro-Symbolic (NeSy) AI has recently emerged as a novel paradigm to enable trustworthy AI, aiming at integrating sub-symbolic neural perception with grounded symbolic reasoning. The neuro-symbolic integration process that characterizes these models has been proven beneficial to achieve more transparent, explainable and efficient AI systems. Meanwhile, their properties under adversarial settings have been overlooked being frequently deemed robust-by-design. However, the neural-symbolic integration process they leverage constitutes an additional layer of complexity that may provide an attack entry-point. Therefore, in this paper, we claim that an in-depth investigation of the adversarial robustness of NeSy models is necessary and provide the first systematic evaluation of backdoor attacks against NeSy. To this end, we compare the most popular NeSy framework, namely DeepProbLog, against baseline neural networks across a total of eight backdoor settings and four reasoning tasks. Our experimental results show that while NeSy models are indeed more robust than their neural counterpart on average, their robustness vastly depend on the strictness of the reasoning process being enforced and its compatibility with the chosen adversarial target. The source code to reproduce our experiments is made available at https://github.com/marcoantoniocorallo/NeSy-Backdoor.

</details>


### [258] [GlitchLab: A Hardware-in-the-Loop Optimizer for Physical Fault Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00502)
*Tanvir Hossain,Abhinav Mahadevan,Jasper Van Woudenberg,Rajesh Velegalati,Arindam Bhattacharyya*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出GlitchLab，一个在线硬件在环（hardware-in-the-loop）故障注入平台，并设计了两种基于强化学习/结构化搜索的策略（RL-Q和SOBAS），分别用于故障发现与复现。在AES、密码和控制系统流三类目标中，两种策略均能成功找到目标故障，相比基线方法大幅减少尝试次数和耗时，且故障复现率和设置多样性显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理故障注入可将短暂的硬件扰动转化为密钥恢复、认证绕过或意外控制流等严重安全失效。然而，由于交互参数众多导致搜索空间庞大、有效故障设置稀疏且因目标而异、每次硬件尝试反馈有限，发现有效故障十分困难。在固定测试时间下，高效搜索对于评估故障敏感性至关重要，因此亟需更高效的自动搜索方法。

Method: GlitchLab平台将延迟视为时序门控（timing gate），将电压和脉冲宽度作为严重性控制参数，并将硬件结果转化为结构化反馈。在此平台上实现了两种策略：(1) RL-Q，基于Q学习的强化学习策略；(2) 结构化奖励（structured bandit）用于故障发现；(3) SOBAS（Structured-Outcome-Based Adaptive Search），一种基于模型的策略用于故障复现。

Result: 在AES、密码和控制系统流的所有攻击活动中，两种策略均找到了目标故障。在AES和控制系统流场景下，所需尝试次数减少2-85倍，耗时减少26-1,237倍；在密码场景中，两种方法在5,000次尝试内均成功，而基线方法失败。故障发现后，SOBAS的故障复现率提高7.3-21倍，RL-Q识别出的不同AES设置多出30%。

Conclusion: GlitchLab及其两种搜索策略显著提升了硬件故障注入搜索的效率和可靠性，在故障发现与复现两个阶段均优于现有基线，为硬件安全故障灵敏度评估提供了更有效的自动化工具。

Abstract: Physical fault injection can turn brief hardware disturbances into security failures such as key recovery, authentication bypass, and unintended control flow. Finding effective faults is difficult because many interacting parameters create a large search space, successful settings are sparse and target-dependent, and each hardware attempt provides limited feedback. Under fixed testing time, efficient search is therefore critical for assessing fault sensitivity.
  We present GlitchLab, an online hardware-in-the-loop platform that treats delay as a timing gate, voltage and pulse duration as severity controls, and hardware outcomes as structured feedback. It implements RL-Q (Q-learning-based reinforcement learning), a structured bandit for discovery, and Structured-Outcome-Based Adaptive Search (SOBAS), a model-based policy for fault reproduction.
  Both policies find a target fault in every AES, password, and control-flow campaign. On AES and control flow, they require 2-85x fewer attempts and 26-1,237x less time than the baselines; on password, both succeed while the baselines fail within 5,000 attempts. After discovery, SOBAS reproduces faults 7.3-21x more often, while RL-Q identifies 30% more distinct AES settings.

</details>


### [259] [The Safeguard Worked. Is the LLM System Safer?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00519)
*Pingyu Wu,Weiming Zhang,Nenghai Yu*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文揭示了部署LLM服务的保护机制（safeguard）评估标准与部署实际需求之间的错位：现有评估通过拒绝率、攻击成功率、策略违例率来衡量护栏在测试请求上的表现，但部署真正需要回答的是"攻击者持续适应或另辟蹊径时，服务仍能在多大程度上帮助有害任务"。作者论证了证据要求存在强不对称性：一次成功的攻击即足以证明有害帮助仍然存在，而证明有害帮助很少则不能仅依赖护栏自身的数据，还需证明周边系统在护栏执行局部功能后仍允许什么——但这类证据只出现在少数深度编码的声明中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全评估指标（拒绝对、攻击成功率、策略违例率）只反映护栏在测试请求上的表现，无法回答部署层面的关键问题——面对不断适应和寻找其他入口的攻击者，服务实际还能提供多少有害帮助。不同护栏家族的结果缺乏统一的部署标准进行比较。

Method: 作者通过逻辑分析不同评估指标对部署问题的含义，建立统一部署判据，并对比各类护栏测试结果的证据效力。同时引入"深度编码声明"（depth-coded claims）的分析方法，评估哪些研究声明在多大程度上提供了能支撑或推导出"周边系统在护栏局部功能执行后仍允许什么"的证据。

Result: 证据要求呈现强不对称性：证明"有害帮助仍存在"只需一次成功的攻击即可，且这类攻击在编码记录中反复出现；而证明"有害帮助所剩无几"无法仅凭护栏自身数字得出，还需周边系统的证据，但这类证据仅存在于少数深度编码声明中，且仅有一个声称界定了其作用范围内的残余风险。因此，更高的局部护栏分数本身并不意味着更强的部署安全声明，多数"改进"并未实质提升部署安全。

Conclusion: 护栏研究不能止步于提升局部评估分数；任何改进都必须以其是否真正让部署系统更安全来评判。局部性能与部署安全的映射需要通过统一判据评估，并补足对系统周边环境的证据。

Abstract: Safeguards in deployed LLM services are evaluated by refusal, attack success, and policy violation rates. Those rates characterize how a control performed on the requests it was tested on. A deployment has to answer a different question: how much help with harmful tasks the service still gives an attacker who keeps adapting or finds another way in. We determine what each reported result implies for that question, allowing results from different safeguard families to be compared under one deployment criterion. The evidence requirements are strongly asymmetric. One attack that obtains harmful help from the deployed service suffices to establish that such help remains, and such attacks appear repeatedly in the coded record. Establishing that little remains cannot follow from the safeguard's own numbers alone; it also requires evidence about what the surrounding system still allows after the safeguard performs its local function. Such evidence is supported or derived in only a small minority of the depth-coded claims, and one such claim bounds its scoped residual. A better local score is therefore not, by itself, a stronger claim about the deployment. Safeguard research cannot stop at raising local scores; a gain has to be judged by whether it makes a deployed system any safer.

</details>


### [260] [Transferable End-to-End Optimization for Indirect Long-Term Memory Poisoning in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00523)
*Chuanchao Zang,Jianing Wang,Wenyu Chen,Xiangtao Meng,Li Wang,Xinyu Gao,Zheng Li,Shanqing Guo*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出PipePoison框架，将间接记忆投毒视为端到端优化问题，解决现有攻击方法仅优化单个阶段而忽视跨阶段耦合的问题。其通过局部影子系统收集细粒度阶段反馈、使用链式结构损失识别并优化端到端成功的瓶颈阶段，并采用稳定性校准的阶段和配置权重提升迁移性，在三个代理框架和四种记忆机制上将攻击利用率提升19.1个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆可将不可信的外部内容转化为对LLM代理未来决策的持久影响，产生间接记忆投毒威胁。现有攻击大多依赖阶段内优化，孤立地优化各阶段而忽视跨阶段耦合。然而各阶段对相同的投毒内容有不同要求，且每个阶段都作用于前驱阶段的变换输出，导致优化某一阶段可能破坏其他阶段的有效性，上游变换也可能抹除为下游阶段设计的改进。因此间接记忆投毒应被看作端到端优化问题。

Method: PipePoison框架包含三个关键模块：(1) 从局部影子系统收集细粒度的阶段级反馈；(2) 使用链式结构损失来识别和优化限制端到端成功的瓶颈阶段；(3) 应用稳定性校准的阶段和配置权重以提升跨配置的迁移性。

Result: 在三个代理框架和四种记忆机制上，PipePoison将攻击利用率提升了19.1个百分点。即使在完全未见过的受害配置上，它比最强基线高出16个百分点，并且在八种代表性防御下仍然有效。

Conclusion: 间接记忆投毒需要被重构为端到端优化问题，PipePoison通过跨阶段视角和瓶颈感知的链式优化策略，成功提升了攻击的有效性与迁移性，同时在防御条件下保持了鲁棒性。

Abstract: Long-term memory can turn untrusted external content into persistent influence over an LLM agent's future decisions, creating the threat of indirect memory poisoning. A successful attack must survive a multi-stage pipeline comprising memory writing, retrieval, and utilization. Existing attacks largely rely on intra-stage optimization, optimizing individual stages in isolation while overlooking inter-stage coupling. Specifically, these stages impose different requirements on the same poisoning content, and each stage operates on the transformed output of its predecessor. Consequently, optimizing one stage may undermine the effectiveness of other stages, while upstream transformations may erase improvements intended for downstream stages. Indirect memory poisoning should therefore be viewed as an end-to-end optimization problem. Based on this insight, we present \textsc{PipePoison}, which collects fine-grained stage feedback from local shadow systems, uses chain-structured losses to identify and optimize the stage bottlenecking end-to-end success, and applies stability-calibrated stage and configuration weights to improve transferability. Across three agent frameworks and four memory mechanisms, \textsc{PipePoison} improves attack utilization rate by 19.1 percentage points. Even on fully unseen victim configurations, it outperforms the strongest baseline by 16 percentage points and remains effective under eight representative defenses.

</details>


### [261] [SoK: When Safe Agents Fail Together: The Security of Multi Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00595)
*Rui Yang,Junjie Xu,Zhengyu Liu,Neil Fendley,Yang Hong,Ziyang Li,Yinzhi Cao*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文对多智能体LLM系统（MAS）的安全问题进行了执行层面的系统化综述，分析了197篇文献，覆盖六种交互接口、四种对手位置、七种系统级风险及八条攻击路径。提出A-I-R攻击分类框架和五部分防御契约，并审计了44篇评测工作，指出隔离交互效应、可比较的诊断指标、跨设计复用和开放系统评估等挑战，最终主张以交互感知视角看待MAS安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中，信息、状态、决策和权限跨越主体边界流动，导致局部安全检查无法捕捉的级联性失败。作者指出，缺乏执行层面的视图会让人误将多智能体设置本身误认为产生了真正的多智能体安全效应，因此需要从执行视角系统化梳理MAS安全研究。

Method: 作者对197篇相关工作进行了执行中心的系统性综述，按六种交互接口、四种对手位置、七种系统级风险和八条攻击路径进行编码分类；提出了A-I-R框架（按对手位置-交互接口-系统级风险组织攻击）；提出五部分防御契约（路径目标、观测、干预、信任边界、恢复）；并对44篇评测与基准工作进行了审计。

Result: 识别出路径闭合（path closure）与恢复（recovery）是防御的关键挑战；在评测方面发现四个开放问题：隔离交互效应、设计可比较且可诊断的指标、支持跨MAS设计复用、评估开放系统运行。

Conclusion: 应以交互感知的视角看待MAS安全：端到端追踪攻击路径，检验防御是否能闭合这些路径，并使用适当的反事实设计来评估系统级安全效应。

Abstract: Safe agents can fail together. Multi-agent LLM systems (MAS) move information, state, decisions, and authority across principal boundaries, creating failures that local checks may miss. Without an execution-level view, a multi-agent setting can easily be mistaken for evidence of a genuinely multi-agent security effect. We thus systematize MAS security through an execution-centered analysis of 197 works, covering six interaction interfaces, four adversary positions, seven system-level risks, and eight recurring attack paths. We introduce an A-I-R framework that organizes attacks by adversary position, interaction interface, and resulting system-level risk, unifying otherwise fragmented attack mechanisms across MAS. We organize defenses through a five-part contract covering path target, observation, intervention, trust boundary, and recovery, and identify path closure and recovery as key challenges. We audit 44 evaluation and benchmark works and identify open challenges in isolating interaction effects, designing comparable and diagnostic metrics, supporting reuse across MAS designs, and evaluating open-system operation. Together, these findings motivate an interaction-aware view of MAS security: trace attacks end to end, test whether defenses close those paths, and evaluate system-level effects with appropriate counterfactuals.

</details>


### [262] [NeuroGraph: An AI Graph-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Explainable Threat Reasoning in Advanced Manufacturing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00604)
*Padmeswari Nandiya,Ahmad Mohsin,Ahmed Ibrahim,Iqbal H. Sarker,Helge Janicke*

Main category: cs.CR

TL;DR: 本文提出一个图基座的神经符号框架，通过双大语言模型架构（一个生成Cypher查询进行符号图检索，另一个仅基于检索到的图证据生成答案）来支持IT/OT环境中准确且可解释的网络威胁情报分析，并在公开基准上展示了相较基线的推理准确性提升、幻觉减少、多跳推理增强和对抗扰动鲁棒性改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进制造业中网络物理攻击面日益复杂，使CTI分析愈发困难。尽管LLM和RAG改进了CTI工作流，但基于文本的方法仍存在幻觉问题，且无法对互联威胁进行结构化推理。现有的图基RAG方法缺乏本体一致的多跳推理和跨异构网络安全数据的透明证据追踪能力。

Method: 提出图基座的神经符号框架，包含三个核心组件：1）本体感知的符号查询生成——第一层LLM将自然语言问题转换为可执行的Cypher查询以进行符号图检索；2）知识图谱检索——从KG中获取结构化证据；3）神经语言生成——第二层LLM严格基于检索到的图证据生成答案，防止幻觉。整个框架采用双LLM架构，确保查询生成与答案生成的角色分离。

Result: 在公开CTI基准上的实验表明，该框架在推理准确性上较已发表基线有一致提升，同时减少了幻觉、增强了多跳推理能力，并提高了对对抗扰动的鲁棒性。运行时和可解释性分析显示框架保持了交互式推理性能，并能暴露图基座推理产物供分析师在每个阶段检查和验证。

Conclusion: 图基座的神经符号推理有望成为面向下一代工业5.0环境的可扩展、可解释且可靠的CTI分析方案，其通过符号图检索与神经生成的协同，弥合了结构化推理与自然语言理解之间的鸿沟。

Abstract: The growing complexity of cyber-physical attack surfaces in advanced manufacturing has made cyber threat intelligence analysis increasingly difficult. Although large language models and retrieval-augmented generation have improved CTI workflows, text-based approaches remain vulnerable to hallucinations and provide limited support for structured reasoning over interconnected threats. Graph-based RAG reduces some of these limitations, but existing approaches often lack ontology-consistent multi-hop reasoning and transparent evidence tracing across heterogeneous cybersecurity data. This paper proposes a graph-grounded neuro-symbolic framework that integrates ontology-aware symbolic query generation, knowledge graph retrieval, and neural language generation to support accurate and explainable threat analysis across information technology and operational technology environments. The framework adopts a dual-large language model architecture: the first model translates natural-language questions into executable Cypher queries for symbolic graph retrieval, while the second generates answers strictly from the retrieved graph evidence. Experimental evaluation using publicly available cyber threat intelligence benchmarks shows consistent improvements over the published baseline in reasoning accuracy, while also reducing hallucinations, strengthening multi-hop reasoning, and improving robustness to adversarial perturbations.
