We distinguish sandbox spawning, in which external controls prevent the specified harm, from capability activation, in which a selected branch crosses an irreversible-action boundary. Progressive Risk Vesting (PRV) holds a trajectory-level risk budget in escrow and debits it as branches are activated. We prove an anytime harm bound for adaptively generated trees. Branch outcomes may be dependent, but each local certificate needs to remain valid conditional on the full pre-activation history, including the information used to select the request. When activation gates, branch charges, and compute constraints are held fixed, delayed vesting preserves every policy available under irrevocable spawn charging. Marginal risk estimates can still fail after branch selection. In a stylized branching model, trajectory harm changes as the authority reproduction number $\mathcal{R}_A$ crosses one. As local risk $p$ approaches zero, trajectory harm is proportional to $p$ below criticality, proportional to $\sqrt{p}$ at criticality, and retains a positive floor above it. A finite-type occupancy model yields risk and compute shadow prices. For nested fanout modes with decreasing marginal value per unit risk, these prices produce a threshold rule. Branching calculations and a split-sample experiment illustrate the results. These synthetic studies do not estimate safety in deployed agents. The analysis suggests a design rule: search broadly in the sandbox and grant recursive authority sparingly, with an explicit risk charge.

</details>


### [395] [Data-Driven Persona-Conditioned Agents for A/B Test Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01038)
*Ziyad Benomar,Weronika Łajewska,Leonardo Perelli,Saab Mansour*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于LLM智能体和数据驱动人设的仿真框架，用于预测A/B测试结果，在40个A/B测试基准上达到0.75-0.90的方向准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: A/B测试是评估产品变更的金标准，但每次实验都需要真实用户流量、工程资源和数周的测量周期，成本高昂且耗时。现有基于合成或规则人设的仿真方法缺乏对真实用户行为建模的能力，需要更高效且低成本的实验预筛选方法。

Method: 提出一个仿真框架：使用LLM驱动的智能体，基于数据驱动的人设（由匿名化行为数据构建，包括活动模式、参与信号和推断人口统计特征）来预测A/B测试结果。将A/B测试仿真建模为结构化问答任务，并系统研究四个方面：(i) 问题设计格式；(ii) 人设数据来源和领域对齐的影响；(iii) 单个人设行为深度与总体多样性之间的权衡；(iv) 高效的总体子采样策略。

Result: 在包含40个A/B测试、跨越两种度量类型的基准上，最佳配置达到0.75-0.90的方向准确率（取决于测试度量），表明数据驱动人设是实现快速、低成本实验预筛选的可行途径。

Conclusion: 数据驱动人设结合LLM智能体能够以较高的方向准确性预测A/B测试结果，为快速、低成本的实验预筛选提供了一条可行路径，相比依赖合成或规则人设的先前方法更具人口建模保真度。

Abstract: A/B testing is the gold standard for evaluating product changes, but each experiment requires real user traffic, engineering effort, and weeks of measurement. We propose a simulation framework that predicts A/B test outcomes using LLM-powered agents conditioned on data-driven personas grounded in real user behavioral signals. Unlike prior work that relies on synthetic or rule-based personas, our agents are constructed from anonymized behavioral data-activity patterns, engagement signals, and inferred demographics-enabling more faithful population modeling. We frame A/B test simulation as a structured question task and systematically study (i) question design formats, (ii) the impact of persona data source and domain alignment, (iii) the trade-off between per-persona behavioral depth and population diversity, and (iv) efficient population subsampling. On a benchmark of 40 A/B tests spanning two metric types, our best configuration achieves 0.75-0.90 directional accuracy depending on the test metric, demonstrating that data-driven personas are a viable path toward fast, low-cost experiment pre-screening.

</details>


### [396] [AgentFactory: Towards Automated Agentic System Design and Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01045)
*Enci Zhang,Haofeng Wang,Yuesheng Zhu,Xiaole Cui,Guibo Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AgentFactory框架，一个联合优化智能体系统中基础模型与工作流结构的多目标优化框架，同时考虑性能、成本和效率。采用三阶段优化流程，利用先进LLM作为优化器在庞大配置空间中自动发现微调模型与优化工作流的有效组合。在涵盖推理、编码、数学、医学和金融五个领域的八项基准上，平均提升9.1%，领域特定任务上提升显著（MedQA提升19.6%，FinEval提升18.7%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体系统的手动设计与优化方法依赖人工努力，限制适应性和可扩展性。虽已有自动化工作流优化研究，但这些方法往往忽视模型能力的关键作用，且仅关注单一性能指标，无法满足真实部署中对成本与效率等多目标约束的需求。

Method: AgentFactory框架联合优化基础模型和工作流结构，核心采用三阶段优化流程，利用先进LLM作为优化器在巨大配置空间中导航。通过迭代优化过程系统性地探索和评估不同智能体系统设计，自动发现微调模型与优化工作流的有效组合，同时兼顾性能、成本与效率多目标。

Result: 在涵盖通用推理、编码、数学、医学和金融五个领域的八项基准上，AgentFactory一致优于手工设计方法和现有自动化方法，平均提升9.1%。领域特定任务收益显著，其中MedQA提升19.6%，FinEval提升18.7%。

Conclusion: AgentFactory通过自动化多目标优化，能够适应任务特定需求同时保持运营效率，为开发更具能力和高效的智能体系统提供了有前景的自动化优化路径。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities as powerful components in agentic systems, enabling sophisticated reasoning and complex task execution. However, current approaches to manually designing and optimizing agentic systems heavily rely on manual effort, limiting their adaptability and scalability. Recent work has explored the automated optimization of workflow designs. However, these approaches often overlook the crucial role of model capabilities and focus on single performance metrics, failing to address real-world deployment constraints. In this paper, we present AgentFactory, a framework that jointly optimizes both foundation models and workflow structures in agentic systems while considering multiple objectives including performance, cost, and efficiency. AgentFactory leverages advanced LLMs as optimizers to navigate the vast search space of possible configurations, employing a three-stage optimization pipeline to automatically discover effective combinations of fine-tuned models and optimized workflows. Through an iterative optimization process, our framework systematically explores and evaluates different agentic system designs, adapting to task-specific requirements while maintaining operational efficiency. We evaluate AgentFactory across eight benchmarks spanning five domains, including general reasoning, coding, mathematics, medicine, and finance. Our experiments demonstrate that AgentFactory consistently outperforms both manually designed methods and existing automated approaches, achieving an average improvement of 9.1% across all benchmarks, with particularly significant gains in domain-specific tasks (19.6% on MedQA and 18.7% on FinEval). These results establish AgentFactory as a promising approach for developing more capable and efficient agentic systems through automated optimization.

</details>


### [397] [QILP-0: Constructing Observational Declarative Twins of Quantum Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01049)
*Marina de la Cruz Echeandía,César Luis Alonso,Tony Ribeiro,Alfonso Ortega de la Puente*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出QXymb通用框架，用于为量子电路构建观测声明性孪生（observational declarative twin），并开发了其首个完整零阶特化QILP-0。QILP-0通过在声明观测范围内从电路行为构建有限多值命题逻辑程序，实现对离散关系的完全、无冲突重构（精确率=1），并在16-100量子比特的Bars & Stripes以及全部14,708个MNIST数字0/1实例上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子电路的数值仿真结果受后端、提供方和离散化不确定性影响，缺乏一种将逻辑精确性与数值不确定性分离的系统性框架。作者希望建立一种能够从量子电路观测行为中提取逻辑级"孪生"（twins）的方法，使逻辑重构的精确性独立于底层数值不确定性，同时保留观测语义与来源追踪。

Method: QILP-0方法包含多阶段流水线：(1) 依据可复现的结构分级与声明性观测参考视界，逐步遍历量子可观测量族；(2) 通过参考相对覆盖率量化进展，观测量响应以目标无关几何组织，保留的潜在结构确定性映射回原始观测列以保证语义；(3) 通过允许的目标无关离散化将选定观测画像转换为有限关系；(4) 目标仅在后验阶段用于审计孪生可容许性和归纳声明性理论；(5) 当理论完全且正确重构有限任务条件离散关系时，认证为精确观测声明性孪生。

Result: 在两组互补实验中，Bars & Stripes在16到100量子比特范围比较product与grid-CZ嵌入（覆盖原生离散分支），Low-Depth MNIST分析全部14,708个0/1实例且涵盖连续离散化。所有报告关系中，QILP-0归纳理论均达到完全、无冲突重构，严格精确率等于1。

Conclusion: QILP-0证明了在量子机器学习设置中，可以在逻辑层面实现对观测关系的完全精确重构（精确率=1），将逻辑精确性与后端、提供方及离散化不确定性成功分离，后者以审计元数据形式保留。该框架为量子电路的声明性逻辑建模提供了系统化途径，具备可复现的结构分级和参考相对覆盖度量机制。

Abstract: This paper introduces QXymb, a general framework for constructing observational declarative twins of quantum circuits, and develops QILP-0, its first complete order-0 specialization. QILP-0 constructs a finite multi-valued propositional logic program from observed circuit behaviour within a declared observational scope.
  The pipeline traverses a declared family of quantum observables incrementally according to a reproducible structural grading and a declared observational reference horizon. Progress is quantified through reference-relative coverage against a fixed target-independent reference. Observable responses are organized through target-independent geometry, while retained latent structure is mapped deterministically back to original observable columns before symbolic processing, preserving observational semantics and provenance.
  Selected observable profiles are converted into a finite relation through admissible target-independent discretization. The target is used only afterwards to audit twin-admissibility and induce the declarative theory. A theory is certified as an exact observational declarative twin when it completely and correctly reconstructs the resulting finite task-conditioned discrete relation. Logical exactness is therefore separated from numerical, backend, provider, and discretization uncertainty, which is retained as audit metadata.
  Validation uses two complementary QML settings. Exhaustive Bars & Stripes experiments compare product and grid-CZ embeddings from 16 to 100 qubits and exercise the native-discrete branch. Low-Depth MNIST analyses all 14,708 digit-0/1 instances before and after a trained variational quantum transformation and exercises continuous discretization. In every reported relation, the induced QILP-0 theory achieves complete, conflict-free reconstruction with strict accuracy equal to one.

</details>


### [398] [WorldBench: Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multilingual Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01056)
*Leonardo Ranaldi,Sherrie Shen,Jushi Kai,Alexandra Birch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WorldBench是一个多语言、人物锚定的真实日常任务基准测试集，包含1,600个任务、7种语言和8种文化背景。实验表明前沿模型仅达到49.2%的约束任务成功率(CTS)，且正确性与环境保持之间存在显著差距，揭示了当前智能体在多语言、长时程场景下的脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体基准测试很少评估状态保持能力、跨语言表现以及对真实场景的适应，缺乏能全面反映智能体在实际复杂环境中性能的评测体系。

Method: 构建WorldBench基准测试集，包含1,600个跨7种语言和8种文化的真实日常任务，经语言与文化专家注释者筛选和反馈优化。引入Constrained Task Success (CTS)评估指标，结合自然语言指令与测试环境，通过确定性评估和LLM-as-a-Judge方法综合衡量任务完成度、最小环境改动和其他互补指标。

Result: 前沿模型在CTS上仅达到49.2%，所有模型都表现出正确性与环境保持之间的显著差距，尤其在长时程任务和状态保持约束下表现脆弱。

Conclusion: 当前智能体在多语言、人物锚定的智能体场景中依然脆弱，需要进一步改进状态保持能力和长时程任务处理能力。

Abstract: Despite the growing use of LLM-powered agents to solve multi-step tasks in complex environments, existing benchmarks rarely test state preservation, performance across languages, and application to realistic, grounded scenarios. To address these concerns, we present WorldBench: a comprehensive, multilingual benchmark of genuine, persona-grounded everyday workflows, where agents can act in a sandbox via structured actions. WorldBench comprises 1,600 tasks across seven languages and eight cultures, filtered and refined through feedback from human annotators with language- and culture-specific expertise. For evaluation, we extend metrics from previous works and introduce Constrained Task Success (CTS), which combines natural language instructions and testbeds to score task completion, minimal modification, and other complementary metrics through deterministic and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations. Our experiments show that frontier models reach only 49.2% CTS, with all models demonstrating large gaps between correctness and environment preservation. We thereby show that current agents remain brittle in multilingual, agentic scenarios, especially for long-horizon tasks and under state-preservation constraints

</details>


### [399] [User Representation via Cross Multi-source Behavior Pre-training for Mobile Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01057)
*Chengqi Yang,Yiran Qiao,Feng Liu,Xingyu Lou,Zijun Zhou,Xiaoyun Mo,Changwang Zhang,Jiayuan Xu,Jun Wang,Xiang Ao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CM-PTM，一种面向移动端设备级行为日志的跨多源行为预训练模型，通过层级级联的mask-then-predict代理任务统一建模跨源依赖与细粒度行为动态，在移动游戏推荐任务上取得显著性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用户表征预训练研究主要关注单一应用或应用级行为，忽略了移动设备上用户活动天然具有的跨源性和多粒度特性。设备层面用户意图源自异构行为来源与层级行为结构的复杂交互，传统以应用为中心的建模方法难以解决该问题。

Method: 提出CM-PTM（Cross Multi-source Behavior Pre-Training Model），采用层级级联的mask-then-predict代理任务：首先预测下一行为的来源（source），然后逐步细化到应用-动作层级的预测，在单一预训练范式下统一建模跨源依赖与细粒度行为动态。

Result: 在大规模真实移动端数据集上的广泛实验表明，CM-PTM能够有效捕捉用户内源兴趣，并在下游移动游戏推荐任务上持续取得显著的性能增益。

Conclusion: 跨多源行为预训练能够弥补传统应用中心建模的不足，层级级联的mask-then-predict设计为设备级用户表征学习提供了有效且统一的方法框架。

Abstract: User representation pre-training has become a fundamental paradigm for alleviating data sparsity in downstream personalization tasks. However, existing studies predominantly focus on single-app or app-level behaviors, overlooking the inherently cross-source and multi-granular nature of user activities on mobile devices. At the device level, user intent emerges from complex interactions among heterogeneous behavior sources and hierarchical action structures, posing challenges that cannot be addressed by conventional app-centric modeling. To tackle this issue, we propose CM-PTM, a novel Cross Multi-source Behavior Pre-Training Model tailored for mobile game user representation learning on device-level behavioral logs. CM-PTM employs hierarchical cascaded mask-then-predict proxy tasks that first infer the source of the next behavior and then progressively refine predictions at the app-action level. This design enables unified modeling of cross-source dependencies and fine-grained behavioral dynamics within a single pre-training paradigm. Extensive experiments on large-scale real-world mobile datasets demonstrate that CM-PTM effectively captures users' endogenous interests and consistently delivers significant performance gains on downstream mobile game recommendation tasks.

</details>


### [400] [ARISE-RL: Agentic Rubric-Grounded Iterative Self-Evolution with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01058)
*Fanrui Zhang,Ruixue Ding,Qiang Zhang,Xi Chen,Boli Chen,Shihang Wang,Qiuchen Wang,Hongmin Zhan,Jinxin Bian,Li xingchao,Peijin Zheng,Hao cheng,Pengjun Xie,Kaipeng Zhang,Jiawei Liu,Zheng-Jun Zha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ARISE-RL，一个全周期自进化框架，通过生成器-求解器的协同进化解决开放世界智能体RL训练中缺乏可验证奖励和长时程奖励噪声的问题，并引入RG-SED蒸馏机制和ECR-Bench评测基准，在多个基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放世界智能体的RL训练面临两大挑战：1) 缺乏可验证的黄金答案和可扩展的评分规则；2) 即使在模型能力边界附近，长时程开放任务产生的奖励往往脆弱且不稳定，导致rollout对比信号弱或噪声大，难以为基于分组的策略学习提供细粒度优化信号。

Method: 1) ARISE-RL框架：任务/评分规则生成器与推理求解器通过评分规则介导的协同进化互相促进，生成器基于真实工具观察生成工具相关的评分标准并探索中等难度任务，求解器从细粒度评分满足信号中学习。2) RG-SED机制：仅在记忆增强变体带来实际奖励提升时，有选择地将其蒸馏回同一策略，减少分布偏移并避免盲目模仿噪声指导。3) ECR-Bench：涵盖单工具深度研究和多工具旅行规划的专家校准评分规则基准套件。

Result: 在包括ECR-Bench在内的所有评估基准上，ARISE-RL一致地实现了稳健且稳定的整体最先进性能。

Conclusion: 通过生成器-求解器协同进化、有选择性蒸馏和高质量评测基准的构建，ARISE-RL有效解决了开放环境智能体RL训练中奖励信号缺乏和噪声大的核心难题，为该领域提供了一个完整的自进化训练和评测方案。

Abstract: Training open-ended agents via reinforcement learning (RL) is hindered by the lack of verifiable gold answers and scalable rubrics. Moreover, even near the model's capability boundary, long-horizon open-ended agentic tasks often yield brittle and unstable rewards, resulting in weak or noisy rollout contrast that obscures fine-grained optimization signals for group-based policy learning. To address these challenges, we propose ARISE-RL, a novel full-cycle self-evolution framework that couples a task/rubric Generator and a reasoning Solver through rubric-mediated co-evolution. The Generator grounds tool-related rubric criteria in real tool observations and is rewarded for producing valid, intermediate-difficulty tasks aligned with the Solver's evolving capability boundary. The Solver, in turn, learns from fine-grained rubric satisfaction signals through multi-step reasoning and tool use. We further introduce Reward-Gated Self-Evolution Distillation (RG-SED), which selectively distills a memory-augmented variant of the same policy back into itself only when the memory yields empirical reward improvement, thereby reducing distribution mismatch and avoiding blind imitation of noisy guidance. Finally, to support rigorous evaluation, we present ECR-Bench, an expert-calibrated rubric benchmark suite covering single-tool deep research and multi-tool travel planning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ARISE-RL consistently achieves robust and stable overall state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated benchmarks.

</details>


### [401] [Space Generative AI with Solar Energy Harvesting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01062)
*Jierui Zhang,Jianhao Huang,Zhanwei Wang,Kaibin Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个太阳能供电的太空生成式AI框架，其中卫星接收用户提示、执行基于扩散的图像生成模型，并在严格时间窗口内下行传输压缩结果。文章识别了由共享能量采集预算主导的计算-通信(C²)权衡，利用确定性轨道运动带来的可预测太阳能采集动态，开发了一个联合C²资源优化框架，推导出封闭形式的低复杂度步长选择策略，并在真实轨道动力学下验证了显著的端到端性能增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星有望成为将生成式AI服务扩展到缺乏地面基础设施的偏远地区的有前景平台，但太空生成式AI的部署受到太阳能能量采集提供的有限、时变板载能量的根本约束，因此需要有效管理计算（生成）与通信（下行传输）之间的资源共享。

Method: 基于扩散图像生成模型，采用两阶段方法：(1) 在固定生成深度和连续太阳能采集下，刻画最大下行吞吐量，建立分离原理将等待时间选择与最优发射功率控制解耦；(2) 形式化联合C²效用最大化问题，在主导恒定功率条件下推导出封闭形式、低复杂度的生成步数选择策略。

Result: 在现实轨道动力学下的大规模实验表明，所提出的策略能够动态平衡生成质量与传输可靠性，相比静态的计算中心型和通信中心型基线，在多种太阳能采集状态下取得了显著的端到端性能提升。

Conclusion: 利用轨道运动导致的确定性太阳能采集动态，可以设计高效的低复杂度联合计算-通信资源分配策略，在有限且时变的星载能量约束下同时优化生成AI的图像质量与传输可靠性，为太空部署生成式AI提供可行的工程方案。

Abstract: Satellites are emerging as promising platforms to extend generative \emph{artificial intelligence} (AI) services to remote areas lacking terrestrial infrastructure. However, deploying space generative AI is fundamentally constrained by the limited, time-varying onboard energy supplied by solar \emph{energy harvesting} (EH). This paper presents a framework for solar-powered space generative AI in which a satellite receives a user prompt, executes a diffusion-based image-generation model, and downlinks the compressed result within a strict time window. We identify the fundamental \emph{computation--communication} (C$^2$) trade-offs governed by the shared harvested-energy budgets. Specifically, increasing the number of generation steps improves intrinsic image quality but depletes energy and time available for downlink transmission, whereas prioritizing communication guarantees reliable delivery but sacrifices semantic quality. To balance these trade-offs and maximize \emph{end-to-end} (E2E) generative performance, we exploit the predictable solar-EH dynamics induced by deterministic orbital motion and develop a joint C$^2$ resource-optimization framework using a tractable two-step approach. First, we characterize the maximum downlink throughput for a fixed generation depth under continuous solar EH. This establishes a separation principle that decouples waiting-time selection from optimal transmit-power control. Next, we formulate a joint C$^2$ utility-maximization problem and derive a closed-form, low-complexity step-selection policy in the dominant constant-power regime. Extensive experiments under realistic orbital dynamics demonstrate that the proposed policy dynamically balances generation quality and transmission reliability. This yields significant E2E performance gains over static computation- and communication-centric baselines across diverse solar-EH states.

</details>


### [402] [Latent Recurrent Thoughts: Recurrent Refinement of Proposed Latents for Reasoning with Frozen LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01117)
*Zhaoliang Chen,Jie Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent Recurrent Thoughts (LRT)框架，在连续表示空间中通过小型循环推理器迭代精炼潜在思维，而冻结的大语言模型仅负责解码，从而在无需推理轨迹监督的情况下实现比链式思维更高效的推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 链式思维推理在离散token空间中展开，存在三个关键问题：(1)每一步错误都会以文本形式固化并不断传播；(2)生成好的推理轨迹需要先存在可模仿的轨迹作为监督；(3)推理深度受限于模型大小和离散表征的约束。这些问题促使作者探索在模型的连续表示空间中进行推理，即中间状态是向量而非单词。

Method: LRT沿两个维度设计：(1)将大语言模型(LLM)冻结，仅利用其擅长序列建模与解码的能力，由小型辅助网络提供连续潜在思想作为模型输入；(2)通过循环机制生成潜在思想——一个微型循环推理器在多个步骤中通过有界残差修正持续精炼潜在状态，使计算深度与模型大小解耦。具体架构包括：任务专用的proposer提供基础潜在向量，循环推理器通过有界残差修正进行迭代精炼，最后由冻结的LLM解码输出答案。

Result: 在符号推理任务（Countdown-4、Sudoku，仅提供答案监督而无推理轨迹）和自然语言推理任务（HumanEval、MBPP、StrategyQA）上，LRT在相同的解码器、提示词、数据和训练预算下显著优于先前的冻结解码器连续空间推理方法，并在推理计算量仅为链式思维提示一小部分的情况下超越了同一骨干网络上的非思维模式链式思维提示。

Conclusion: LRT证明了一种可行的推理范式：通过连续潜在空间中的循环精炼实现深度推理，无需依赖离散token推理轨迹的监督，同时解耦了推理计算深度与LLM模型大小，在显著降低推理成本的同时提升性能。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning unfolds in discrete token space: each step is committed as text, errors propagate, and eliciting good traces presupposes traces to imitate. Reasoning instead in a model's continuous representation space - where intermediate states are vectors rather than words - sidesteps these constraints, but leaves open how those latent states should be computed. We approach this along two axes. First, we keep a large language model (LLM) frozen and use it for what it is already good at - modeling and decoding sequences - while a small auxiliary network supplies continuous latent thoughts as input. Second, we produce those latents by recurrence: a tiny recurrent reasoner refines them over many steps, decoupling the depth of computation from the size of the model, so that the latents are a product of iterative processing rather than a single forward pass. We instantiate this as Latent Recurrent Thoughts (LRT): a task-dedicated proposer supplies base latents, a recurrent reasoner refines them through bounded residual corrections, and the frozen LLM decodes the answer. On symbolic reasoning with answer supervision but no reasoning traces (Countdown-4, Sudoku) and on natural-language reasoning (HumanEval, MBPP, StrategyQA), LRT substantially outperforms prior frozen-decoder continuous-space reasoning methods under an identical decoder, prompt, data, and training budget, and outperforms non-thinking-mode chain-of-thought prompting on the same backbone at a small fraction of its inference compute.

</details>


### [403] [Jailbreaking Text-to-Image Models Through Cracks: Navigating Heterogeneous Safety Filters via Multi-Agent Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01168)
*Kaiyan Wen,Shijie Zhang,Lu Yu,Guangdong Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Detection Surface这一统一几何框架来描述T2I模型多层安全过滤器的决策边界及其交叉冲突对越狱搜索空间的影响，并基于此设计了CRACK——一个多智能体辩论框架，通过攻击、防御和裁判三个智能体的协作实现自适应越狱搜索，在复合防御下达到高达99.63%的攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I模型的防护体系由异构的多层安全过滤器（文本过滤器、图像分类器、跨模态检测器）组成，但现有越狱攻击研究要么只针对单个过滤器进行优化，要么仅通过聚合反馈查询整个流水线，难以识别当前生效的具体约束，也难以适应不同安全层之间的冲突。

Method: 1) 提出Detection Surface框架，统一刻画异构安全过滤器的决策边界及其在越狱搜索空间上的联合效应，揭示成功的规避区域是稀疏且非凸的，由跨层冲突塑造。2) 基于该分析提出CRACK多智能体辩论框架，将越狱搜索分解为探索（Exploration）、诊断（Diagnosis）和仲裁（Arbitration）三个阶段，协调攻击智能体（Attack Agent）、防御智能体（Defense Agent）和裁判智能体（Judge Agent），通过逐层诊断反馈和奖励引导的优化不断迭代生成提示词变异。

Result: 在多个T2I模型、数据集和安全配置上的大量实验表明，CRACK在复合防御下攻击成功率可达99.63%，且相比现有方法所需的查询次数更少，同时保持了语义保真度。

Conclusion: Detection Surface提供了一个理解异构安全层联合约束的理论视角，而CRACK通过多智能体辩论范式有效利用跨层诊断反馈，实现高效、自适应的越狱攻击搜索，为理解T2I安全系统的脆弱性提供了更深入的洞察。

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content, despite increasingly being guarded by heterogeneous, multi-layer safety stacks combining text filters, image classifiers, and cross-modal detectors. Existing jailbreak studies either optimize against individual filters or query the complete pipeline with aggregate feedback, making it difficult to identify the active constraint and adapt to conflicts across safety layers.In this paper, we introduce the \emph{Detection Surface}, a unified geometric framework that characterizes the decision boundaries induced by heterogeneous T2I safety filters and their joint effect on the jailbreak search space. This formulation reveals that successful evasion is governed by a sparse and non-convex region shaped by cross-layer conflicts, where mutations that bypass one filter may increase exposure to another. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \emph{CRACK}, a multi-agent debate framework for adaptive jailbreak search that decomposes jailbreak search into exploration, diagnosis, and arbitration. CRACK coordinates an Attack Agent, a Defense Agent, and a Judge Agent to iteratively generate prompt mutations, obtain layer-specific diagnostic feedback, and optimize mutation strategies through reward-guided refinement. Through repeated rounds of debate, CRACK adapts its search direction to the evolving cross-layer constraints while preserving the original harmful intent. Extensive experiments across multiple T2I models, datasets, and safety configurations show that CRACK achieves Attack Success Rates (ASR) of up to 99.63\% under composite defenses, while requiring fewer queries than existing methods and maintaining semantic fidelity.

</details>


### [404] [FinLifeBench: Exhaustive Life-Event History and Financial-State Reconstruction from Longitudinal Banking Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01198)
*Hangyeul Lee,Juyoung Oh,Jaeyong Ko,Sunmin Kim,Jaeik Park,Hyunkyu Kim,Jungmin Son,Pilsung Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FinLifeBench基准，用于评估LLM在累积银行对话中对跨会话纵向客户记录的重建能力，涵盖20条合成轨迹的6,000个韩语会话，包含34条状态路径与24种事件类型的确定性标注。实验表明11个LLM在长上下文下事件锚定召回率从15个会话的0.591降至300个会话的0.445，主要错误源于事件遗漏而非锚点定位不足；财务状态重建常将已过时信息当作当前信息，最佳GCA@15仅达0.470，且两任务表现关联弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准侧重于问答、受限情节或定向回忆，缺乏对跨会话、详尽纵向记录的评估。然而真实银行场景中，助理需要在多次交互中维护完整、最新且可追溯的客户记录，生活变化常在日常请求中偶然出现，这一能力尚未得到系统评测。

Method: 构建FinLifeBench基准，包含20条独立合成轨迹共6,000个八轮韩语银行会话，在每个越过的检查点同时评估两项任务：(1)逐条重建所有人生事件实例并定位其首次确立的会话；(2)重建完整的34路径财务状态。提供24种事件类型与34条状态路径的确定性、穷尽式黄金标注，并采用共识质量保证。在完整上下文的条件下测试11个LLM。

Result: 事件锚定召回率从15个会话的0.591下降到300个会话的0.445；错误主要由事件遗漏驱动而非锚点定位不准。财务状态重建时常把被替代或可能陈旧的信息当作当前状态，最优GCA@15仅为0.470。事件重建与财务状态重建两项任务的性能关联较弱。

Conclusion: 模型虽然能够定位已被恢复证据的事件，但仍无法维持完整且时间有效的纵向记录。这揭示了当前LLM在长期累积对话中作为银行助手的根本局限，为面向纵向记录维护能力的评测和模型改进指明了方向。

Abstract: Repeated banking interactions require assistants to maintain complete, current, and traceable customer records as life changes emerge incidentally in routine requests. Existing benchmarks emphasize question answering, bounded episodes, or targeted recall rather than exhaustive longitudinal reconstruction. We introduce FinLifeBench, which evaluates two tasks over the same cumulative dialogue: reconstructing every life-event instance with its first-establishing session and reconstructing a complete 34-path financial state at consecutive checkpoints. The benchmark contains 6,000 eight-turn Korean banking sessions from 20 independent synthetic trajectories, with deterministic, exhaustive gold for 24 event types and 34 state paths and consensus quality assurance. Across eleven LLMs under a full-context condition, event-anchor recall falls from 0.591 at 15 sessions to 0.445 at 300. Errors are driven primarily by omitted events rather than poor anchor localization, while financial-state reconstruction frequently treats superseded or potentially outdated information as current; the best GCA@15 reaches 0.470. Performance on the two reconstruction tasks is only weakly associated. These results show that models can localize evidence for recovered events while still failing to maintain complete and temporally valid longitudinal records.

</details>


### [405] [H2Table: Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Large Language Models for Complex Table Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01216)
*Jia Ling,Yangfan Wang,Chen Tang,Haoming Tan,Yang Yang,Yi Guan,Jingchi Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出H2Table框架，用层次化嵌套超图表示复杂表格，通过定制超图编码器在超边（表头）和节点（单元格）之间进行消息传递以感知语义蕴涵关系，并使用可学习查询向量将结构嵌入轻量地桥接到LLM中，在HiTab数据集上对嵌套深度为四的高度复杂表格相比SOTA平均提升22.88%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM处理表格通常将其线性化为序列，忽视了表格固有的二维和层次化结构。这种线性化方法导致模型难以捕捉复杂表格（尤其是含嵌套层次表头的表格）中的结构信息和语义关系，限制了推理性能。

Method: H2Table将复杂表格表示为层次化嵌套超图结构，设计定制超图编码器在超边（表头）与节点（单元格）之间进行消息传递，使模型能够感知复杂表格中表头与单元格之间的语义蕴涵关系；同时引入一组可学习查询向量作为轻量级桥梁，从编码器中提取代表性结构嵌入并传递给LLM进行推理。

Result: 在HiTab数据集上，H2Table对嵌套深度为四的高度复杂表格相比最先进的基线方法平均提升22.88%，有效处理了具有层次化嵌套表头的复杂表格问答任务。

Conclusion: 通过将表格建模为层次化超图而非线性序列，能够更好地保留和利用表格的结构信息，显著提升LLM在复杂表格上的推理能力。

Abstract: Tables are ubiquitous across diverse domains, yet reasoning over them remains a significant challenge for modern large language models (LLMs). Current approaches typically linearize tables into sequences, inherently overlooking their intrinsic two-dimensional and hierarchical structure. To address this, we propose H2Table (Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Table Reasoning), a novel framework that represents complex tables as hierarchical nested hypergraphs. To process this representation, we design a tailored hypergraph encoder to facilitate message passing between hyperedges (headers) and nodes (cells), thereby perceiving the semantic entailment relationships between them within complex tables. Furthermore, we introduce a set of learnable query vectors acting as a lightweight bridge to extract representative structural embeddings from the encoder into the LLM. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively handles complex table question answering tasks with hierarchical nested headers. Notably, on the HiTab dataset, H2Table achieves an average improvement of 22.88% over state-of-the-art baselines on highly complex tables with a nesting depth of four. Our code is available at: https://github.com/lila120/h2table.

</details>


### [406] [Prompt-Robust Language Models: Which Training Strategies Work?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01217)
*Frederic Sadrieh,Michal Štefánik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在受控条件下复现并比较了多种提示敏感性缓解策略，发现现有鲁棒性微调方法虽优于标准微调和上下文学习，但最佳与最差提示之间的性能差距仍高达40-57%；最新方法CoIN和PPCL甚至常常不如最简单的基础数据构建策略（每batch一个模板）。诊断实验揭示了原因：辅助目标只惩罚其度量的量而无法泛化，且不同模板梯度在57-64%的参数上符号冲突，导致混合模板的batch迫使优化器调和冲突更新而非寻找共享的提示无关解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型对提示表述高度敏感，即使性能强劲的模型也会因措辞变化产生显著性能波动。已有工作通过精细化数据构建或专用鲁棒性目标来缓解这一问题，但缺乏在受控条件下的系统化复现与公平比较，也不清楚这些策略实际起效的程度与内在机制。

Method: 在受控实验条件下系统复现并比较标准微调、上下文学习、数据构建策略（如每batch单模板训练）以及最新的鲁棒性增强方法（CoIN对比对齐与PPCL一致性正则化），通过性能差距测量和诊断分析（包括辅助目标行为与逐模板梯度的符号冲突分析）揭示各方法的效果与失效原因。

Result: 鲁棒性微调方法优于标准微调与上下文学习，但最佳到最差提示的性能差距仍高达40-57%。CoIN和PPCL等最新鲁棒性增强方法经常无法超越最简单的数据构建策略。诊断表明：辅助目标只移动其惩罚的度量而缺乏泛化；不同模板梯度在57-64%的参数上符号相反，混合提示batch迫使优化器调和竞争性更新，而非找到共享的提示无关解。

Conclusion: 现有鲁棒性方法对提示敏感性的缓解效果有限，性能差距依然悬殊。辅助目标优化存在过拟合于目标本身的局限，而混合模板batch中的梯度冲突表明真正的提示无关表征学习需要所有模板共享一致的优化方向，简单数据策略（每batch单模板）反而在这一目标上表现更好。

Abstract: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Prior work addresses this through refined data construction or through dedicated robustness objectives. We reproduce and compare these strategies under controlled conditions, and measure how effective they are in addressing models' prompt sensitivity. We find the current robustness fine-tuning methods improve over standard fine-tuning and in-context learning, but the best-to-worst prompt gap remains as high as 40-57% of performance. Moreover, the recent robustness-enhancing methods we test - CoIN for contrastive alignment and PPCL for consistency regularization - often fail to outperform the simplest data construction strategy: training on one template per batch. Our diagnostics explain these results. The auxiliary objectives move the quantity they penalize, but do not generalize beyond it. Additionally, data construction strategies differ due to the conflicting signs of per-template gradients on 57-64% of parameters. Thus, batches that mix formulations force the optimizer to reconcile competing updates instead of finding a shared, prompt-agnostic one.

</details>


### [407] [Measuring the Behavioral Fidelity of Long-Horizon Human Activity Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01257)
*Yi Fei Cheng,Fan Yang,Iremsu Bas,Koichiro Niinuma,Narishige Abe,David Lindlbauer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个评估基于LLM的人类模拟器在长时程活动模拟中行为保真度的框架，并以43小时的多摄像头真实办公室活动数据为案例，比较了人物描述、少样本示例和统计先验三种条件机制的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于LLM的人类模拟器被广泛用于政策制定、评估和训练，它们必须忠实再现真实行为模式。已有研究虽探讨了调查回答和对话中的行为保真度，但长时程的真实世界活动模拟在很大程度上尚未被探索。

Method: 提出了一个跨时间粒度和分析层面评估长时程活动模拟中行为保真度的框架；收集了43小时多摄像头野外办公室活动数据集；比较了从轨迹中衍生的条件机制：人物描述符、少样本示例以及统计转移和时间段先验。

Result: 行为保真度在不同指标上不一致：统计先验使活动和序列分布最接近真实行为，但过度碎片化了日常惯例并抑制了个体内变异性。

Conclusion: 这些发现促使需要一种更全面的评估方法，涵盖多个指标、时间粒度和分析层面。

Abstract: As LLM-based human simulators are increasingly used for policy, evaluation, and training, they must faithfully reproduce real behavioral patterns. While prior work has examined behavioral fidelity in survey responses and dialogue, longer-horizon real-world activity remains largely unexplored. We introduce a framework for evaluating behavioral fidelity in long-horizon activity simulations across temporal granularities and levels of analysis. As a case study, we collect a 43-hour multi-camera dataset of in-the-wild office activity and compare trace-derived conditioning mechanisms: persona descriptors, few-shot exemplars, and statistical transition and time-of-day priors. We find that behavioral fidelity is not uniform across metrics: statistical priors bring activity and sequence distributions closest to real behavior, yet over-fragment routines and suppress within-person variability. These findings motivate a more holistic evaluation that spans multiple metrics, temporal granularities, and levels of analysis.

</details>


### [408] [Making Prospective Memory SLM-Shaped: Typed Intention Stores for Small-Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01272)
*Jinqing Zhao,Chengcan Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出前瞻性意图存储（PIS）框架，将前瞻记忆中的生命周期逻辑编码到代码中，仅在作用域范围内使用语言模型，通过类型化动作空间让小型模型也能高效执行前瞻记忆任务。在PM-Bench基准上，DeepSeek-Chat配合PIS达到82.9% Set-F1，刷新SOTA，使小模型超越已发表的大模型脚手架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM在前瞻记忆（Prospective Memory）基准上表现不佳，最佳已发表脚手架仅达到65.1% Set-F1。作者认为该任务本质上是受schema约束的状态跟踪而非开放式推理，因此小型模型在类型化动作空间下即可胜任，无需依赖大模型的复杂推理能力。

Method: 提出Prospective Intention Store（PIS）脚手架，将生命周期逻辑（lifecycle logic）放在代码中，模型仅负责作用域受限的语言工作。该脚手架是agentic且免训练的，无需选择器微调或轨迹蒸馏。核心思想是将前瞻记忆任务分解为确定性的状态管理和有限的语义判断。

Result: 在PM-Bench上，DeepSeek-Chat配合PIS从65.1%提升至82.9% Set-F1。在Gemma-E2B上，无存储时仅4.2% Set-F1，七条回溯记忆上限为6.6%，而PIS达到66.2%。另一场景中PIS达到70.1%，而回溯记忆方法最高仅54.4%。PIS刷新基准SOTA并使小模型超越已发布的大模型脚手架。

Conclusion: 前瞻记忆可被重构为基于类型化动作空间的受约束状态跟踪问题，将生命周期逻辑外部化到代码中可以显著提升性能，使小模型超越大模型。这一结果挑战了该任务需要开放推理能力的假设，验证了结构化脚手架对agent能力的增强价值。

Abstract: Prospective memory means carrying out a deferred intention at the right future cue while other work continues. Benchmarks now isolate it as an agent skill, yet frontier LLMs still struggle: the best published PM-Bench scaffold reaches only 65.1% Set-F1. We argue that this loop is schema-constrained state tracking rather than open-ended reasoning, and that small models can execute it when the action space is typed. We propose the Prospective Intention Store (PIS) that puts lifecycle logic in code and scoped language work on the model. The scaffold is agentic and training-free: no selector fine-tuning and no trajectory distillation. On PM-Bench, DeepSeek-Chat with PIS reaches 82.9% Set-F1. On Gemma-E2B, Set-F1 is only 4.2% without a store and at most 6.6% under seven retrospective memories, while PIS reaches 66.2%. PIS further reaches 70.1% Set-F1, where retrospective memory methods stay at most 54.4%. PIS sets a new state of the art on this benchmark and enables small models to surpass the published large-model scaffold.

</details>


### [409] [A Composable Evaluation System for Reproducible Omni-Modal Foundation Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01315)
*Hodong Lee,Sanghee Park,Dohoon Ryu,Jungwhan Kim,Junyeob Kim,Soyoon Kim,Geewook Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OmniEvaluator是一个面向全模态基础模型的统一评测工具，通过单接口连接四种推理后端、四个评测框架和上千个基准测试，解决各模态评测工具链不兼容的问题，并内置CPU可运行的轻量级评分验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有各模态（文本、图像、视频、音频）已有优秀的评测工具包，但它们的推理引擎、提示约定和指标实现互不兼容，导致从业者需维护多套环境且难以跨结果比较。作者在自身模型开发中萌生此需求，希望在不重实现基准的情况下统一评测流程。

Method: 在高层连接现有推理引擎和精选评测库，而非重新实现基准。系统暴露四种推理后端、四个评测框架和上千个基准的统一接口；每次运行记录为包含完整配置的artifact以保证精确复现；结果汇入共享仪表板进行跨模型比较。提供联邦模式共享GPU推理服务器，并内置一个足够小以在CPU上运行的内置验证器，在基于规则的评分因配置不匹配而波动时保持分数稳定。

Result: 内置验证器在保持评分稳定（跨引擎和提示词）方面匹配成本效益高的商业LLM评判效果，同时不产生其重复API调用成本。系统、演示视频和仪表板已公开可用。

Conclusion: OmniEvaluator通过统一接口整合多模态评测工具链及GPU资源联邦共享，大幅降低多模态评测的工程维护成本，并提供了可复现、低成本、稳定评分的评测解决方案，已在GitHub公开。

Abstract: Building an omni-modal foundation model means evaluating it across text, image, video, and audio. Excellent evaluation toolkits exist for each modality, but their inference engines, prompt conventions, and metric implementations are mutually incompatible, so practitioners end up maintaining separate environments for every toolchain and still struggle to compare results across them. OmniEvaluator grew out of this need in our own model development: rather than reimplementing benchmarks, it connects existing inference engines and curated evaluation libraries at a higher level, exposing four inference backends, four evaluation frameworks, and over a thousand benchmarks through a single interface. Every run is recorded as an artifact capturing the full configuration for exact reproduction, and results flow into a shared dashboard for cross-model comparison. A federated mode shares GPU inference servers across concurrent evaluations, and a built-in verifier, small enough to run on CPU, keeps its score stable across engines and prompts where rule-based scoring fluctuates under configuration mismatch, matching cost-efficient commercial LLM judges without their recurring API cost. The system, demo video, and dashboard are publicly available. (https://github.com/naver-ai/omni-evaluator)

</details>


### [410] [Automated Event Log Generation from Unstructured Text Using Finetuned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01320)
*Maximilian Seeth,Gabriel Marques Tavares,Daniel Schuster*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个可扩展框架，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）作为数据翻译器，将非结构化文本资源（如工单、手册、报告）自动转换为结构化事件日志，以解决流程挖掘中事件日志构建成本高昂的瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流程挖掘（PM）技术的有效性依赖于结构化事件日志的可用性，但事件日志通常由领域专家和流程挖掘专家人工构建，成本高昂且耗时，导致大量组织知识（如事件工单、手册、文本报告）未被充分利用。

Method: 提出一个可扩展框架，将LLMs用作数据翻译器以弥合非结构化文本资源与结构化事件数据之间的鸿沟。具体方法包括：构建一个新的text-to-log数据集，并在该数据集上对LLMs进行微调（finetuning），使模型能够从非结构化资源中提取高保真事件日志。实验中还对比了few-shot和zero-shot提示方法。

Result: 微调后的模型能够从非结构化资源中提取高保真事件日志；微调方法在性能上大幅优于few-shot和zero-shot提示方法，表明微调是生成可靠事件数据的必要前提。

Conclusion: 该方法为流程挖掘生态系统提供了将先前未利用的数据转化为可用事件日志的可行管道，有效扩展了流程挖掘在组织工作流研究中的应用可能性。

Abstract: Process mining (PM) provides a powerful framework for discovering and optimizing operational processes from event data. However, the efficacy of PM techniques is strictly predicated on the availability of structured event logs. Thus far, event logs have often been laboriously created by domain and process mining experts. This costly effort causes large portions of organizational knowledge, including incident tickets, manuals, and textual reports, to remain underutilized. We address this bottleneck by investigating the efficacy of Large Language Models (LLMs) as automated data translators. We propose a scalable framework that leverages LLMs as data translators to bridge the gap between unstructured textual resources and structured event data. We finetune LLMs on a newly created text-to-log dataset, demonstrating that the resulting models can extract high-fidelity event logs from unstructured resources. Our results show that this finetuning approach outperforms few-shot or zero-shot prompting by a large amount, highlighting finetuning as a necessary pre-condition for generating reliable event data. We conclude that our method provides a promising pipeline for making previously unused data available to process mining ecosystems, effectively expanding the possibilities of using PM to further investigate organizational workflows.

</details>


### [411] [LEAP: Likelihood Elicitation and Aggregation for LLM-based Probabilistic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01337)
*Yufei Chen,Yiran Zhao,Xiaogang Xu,Qipeng Xie,Jiafei Wu,Zhe Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LEAP（似然引导与聚合的预测框架），将LLM预测从"整体阅读全部证据后一次性输出"的Monolithic Prediction方式，重构为"逐条独立分析证据并提取似然参数，再通过显式先验和确定性概率模型聚合为后验分布"的流程，在预测、信息获取、浏览等基准任务上显著提升多数预测与校准指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的预测系统虽在搜索和工具使用上有所改进，但多数系统仍采用Monolithic Prediction设计——让LLM一次性读取全部证据并输出预测。这种方式存在两个问题：(1)难以追溯单个证据对最终结果的具体影响；(2)不同竞争结果之间的不确定性被混淆折叠，导致预测不透明且概率校准不佳。

Method: LEAP将预测阶段重组为三步：(1)逐条证据分别输入LLM，针对每条证据独立提取似然参数，描述该证据对目标事件各结果的蕴含；(2)建立显式先验分布；(3)通过确定性概率模型（贝叶斯聚合）将各似然与先验结合，求解得到后验分布。该流程支持连续、单选择和多项选择三类预测任务，并保持证据贡献的可复现性。作者构建了覆盖预测、信息获取和浏览任务的基准，并在自建agent loop及多个agent CLI框架上评估。

Result: 在相同证据条件下，LEAP在多个模型上显著改善了多数预测指标与校准指标，且在控制先验访问、推理预算和聚合方式的对照实验中表现依然更强。

Conclusion: LEAP通过将似然抽取与概率聚合解耦，提供了一种更具可解释性、可复现且概率校准更优的LLM预测范式，在各类agent框架中具有通用性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: LLM-based forecasting systems have improved on real-world tasks such as financial markets and sports outcomes, largely through stronger search and tool use. Many systems still ask an LLM to read all collected evidence together and produce the final forecast. We call this design Monolithic Prediction. It can obscure how individual evidence items affect the result and collapse uncertainty across competing outcomes. We propose LEAP (Likelihood Elicitation and Aggregation for Probabilistic forecasting), which reorganizes how collected evidence is used in the prediction stage. LEAP examines each evidence item separately and elicits likelihood parameters that describe its implications for the target. An explicit prior and a deterministic probabilistic model then combine these likelihoods into a posterior distribution. This procedure supports continuous, single-choice, and multi-choice forecasts while preserving reproducible evidence contributions. We build a benchmark covering forecasting, information-seeking, and browsing tasks, and evaluate LEAP on our own agent loop and several agent CLI frameworks. Given the same evidence, LEAP improves most prediction and calibration metrics across models and remains stronger under controlled comparisons of prior access, inference budget, and aggregation.

</details>


### [412] [SymFold: Synergizing Evolutionary and Structural Priors for Accurate Protein Inverse Folding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01353)
*Handong Wang,Jiaxin Qi,Baisheng Lai,Jianqiang Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种对称双路径架构，同时利用蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）的序列进化知识和多模态蛋白质语言模型（MPLMs）的结构知识，通过迭代指导来提升蛋白质逆折叠的性能，在多个基准上达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质逆折叠方法多采用串行流水线：结构编码器先预测粗序列，再由蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）进行后处理精修。然而PLMs只能做事后的序列编辑，其效果受限于上游预测质量。虽然多模态蛋白质语言模型（MPLMs）可以直接编码结构来生成序列，但实验发现它们对逆折叠任务并不有效。因此需要一个能同时利用两类模型优势的架构。

Method: 提出一种对称双路径（symmetric dual-path）架构，该架构一方面利用PLMs提供预训练的序列进化知识，另一方面利用MPLMs提供预训练的结构知识，两条路径以迭代的方式相互引导蛋白质序列的生成过程，而非传统的单向串行流水线。

Result: 在标准蛋白质逆折叠基准上取得了最先进（state-of-the-art）的性能，超越现有方法；消融实验验证了对称设计的合理性。

Conclusion: 对称双路径设计为蛋白质逆折叠提供了有前景的研究方向，通过均衡利用序列与结构两种模态的预训练知识，解决了传统串行方法中精修受限于上游预测的瓶颈问题。

Abstract: Protein inverse folding aims to recover amino acid sequences for a given 3D protein structure, underpinning broad applications such as enzyme engineering and drug discovery.Current methods often follow a serial pipeline, in which a structure encoder predicts a coarse sequence, which is then refined by protein language models (PLMs). However, because PLMs only perform post-hoc sequence edits, the refinement is bounded by the quality of upstream predictions.Thanks to recent multimodal protein language models (MPLMs), we could directly encode structure to generate sequences with pretrained structural knowledge, but we observe that they are not effective for inverse folding. Therefore, we introduce a symmetric dual-path architecture that both leverages PLMs for pretrained sequence evolution knowledge and MPLMs for pretrained structural knowledge to iteratively guide protein sequence generation.Through extensive experiments across standard protein inverse folding benchmarks, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior approaches, and ablation studies validate the rationale of our symmetric design, revealing a promising direction for the community.

</details>


### [413] [EDGE: Error Dependency Graph-Guided Multi-Error Attribution in Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01360)
*Jun Hou,Priya Pitre,Yi Fang,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EDGE是一个基于错误依赖图的LLM智能体多错误归因框架，它显式建模多个相关错误之间的依赖关系，通过两阶段LLM-as-judge检测器进行错误归因，并在TRAIL和MAST基准上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体的错误归因方法通常只识别单一责任主体、步骤或根因，但实际中智能体失败往往包含多个相互关联的错误，已有方法没有显式建模错误之间的依赖关系，导致归因不完整或不准确。

Method: EDGE框架首先从观察到的错误事件中构建错误依赖图，然后通过反事实回滚验证得到可靠的因果子图。推理阶段利用该图引导两阶段LLM-as-judge检测器进行多错误归因，干预验证后的子图进一步用于解释和修复分析。

Result: 在TRAIL和MAST基准上的实验表明，EDGE在大多数评估模型和设置下提升了类别级多错误归因表现。与Who&When风格提示的适配实验中，错误依赖图在不同提示策略下都能带来帮助。

Conclusion: 错误依赖结构可作为一种有效的诊断先验用于智能体失败分析，超越了孤立的根因预测方法，为多错误归因提供了更可靠的依据。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agent failures often contain multiple related errors rather than a single mistake. Existing attribution methods usually identify a responsible agent, step, or root cause, but do not explicitly model dependency between errors. We introduce EDGE, an Error Dependency Graph-guided multi-Error attribution framework. EDGE constructs an error dependency graph from observed error events and validates a reliable causal subset through counterfactual rollout. The inference graph guides a two-stage LLM-as-judge detector for error attribution, and the intervention-validated subgraph provides a more reliable basis for explanation and repair analysis. Experiments on TRAIL and MAST show that EDGE improves category-level multi-error attribution across most evaluated models and settings. Experiments with adapted Who&When-style prompts show that the graph helps across prompting strategies. These results suggest that dependency structure is a useful diagnostic prior for agent failures beyond isolated root-cause prediction.

</details>


### [414] [Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction (NeuSOGA): From Observations to Symbolic Mathematical Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01408)
*Qingde Li,Qingqi Hong,Jie Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuSOGA（神经符号几何抽象）框架，将几何观测逐步转化为拓扑抽象、几何抽象和符号数学表示，结合欧几里得距离变换、Segment Anything基础模型感知、自适应多尺度几何抽象和隐式面积样条符号合成，生成可解释、可编辑且显式可解析的数学模型表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统通过大规模统计学习获得出色感知能力，但知识编码在难以检查或操作分析的潜在参数中。受神经符号AI和人类抽象理论启发，论文旨在解决从观测到显式符号表示转换这一人工智能基础挑战。

Method: 提出NeuSOGA框架，采用渐进式抽象管线：(1)基于欧几里得距离变换的拓扑引导结构发现；(2)使用Segment Anything基础模型感知；(3)自适应多尺度几何抽象；(4)通过隐式面积样条进行符号综合。最终表示支持任意阶光滑性、加性组合和闭式求值。

Result: 在ModelNet40点云、任意视角投影和分割光学观测上的实验表明，NeuSOGA能将多种观测转换为紧凑的符号表示，同时跨感知模态和视角方向保留关键几何与拓扑结构。

Conclusion: NeuSOGA提供了一条从观测到符号的可解释、可说明的路径，区别于神经潜在编码，生成的表示保持可解释性、可编辑性和数学显式性。

Abstract: A fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence is the transformation of observations into explicit symbolic representations suitable for abstraction, interpretation, and reasoning. While modern AI systems achieve remarkable perceptual capabilities through large-scale statistical learning, the resulting knowledge is typically encoded within latent parameters that are difficult to inspect or manipulate analytically. Inspired by Neuro-Symbolic AI and theories of human abstraction, this paper investigates the formation of symbolic mathematical representations from geometric observations.
  We propose NeuSOGA (Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction), a framework that progressively transforms observations into topological abstractions, geometric abstractions, and ultimately symbolic mathematical representations. The architecture combines topology-guided structural discovery using Euclidean Distance Transforms, foundation-model perception using Segment Anything, adaptive multi-scale geometric abstraction, and symbolic synthesis through Implicit Area Splines.
  The resulting representation is an analytical implicit model supporting arbitrary-order smoothness, additive composition, and closed-form evaluation. Unlike neural latent encodings, the generated representation remains interpretable, editable, and mathematically explicit. Experiments on ModelNet40 point clouds, arbitrary-view projections, and segmented optical observations demonstrate that NeuSOGA transforms diverse observations into compact symbolic representations while preserving essential geometric and topological structure across sensing modalities and viewing directions.
  NeuSOGA provides an interpretable and explainable pathway from observation to symbol and establishes

</details>


### [415] [A survey of AI-generated voices and their detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15411)
*Chengzhe Sun,Tianle Yang,Siwei Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文全面综述了AI语音生成与检测方法，涵盖技术基础与最新进展，并指出开放挑战、基准资源和未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI语音生成技术发展迅速，既能用于无障碍工具、虚拟助手等有益场景，也能被滥用进行模仿、欺诈和虚假信息传播。近期针对企业和政治领袖的语音克隆诈骗事件凸显了建立稳健防护措施的紧迫性。与图像和视频深度伪造不同，合成语音检测因语音学、韵律和听觉感知的复杂性而面临独特挑战，因此需要系统的综述来整合现有知识与方法。

Method: 本文采用综述研究方法，系统梳理AI语音生成与检测两大方向，涵盖技术基础（如语音学、韵律、听觉感知等理论基础）与最新最先进的研究进展，同时收集并归纳基准资源，分析开放挑战。

Result: 文章提供了AI语音生成与检测方法的全面概览，明确了该领域区别于图像/视频深度伪造检测的独特挑战，并整合了相关基准数据集与开放问题。

Conclusion: 作者期望该综述能够为未来研究者在语音克隆防护和深度伪造检测领域提供有价值的参考框架，帮助推动更可靠的保障措施。

Abstract: The ability of artificial intelligence (AI) models to generate highly realistic human voices has advanced rapidly. These technologies power accessibility tools, virtual assistants and creative applications, but they also enable harmful uses, including impersonation, fraud and disinformation. Recent incidents of voice cloning scams targeting businesses and political leaders underscore the urgent need for robust safeguards. Unlike image and video deepfakes, the detection of synthetic voices poses unique challenges due to the complexity of phonetics, prosody and auditory perception. This survey offers a comprehensive overview of AI voice generation and detection methods, encompassing both the technical foundations and the latest state-of-the-art advances. This study also identifies key open challenges, benchmark resources and future directions to make this survey useful for future researchers.

</details>


### [416] [EdiTikZ: Scientific Figure Editing from Revision Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01409)
*Christian Greisinger,Zhixue Zhao,Steffen Eger*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DaEdiTikZ，首个大规模修订来源的科学图表编辑数据集（391K TikZ编辑对，781K指令），并训练紧凑的EdiTikZ模型（4B和9B），通过联合学习重建与编辑及RL优化，使9B模型在自动和人工评估中超越GPT-5.6-Sol，与Gemini-3.1-Pro相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在从文本或图像生成科学图表方面表现优异，但生成出版级图表需要迭代细化，而科学图表编辑这一重要任务尚未被充分探索。现有方法依赖昂贵的专有智能体系统、主要聚焦于评估，或基于合成生成的编辑构建训练监督，缺乏自然、可扩展的监督信号。

Method: (1) 从arXiv、GitHub和TeX SE中挖掘391K个自然的TikZ编辑对（基于真实的科学修订与开发轨迹）；(2) 使用VLM在渲染图和TikZ代码条件下推断781K条有向编辑指令；(3) 构建人工精炼的基准DaEdiTikZ-Bench（790个实例）；(4) 训练两个基于Qwen3.5的紧凑EdiTikZ模型（4B和9B），联合学习重建与编辑，再通过强化学习（RL）施加渲染保真度和编辑应用的互补奖励进行优化。

Result: 自动评估中9B模型超越所有测试基线；人工评估（9名标注者，4,320个评分）中表现优于GPT-5.6-Sol，与Gemini-3.1-Pro相当；在严重的分布外（OOD）偏移下，在接近2K训练序列长度的场景中仍与GPT-5.6-Sol保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 利用自然发生的科学修订轨迹作为可扩展监督信号是有效的，能够在紧凑模型规模下达到甚至超越专有大型模型的科学图表编辑能力，展示了开源模型在该任务上的潜力。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in generating scientific figures from text or images. However, producing publication-ready figures requires iterative refinement, making scientific figure editing an important yet largely unexplored task. Existing approaches rely on costly proprietary agentic systems, focus primarily on evaluation, or construct training supervision from synthetically generated edits. Instead, we leverage naturally occurring scientific revision and development trajectories as a scalable source of supervision. To this end, we introduce DaEdiTikZ, the first large-scale dataset of revision-derived scientific figure edits, constructed by mining 391K plausible TikZ edit pairs from arXiv, GitHub, and TeX SE and inferring 781K directed edit instructions with a VLM conditioned on rendered figures and TikZ code. We further introduce DaEdiTikZ-Bench, a human-refined benchmark with 790 instances, and train two compact Qwen3.5-based EdiTikZ models (4B and 9B) by jointly learning reconstruction and editing, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) with complementary rewards for rendered fidelity and edit application. Automatic evaluation places our 9B model above all tested baselines, while human evaluation with 9 annotators and 4,320 ratings places it above GPT-5.6-Sol and on par with Gemini-3.1-Pro. Under severe out-of-distribution shifts, it remains competitive with GPT-5.6-Sol near its 2K training sequence-length regime. Models and datasets will be released.

</details>


### [417] [Parsing the Stream: A Live Trace Model for Long-Horizon Agents and Their Observers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01466)
*Egor Pakhomov,Erik Nijkamp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种活体追踪（live trace）模型：将自增事件账本增量折叠为类型化运行状态，并编译为面向不同消费者（人类观察者与智能体本身）的视图。实验表明，对观察者侧（以LLM作为代理），编译视图相比预算受限的原始追踪单次读取，可减少约14-15倍输入token、降低5-7倍成本，并显著提升准确率（0.85-0.87 vs 0.48）；对智能体侧，在120步顺序依赖任务中，维护运行统计量的机制在完整上下文提示失败的情况下依然成功（30/30 vs 8/30）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体的运行轨迹规模超出了两类消费者的处理能力：人类观察者无法有效监控超长轨迹，而智能体自身的有限上下文窗口也难以容纳全部轨迹。需要一个模型将持续增长的轨迹高效地回折（fold）到可消费的状态中。

Method: 提出活体追踪模型：（1）采用追加式事件账本作为底层记录；（2）增量地将事件折叠为类型化运行状态；（3）将该状态编译为面向不同消费者的定制视图。在观察者侧使用LLM读者作为代理评估；在智能体侧采用维护运行统计量的每步状态机制，并与完整上下文提示、提示级草稿本（scratchpad）及双臂分解方法进行比较。

Result: 观察者侧：编译视图以约14x和15x的token缩减（按读者计），5-7x的成本降低，取得更高准确率（0.85-0.87 vs 0.48）。智能体侧：在120步链路任务上维护运行统计量的机制30/30成功，而完整上下文提示仅8/30；提示级草稿本在更低成本下匹配折叠的准确率。双臂分解表明折叠的准确率源于其确定性聚合，成本优势源于其紧凑性。

Conclusion: 折叠方法相对更便宜的替代方案（如提示级草稿本）的剩余价值在于可审计性和为观察者提供服务的单源同构能力。作者从观察到的失败中提炼出十一条候选需求，并通过一个顺序敏感任务族划定折叠有效性的边界，证明当任务对顺序敏感时折叠的效用会消失。

Abstract: A long-horizon agent's trace outgrows both of its consumers: the human observer monitoring the run, and the agent itself, whose bounded context the trace must be folded back into. We present a live trace model, an append-only event ledger folded incrementally into typed run state and compiled into per-consumer views, and evaluate it for both consumers against deterministic ground truth. For the observer side, evaluated with an LLM reader as proxy, the compiled view answers monitoring questions using approximately 14x and 15x fewer input tokens (by reader) and at 5-7x lower cost than a budget-capped single-call reading of the raw trace, with higher accuracy (0.85-0.87 versus 0.48). Because the questions were co-designed with the view schema, we treat the token and cost reduction, conditional on schema coverage, as the transferable result. For the agent, on 120-link sequential-dependency tasks, mechanisms that maintain the task's running statistic in per-step state succeed where full-context prompting fails (30/30 versus 8/30 under a clean protocol, n=30, labeled descriptive owing to benchmark-system co-development); a prompt-level scratchpad matches the fold's accuracy at lower cost, and a two-arm decomposition attributes the fold's accuracy to its deterministic aggregate and its cost advantage to its compactness. The fold's remaining value over cheaper alternatives is deterministic auditability and serving the observer from the same state. We derive eleven candidate requirements for trace folding from observed failures and delimit them with an order-sensitive task family on which the fold ceases to help. Code, benchmarks, a regenerable synthetic corpus, and all workbench traces are released.

</details>


### [418] [Harness-of-Harness: Multi-Day Autonomous Software Development with Continual Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01481)
*Haoyang Yan,Min-le Su,Hangfan Zhang,Zhanhao Li,Chen Zhang,Shao Zhang,Yang Chen,Lei Bai,Shuyue Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HoH（Harness-of-Harness）框架，使基于LLM的编码智能体能在无人工干预下自主开发完整、可用且高质量的软件系统。HoH通过将已有编码智能体harness的执行组织为迭代式"规划-编码-测试"循环，持续改进软件。在GameCraft-Bench、FrontierSWE和ProgramBench三个基准上，HoH以三种harness-模型组合平均提升52.25%、最大提升82.86%，并在多日部署（70+次迭代）中自主开发出一款具有连贯剧情、完整核心机制、可玩且包含音画的一人称射击游戏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM编码智能体虽能将高层需求转化为软件，但长期自主开发中往往缺乏自我持续改进能力，难以在无人干预下产出真正完整、功能良好且可用的软件系统。作者旨在解决自主软件开发中智能体如何在多轮迭代中可持续提升软件质量的问题。

Method: HoH作为一个元框架（meta-framework），不重新构建编码harness，而是作用于已有harness之上，将其执行组织为迭代的"规划-编码-测试"循环。其关键设计包括：在循环中平衡缺陷修复（repair）与能力增长（capability growth）；将开发拆分为小而可验证的增量；将实现期测试与独立评估分离；通过约束可验证的输出（而非规定智能体工作流程）来引导开发。此外，HoH渐进式地暴露可交付物、角色特定工具和技能，鼓励复用而非重新创造，并维护版本化的项目历史，从而在多轮迭代中支撑持续改进。

Result: 在GameCraft-Bench、FrontierSWE和ProgramBench三个基准上，对三种harness-模型组合（Codex+GPT-5.5、OpenCode+DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Pi+MiniMax-M3）进行测试，HoH一致优于对应的独立harness，三次迭代后平均相对提升52.25%，最大提升82.86%。多日部署（超过70次迭代）中，HoH自主开发出一款带连贯故事线、完整核心机制、人类可玩、视觉精美且集成音频的第一人称射击游戏。

Conclusion: HoH验证了通过对已有harness进行高层编排（而非替换）即可显著增强LLM编码智能体在长期自主软件开发中的能力与输出质量，是一种通用性强、可组合性好且易于复用的自主软件开发范式。该框架及示例游戏均开源发布。

Abstract: This paper studies autonomous software development, in which LLM-based coding agents transform high-level requirements into complete, functional, and usable software systems without human intervention. We introduce Harness-of-Harness (HoH), a framework that enables coding agents to continually improve software during autonomous development. HoH operates on existing coding-agent harnesses, and organizes their executions into iterative planning-coding-testing loops. To sustain improvement across loops, HoH balances repair with capability growth, scopes development into small and verifiable increments, separates implementation-time testing from independent evaluation, and constrains verifiable outputs rather than prescribing agent workflows. It progressively exposes deliverables, role-specific tools, and skills, encourages reuse rather than recreation, and maintains versioned project histories. On GameCraft-Bench, FrontierSWE, and ProgramBench, three harness-model pairs (Codex with GPT-5.5, OpenCode with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Pi with MiniMax-M3), HoH consistently outperforms the corresponding standalone harnesses, achieving an average relative gain of 52.25 percent and a maximum gain of 82.86 percent after three iterations. In a multi-day deployment with more than 70 iterations, HoH autonomously develops a first-person-shooter game, featuring a coherent storyline, fully implemented core mechanics, human-playable experience, polished visuals and integrated audio. Github: https://github.com/Flesymeb/HarnessOfHarness Project Page: https://flesymeb.github.io/HarnessOfHarness/

</details>


### [419] [When Guardrails Look Effective: Construct Validity Failures in LLM Agent Commerce Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01519)
*Peiying Zhu,Sidi Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文审计了由语言模型代理构成的模拟市场中政策评估的构念效度问题。通过一个可配置的多轮酒店交易买卖双方测试平台，作者发现初始实现报告的护栏福利增益(+87.4/+35.0/+28.8)在固定方案和选择程序后大幅缩小(+7.2/-13.9/+23.8)，多次生成后效应趋于不显著，且卖家激励检查呈非单调性。脚本化阳性对照进一步表明，利润最大化卖家已能达到最优福利，护栏主要起再分配和降低福利的作用。作者提出构念效度契约（涵盖激励效度、协议隔离、随机稳定性和福利核算四方面），判定原始估计在协议隔离下INVALID，受控研究在激励效度和随机稳定性下仍为INCONCLUSIVE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式模拟越来越多地用语言模型代理来评估市场政策，但模型的输出看起来像经济结果，却可能并未真正实例化声称的行为，导致政策评估的结论在构念层面无效。作者希望审计并系统化这种"看似经济结果实则未经验证"的风险。

Method: 构建可配置酒店交易的多轮买卖双方测试平台，系统性地在对照组与护栏组间隔离变量（保持offer schema和买方案选择程序固定），对Qwen2.5 1.5B-14B梯度的模型逐次生成并分析残差；同时设计脚本化阳性对照（利润最大化卖家与被迫低效捆绑的卖家），并引入卖家激励非单调性测试，最终建立四维构念效度契约（激励效度、协议隔离、随机稳定性、福利核算）作为报告标准。

Result: 初始报告的护栏福利增益(+87.4/+35.0/+28.8)在协议隔离后变为(+7.2/-13.9/+23.8)；大规模模型单次生成平均效应+229，三次生成后降至+37.6（95% CI [-34.2, 109.3]），生成残差解释了49.9%的方法间变异。卖家激励呈非单调性：增加利润压力反而比默认提示产生更少利润。阳性对照显示利润最大化卖家已达第一最优福利，护栏主要减少福利，仅在卖家被强制低效捆绑时才创造福利。

Conclusion: 原福利估算在协议隔离标准下判定为INVALID，受控研究在激励效度和随机稳定性标准下仍为INCONCLUSIVE。案例不表明护栏无效，而是表明在模拟代理与协议通过构念效度检查之前，其表面价值无法被识别。作者呼吁采用构念效度契约作为此类研究的前置报告规范。

Abstract: Interactive simulations increasingly evaluate policies in markets populated by language-model agents. Their outputs can look economic---prices, profits, consumer surplus, and welfare---without instantiating the behavior named in the claim. We audit this risk in a multi-turn buyer--seller testbed for configurable hotel transactions. An initial implementation reported welfare gains from two marketplace guardrails of +87.4, +35.0, and +28.8 across a Qwen2.5 1.5B--14B ladder. It also gave guarded and unguarded agents different offer schemas and choice procedures. Holding the schema and buyer chooser fixed changes the paired contrasts to +7.2, -13.9, and +23.8. The four largest 14B single-generation effects averaged +229; after three generations per profile-condition, they averaged +37.6 (95% bootstrap interval [-34.2, 109.3]), while generation residuals account for 49.9% of variation in this post-hoc probe. A seller-incentive check is non-monotone: increasing profit pressure produces less profit than the default seller prompt. Scripted positive controls show why this matters. A profit-maximizing seller already attains first-best welfare, so guardrails mostly redistribute and reduce welfare; they create welfare only when the seller is explicitly programmed to force inefficient bundles. We contribute a construct-validity contract separating incentive validity, protocol isolation, stochastic stability, and welfare accounting, and returning INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE before substantive policy claims. In our case, the original estimate is INVALID under protocol isolation, while the controlled study remains INCONCLUSIVE under incentive validity and stochastic stability. The case does not show that guardrails are ineffective; it shows their apparent value is unidentified until the simulated agents and protocol pass these checks.

</details>


### [420] [EvoSCM: Scientific Belief Revision Through Causal Model Evolution and Experimentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01526)
*Qing Zhao,Haowei Li,Weijian Deng,Pengxu Wei,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EvoSCM，一种赋予科学智能体显式结构因果模型（SCM）并使其随实验证据不断进化的方法，在DiscoverPhysics基准上取得了优于基线的一致性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM科学智能体以自由文本表达科学假设，导致其信念隐含且难以测试与修正，缺乏显式、可演化的因果建模机制。

Method: EvoSCM维护一个竞争性的SCM假设种群，每个SCM编码候选因果解释；通过闭环发现循环进化：反演（从累积证据归纳潜在机制）、设计判别性干预、承诺可证伪的预测并通过实验检验；预测与观察的偏差被归纳蒸馏为修正规则以更新因果结构与机制，随后演绎验证修订后的种群并进入下一轮。

Result: 在DiscoverPhysics基准（要求智能体通过实验揭示非标准物理世界的隐藏动力学）上，EvoSCM较基线持续提升科学发现性能，产生更准确的解释与预测，且更有效地利用实验交互。

Conclusion: 显式的、可进化的结构化因果模型能够帮助科学智能体更好地形成、测试和修正科学信念，提升科学发现的准确性与实验效率。

Abstract: Scientific agents must learn not only how to reason, but also what to believe. However, existing LLM agents typically express scientific hypotheses in free-form text, leaving their beliefs implicit and difficult to test or revise. We introduce EvoSCM, which equips scientific agents with explicit structural causal models that evolve as new experimental evidence is collected. EvoSCM maintains a population of competing SCM hypotheses, each encoding a candidate causal explanation of the environment, and evolves them through a closed discovery loop. In each round, the agent abduces latent mechanisms from accumulated evidence, designs discriminative interventions, and commits to falsifiable predictions that it tests through experimentation. Discrepancies between prediction and observation are inductively distilled into correction rules that revise the causal structures and mechanisms of each hypothesis, and the agent then deductively validates the revised population against accumulated evidence and structural consistency to guide the next round. We evaluate EvoSCM on DiscoverPhysics, a benchmark requiring agents to uncover the hidden dynamics of noncanonical physical worlds through experimentation. EvoSCM consistently improves scientific discovery over baselines, yielding more accurate explanations and predictions while making more effective use of experimental interactions.

</details>


### [421] [Can LLMs Discover Scientific Laws in Real and Parallel Worlds?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01552)
*Yiming Huang,Ziche Liu,Zhuohang Wu,Yiqian Wang,Junxia Cui,Xinkai Zou,Linjun Mao,Nan Huang,Naicheng Yu,Kaijie Zhu,Yue Ma,Kun Zhou,Letian Peng,Jingbo Shang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SCILAWS-BENCH，一个基于已发表论文和真实科学数据构建的科学定律发现基准，包含118个问题、381篇论文、291条候选定律和约800万真实数据点，覆盖六个学科。基准通过两个互补设定（SCILAWS-REAL和SCILAWS-PARALLEL）分别评估模型从固定观测中提出定律的能力与主动查询世界恢复综合合成隐藏定律的能力，揭示了预测拟合与科学有效性可能不一致、记忆化影响模型是否复制或超越已发表公式，以及最佳N采样的选择瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学定律发现评估要么使用简化合成设置，要么复用可能已被LLM记住的公开目标，无法真正评测AI能否发现新的科学定律以及应如何评测这种能力。

Method: 从381篇已发表论文构建118个问题任务，涵盖291条候选定律和约800万真实数据点、六个学科。每个问题实例化为两个互补设置：SCILAWS-REAL要求模型从固定真实观测中提出定律，评估保留数据预测拟合度和源自文献的科学有效性；SCILAWS-PARALLEL要求模型主动查询残差校准的世界并恢复源自已发表形式的合成隐藏定律，以分别评测固定记录定律发现与主动合成隐藏定律恢复。

Result: 研究发现：预测拟合度可能偏离科学有效性；记忆化决定模型是复制还是超越已发表公式；最优N采样研究暴露出选择瓶颈。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个论文支撑的基准以及评估AI科学发现的新实证视角。

Abstract: Scientific equation discovery has long been central to scientific progress, proceeding through iterative cycles of hypothesis generation, observational testing, and refinement under scientific constraints. As LLM capabilities advance and their role in AI for Science expands, it remains an open problem whether they can genuinely discover scientific laws and how this ability should be evaluated. Existing evaluations, however, often either simplify discovery through synthetic settings or reuse published targets that may already be familiar to LLMs. We therefore introduce SCILAWS-BENCH, a benchmark for scientific law discovery built from published research and real scientific data. It comprises 118 problems drawn from 381 scientific papers, covering 291 candidate laws and roughly 8M real data points across six scientific disciplines. Each problem is instantiated in two complementary settings: (1) SCILAWS-REAL asks models to propose laws from fixed real observations and evaluates held-out predictive fit and scientific validity derived from the source literature, and (2) SCILAWS-PARALLEL asks models to actively query residual-calibrated worlds and recover synthesized hidden laws derived from published forms. This two-setting task design preserves each problem's scientific context while separately evaluating fixed-record law discovery and active recovery of a newly synthesized hidden law. We find that predictive fit can diverge from scientific validity, memorization shapes whether models reproduce or move beyond published formulas, and our best-of-N study reveals a selection bottleneck. Our work provides a paper-grounded benchmark and new empirical perspectives for evaluating AI for scientific discovery. Project page: https://yiyihum.github.io/SciLaws-Bench

</details>


### [422] [Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy: Learning Autonomous Policies from Imperfect VLM Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01567)
*Matteo Merler,Giovanni Bonetta,Davide Zago,Rossella Cancelliere,Bernardo Magnini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SAGE框架，利用VLM作为在线、昂贵但不完美的教师，仅在学习者不确定时查询VLM，并通过优势加权将教师建议蒸馏到轻量级RL策略中。在稀疏奖励的视觉推理和导航任务中，SAGE学到的策略在部署时不需VLM引导，且在多个环境中优于无引导RL，甚至超越VLM教师本身，同时大幅减少VLM调用次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM虽然为交互式决策提供有用的先验，但直接将其用作策略存在三个问题：每步查询成本高、无法从环境交互中改进、可能重复系统性错误。因此需要一种方法，能从在线的、昂贵的、不完美但有信息的VLM教师中学习一个廉价的自主策略。

Method: SAGE框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 选择性查询——仅在学习者不确定（基于熵）时查询VLM教师；(2) 训练时执行教师建议的动作；(3) 利用环境导出的优势值对教师动作进行加权蒸馏，而非将教师所有建议等同对待，从而过滤不可靠的教师指导，将知识蒸馏到轻量级RL策略中。

Result: 在稀疏奖励视觉推理和导航任务上，SAGE学到的策略在评估时无需VLM引导即可行动。在多个环境中优于无引导RL，甚至在某些设置下超越其VLM教师。选择性引导在VLM能帮助探索高奖励轨迹时最有益，而在无引导探索已成功或教师动作无法带来信息性经验时益处有限。SAGE仅在一小部分训练步骤中提示教师，部署时零VLM调用，大幅降低VLM使用成本。

Conclusion: VLM不必被用作固定策略才具有价值；它们可以充当临时的、不完美的指导来源，其价值通过环境交互被检验并内化到轻量级策略中。选择性指导策略为利用大型预训练模型进行交互式决策提供了高效、可扩展的新范式。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide useful priors for interactive decision-making, but using them directly as policies is expensive and brittle: they must be queried at every step, do not improve from environment interaction, and can repeat systematic errors. We study how to learn a cheap autonomous policy from an online, expensive, and imperfect but informative VLM teacher. We propose SAGE (Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy), a framework that queries a VLM only when the learner is uncertain, executes the suggested action during training, and distills guidance into a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy. Because VLM advice is not always reliable, SAGE can weight teacher-action distillation using environment-derived advantages rather than treating all suggestions as equally useful. Across sparse-reward visual reasoning and navigation tasks, SAGE learns policies that act without VLM guidance at evaluation time and improves over unguided RL in several environments, including settings where the learned policy exceeds its VLM teacher. The results show that selective guidance is most beneficial when the VLM can help the agent discover high-reward trajectories, and less useful when unguided exploration already succeeds or teacher actions do not lead to informative experience. SAGE also reduces VLM usage by prompting the teacher only on a fraction of training steps and requiring no VLM calls at deployment. Overall, our results suggest that VLMs don't need to be used as fixed policies to be useful; they can instead act as temporary, imperfect sources of guidance whose value is tested and internalized through interaction.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [423] [Inverse kinematic solution for generic 3R positional robots using Conformal Geometric Algebra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00311)
*Abhilash Nayak,Durgesh Haribhau Salunkhe*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文利用共形几何代数(CGA)研究3R机器人的逆运动学模型，通过将问题重构为两个圆的交点，直接获得关于theta_2的一元多项式，无需消去theta_1和theta_3，为逆运动学解提供了新的几何洞察。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3R机器人逆运动学通常通过代数方法求解特定方程组，虽然已有几何解释将其描述为一对圆锥曲线的交点，但这些解释局限于关节空间域，缺乏更深层的几何洞察。

Method: 利用共形几何代数(CGA)的优势来研究3R机器人的逆运动学模型，将逆运动学问题重构为两个圆的交点（CGA中的基本元素），从而直接得到以theta_2为变量的单变量多项式，避免了通过消元theta_1和theta_3来求解的传统步骤。

Result: 该方法直接导出了一个关于theta_2的单变量多项式，无需传统代数方法中消除theta_1和theta_3的步骤，将逆运动学解的几何本质简化为两个圆的交集问题。

Conclusion: 通过CGA框架，3R机器人逆运动学获得了比先前仅在关节空间域中圆锥曲线相交解释更深刻的几何理解，展示了代数框架在机器人运动学分析中的优势。

Abstract: The inverse kinematics of generic 3R robots has been investigated through multiple approaches, mainly algebraic methods involving the solution of certain equation sets. Previous geometric interpretations of the solution, characterized as the intersection of a pair of conics have been confined to the joint-space domain. In this article, we study the Inverse Kinematic Model (IKM) of 3R robots, using the advantages of Conformal Geometric Algebra (CGA) to provide further insights on its kinematic properties. Our approach directly yields a univariate polynomial in terms of theta_2 without the need to eliminate theta_1 and theta_3 by reframing the problem as the intersection of two circles, which are fundamental elements within this algebraic framework.

</details>


### [424] [Geometric analysis of generic 3R robots, and necessary and sufficient conditions for a class of orthogonal robots to have four IKS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00316)
*Durgesh Haribhau Salunkhe,Abhilash Nayak*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种融合代数与几何方法的通用框架，基于共形几何代数推导的逆运动学模型，对通用3R机器人的运动学进行分析，研究其四组逆运动学解（IKS）的存在条件及在工作空间中的分布，并针对正交机器人一类给出了充要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去对3R机器人运动学分析中，代数方法虽然结果确切但局限于特殊类型或架构简化，几何方法虽能推广到通用机器人并提供直观理解，两者各有优劣。作者希望结合两者优点，实现对通用3R机器人更全面的运动学分析。

Method: 利用基于共形几何代数（CGA）的方法推导3R机器人的逆运动学模型，在此基础上构建通用框架来研究3R机器人存在四组逆运动学解（IKS）的必要与充分条件，并分析IKS在工作空间中的分布特性；对一类正交机器人给出充要条件。

Result: 提出了研究通用3R机器人四组IKS存在条件及分布情况的通用框架，并成功对特定类别的正交机器人给出了充分的充要条件。

Conclusion: 通过融合共形几何代数的解析能力与几何直觉，所提出的框架能有效推广到通用3R机器人，弥补了纯代数方法的局限，并为后续机器人运动学分类与设计提供了理论工具。

Abstract: The kinematic analysis of a generic 3R robot has been investigated with multiple approaches in the past. The algebraic approaches have established concrete results but are unfortunately limited to special classes or architectural simplifications. Geometric approaches on the other hand have extended the analysis to generic robots while also providing an intuitive understanding of their kinematic properties. We use the best of both approaches to present the kinematic analysis of a generic 3R robot, using the inverse kinematic model inherited from a method based on conformal geometric algebra. The paper discusses a generic framework to study the conditions for a 3R robot to have four inverse kinematic solutions (IKS) and allows to study the distribution of IKS as seen in workspace. The necessary and sufficient conditions for a class of orthogonal robots are presented using the proposed approach.

</details>


### [425] [Scene Graph-based Driving Scenario Extraction for Automotive Egocentric Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00333)
*Stefan Ramdhan,Kyanna Dagenais,Vera Pantelic,Victor Bandur,Mark Lawford*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种利用场景图（Scene Graphs）和线性时序逻辑（LTL）从未标注的真实世界传感器数据流中自动提取自动驾驶场景的方法。通过处理以自我为中心的传感器数据和HD地图生成场景图序列，使用LTL形式化描述感兴趣的场景，并借助现成的模型检查器评估LTL公式，从而从大规模数据集中提取场景实例。该方法在Argoverse 2数据集（850条15秒真实驾驶日志）和行车记录仪视频上进行了验证，并与基于规则标注的基准进行了对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从无标注的真实世界传感器数据流中提取场景是自动驾驶系统开发中的关键但具有挑战性的任务。自动从大型数据集中定位关键场景的时间和空间位置，能够支持基于场景的覆盖率分析，从而提高自动驾驶系统的测试和验证效率。

Method: 该方法首先处理以自我为中心的传感器数据和HD地图，生成表示驾驶场景的场景图序列；然后使用LTL形式化指定感兴趣的驾驶场景；最后使用现成的模型检查器评估LTL公式是否满足场景图序列，从而提取出所有符合条件的场景实例。该方法同时适用于模拟数据和真实世界数据。

Result: 该方法在Argoverse 2的训练和验证数据集（包含850条15秒的真实驾驶日志）以及若干行车记录仪视频上进行了评估，通过与基于轨迹标注和HD地图的规则基准进行对比，验证了其提取和查询场景的有效性。

Conclusion: 基于场景图和LTL形式化的方法能够有效且灵活地从大规模未标注的真实世界驾驶数据中自动提取场景，为自动驾驶系统的场景化覆盖率分析提供了可靠支撑，兼顾了形式化验证的严谨性与实际数据处理的可行性。

Abstract: Extracting scenarios from unlabelled real-world sensor data streams is a critical but challenging task in the development process of automated driving systems (ADS). Automatically sifting through large datasets to spatially and temporally locate critical scenarios can enable scenario-based coverage analysis of ADS datasets. In this paper, we present a method for extracting scenarios from egocentric datasets using scene graphs and Linear Temporal Logic (LTL). We first process egocentric sensor data and HD maps to generate a sequence of scene graphs representing a driving scenario. Next, we use LTL to formally specify driving scenarios of interest, then extract all instances of the scenarios from the dataset using an off-the-shelf model checker, which evaluates the LTL formula against the sequence of scene graphs. Our approach can be used on both simulated and real world datasets. We evaluate the method on the training and validation datasets from Argoverse 2 consisting of 850 15-second real-world driving logs, and several videos of dashcam footage. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for extracting and querying scenarios by evaluating against a rule-based benchmark based on track annotations and HD maps.

</details>


### [426] [Risk-Aware Decision-Making for Autonomous Overtaking: A World Model-Based Mixture-of-Experts Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00385)
*Yongzhi Liu,Sunan Zhang,Jinchang Xu,Jiawei Wang,Yushu Qiu,Chen Lv,Weichao Zhuang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于世界模型的风险感知混合专家框架（WM-RMoE），用于自动驾驶高速公路超车场景中的前瞻性决策，通过对多步轨迹级风险累积评估和动态专家协调机制，解决了标准安全强化学习方法中隐式价值估计无法准确捕获长期风险传播的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准的安全强化学习方法通常依赖隐式的基于值的风险估计，而非显式的动力学建模，难以准确捕获多步时域上复杂的风险传播，容易产生"局部安全但长期隐含重大风险"的行为，因此需要一种能够进行前瞻性多步风险评估的决策框架。

Method: WM-RMoE框架包含三个核心组件：（1）学习到的潜在动力学模型支持并行多步rollout，将安全评估从动作级提升到轨迹级，通过累积风险评价实现超越评估；（2）分层门控机制在长时域、短时域和基于规则的安全模块之间动态协调专家，增强在不同交互强度下的鲁棒性；（3）集成高斯混合模型以保持多模态机动分支，缓解行为模式平均化问题。

Result: 实验结果表明，WM-RMoE在安全合规性、决策稳定性和泛化能力方面显著优于代表性基线；此外，得益于风险感知的公式化设计，该框架能够在不同交通密度下生成具有前瞻性和语义上可区分的超车机动。

Conclusion: 通过将风险评估从动作级扩展到轨迹级并结合动态专家协调机制，WM-RMoE有效提升了自动驾驶超车决策的前瞻性与安全性，能够在复杂交通环境中生成语义多样的安全超车策略。

Abstract: Autonomous highway overtaking demands foresighted decision-making to handle complex interactions, stochastic traffic evolution, and temporal risk accumulation. However, standard safe reinforcement learning approaches typically rely on implicit value-based risk estimations rather than explicit dynamics modeling, thereby struggling to accurately capture complex risk propagation over multi-step horizons. This limitation frequently results in behaviors that are locally safe but induce substantial latent risks in the long term. To address this, a World Model-based Risk-aware Mixture-of-Experts (WM-RMoE) framework is proposed. First, a learned latent dynamics model facilitates parallel multi-step rollouts, elevating safety assessment from the action level to the trajectory level via cumulative risk evaluation. Second, to enhance robustness under varying interaction intensities, a hierarchical gating mechanism dynamically coordinates experts across long-horizon, short-horizon, and rule-based safety modules. Furthermore, a Gaussian Mixture Model is integrated to preserve multimodal maneuvering branches, thereby mitigating the issue of behavioral mode averaging. Experimental results demonstrate that WM-RMoE significantly outperforms representative baselines in terms of safety compliance, decision stability, and generalization capability. Furthermore, benefiting from the risk-aware formulation, the proposed framework uniquely exhibits the ability to generate foresighted and semantically distinct overtaking maneuvers across diverse traffic densities.

</details>


### [427] [Beyond Object Selection:Markerless Gaze-based Robot Placement at Arbitrary Position](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00478)
*Yuzhi Lai,William Marx,Shenghai Yuan,Peizheng Li,Zhuoyu Ran,Andreas Zell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向凝视操控的跨设备对齐框架，引入了基于图结构的参考选择方法（GBRS）和新的任务级评估指标——凝视-表面交点误差（GSIE），并通过统一的协议对多种对齐管线进行基准测试，证明传统姿态指标评价良好的对齐方法在任务级精度上未必最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于凝视的辅助操控通常只支持物体选择，而任意位置放置需要头显与机器人之间的精确空间对齐。然而，姿态精度并不必然转化为任务精度：平移和旋转误差会共同影响转换后的凝视光线，并可能相互抵消。因此需要从任务导向的视角研究跨设备对齐问题。

Method: 1) 提出无标记交互框架及专门的跨设备数据集；2) 提出基于图的参考选择（Graph-based Reference Selection）以解决稀疏机器人参考问题；3) 引入凝视-表面交点误差（GSIE）直接度量凝视指定目标的空间误差；4) 在统一协议下开发和基准测试多种任务特定的对齐管线。

Result: 实验表明，在传统姿态指标上排名靠前的对齐方法在GSIE指标下并不总是最优，证明了凝视操控需要在任务层面进行评估的重要性。

Conclusion: 凝视操控系统的对齐评估应采用任务级指标（如GSIE）而非仅依赖传统姿态度量，以真实反映操控任务的准确性。

Abstract: Gaze-based assistive manipulation typically supports object selection, while arbitrary-position placement requires accurate spatial alignment between the headset and robot. However, for gaze-based manipulation, pose accuracy does not necessarily translate into task accuracy: translational and rotational errors jointly affect the transformed gaze ray and may compensate for each other. To study cross-device alignment from this task-oriented perspective, we present a markerless interaction framework and a dedicated cross-device dataset. We propose Graph-based Reference Selection to address sparse robot references. We further develop and benchmark multiple task-specific alignment pipelines under a unified protocol. Specifically, we introduce Gaze--Surface Intersection Error (GSIE), which directly measures the spatial error of the gaze-specified target. Experiments show that alignment methods ranked highly by conventional pose metrics are not always optimal in GSIE, demonstrating the importance of evaluating gaze-based manipulation at the task level.

</details>


### [428] [Exploring Nonlinear Body Oscillations for Natural Quadruped Gaits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00539)
*Annika Schmidt,Davide Calzolari,Florian Loeffl,Arne Sachtler,Daniel Seidel,Milan Herrmann,Robert Burger,Thomas Gumpert,Antonin Raffin,Tristan Ehlert,Maximilian Pries,David Wandinger,Florian Schmidt,Manuel Keppler,Jinoh Lee,Alin Albu-Schäffer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个概念验证框架，使机器人非线性动力学在设计阶段可预测，并利用非线性共振（而非主动控制）在多足机器人中实现多步态涌现。研究人员在高度柔顺的四足机器人eBert上识别出六个非线性正则模态（NNMs），通过黑盒优化确定步长，每个NNM自然发展成不同速度的独特步态，仿真结果在硬件上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动物通过调节姿态和肌肉刚度利用机械共振和具身智能实现高效步态，而大多数四足机器人并未专门设计来利用机械共振，因为非线性动力学复杂且需要专门的运动控制器。需要一种替代方案。

Method: 提出了一个概念验证框架：使用新的理论工具在高度柔顺的四足机器人eBert上识别六个非线性正则模态（NNMs），使机器人的非线性动力学在设计过程中可预测；通过黑盒优化确定步长，探索每个NNM如何自然发展为不同步态。

Result: 仿真表明每个NNM能自然发展成具有不同速度的独特步态，且这些发现在很大程度上成功迁移到真实机器人硬件上。实验证明eBert能利用其机械特性产生任务特定的运动。

Conclusion: 该框架证明非线性共振可以作为多步态运动的涌现基础，利用重力、惯性和弹性实现运动，为设计新一代灵巧高效的具身智能机器人奠定基础。

Abstract: Animals' body morphology shapes the gait patterns they can perform, where mechanical resonance reduces the need for active control. By tuning posture and muscle stiffness, they leverage their embodied intelligence to achieve effective gaits for different speeds. In contrast, most quadruped robots are not specifically designed to exploit mechanical resonance due to the complexity of nonlinear dynamics and require dedicated locomotion controllers. To provide an alternative, we present a proof of concept framework making the nonlinear dynamics of a robot predictable in the design process and show how this knowledge can be leveraged such that multi-gait locomotion can emerge from nonlinear resonances, shaped by gravity, inertia, and elasticity.
