We present the highly compliant quadruped robot eBert, on which we identify six nonlinear normal modes (NNMs) using our new theoretical tools and validate their existence in simulation and hardware. With black-box optimization to determine step length, simulations show how each NNM naturally develops into a distinct gait, manifesting different speeds, which also largely transfers to the robotic hardware. Our experiments show that eBert can exploit its mechanics to generate task-specific movements which may serve as foundation for designing a new generation of agile and efficient robots leveraging embodied intelligence.

</details>


### [429] [Potential-Guided Particle Steering for Negation-Constrained Dexterous Grasping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00555)
*Geonho Kim,SooGon Kim,Jongmin Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文针对语言驱动的灵巧抓取模型在"负面约束"指令（如"抓把手但避开主体"）下系统性失败的问题，提出了一种无需负面示例训练数据的推理时框架，通过序贯蒙特卡洛与分类器自由引导相结合，在采样过程中同时引导向目标部位靠近并剪枝朝向禁止区域的候选，将强基线的违反率从57.9%降至17.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言驱动灵巧抓取模型（如DextER）在指令指明抓取位置时表现良好，但当指令同时明确"不要抓哪里"时系统性地失败。原因在于：现有训练语料（如DexGYSNet）几乎不含回避类指令，且为每种可能的约束收集样本不切实际；更根本地，训练中提及的每个部位都被模型视为接触目标，导致模型可能将禁止部位误解为另一抓取区域而非应回避的区域。因此需要一种不依赖负面样本训练数据的方法。

Method: 提出一种推理时的框架：(1) 将序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）与分类器自由引导（CFG）相结合，在采样过程中同时实现两个目标——引导采样朝向指令指定的部位，同时剪除朝向被禁止区域的候选轨迹；(2) 利用一个冻结的3D部位接地模型从语言指令中定位禁止区域；(3) 整个方法在训练阶段不需要任何负面（回避类）示例。同时构建NegGrasp基准，包含配对的正面/负面指令，并设计了约束感知指标，只有同时完成任务且遵守约束的抓取才被记为成功。

Result: 在NegGrasp基准上，该方法将最强基线的违反率从57.9%降至17.2%，同时约束感知成功率和物理成功率均有提升。

Conclusion: 通过推理时框架即可有效解决语言驱动的负面约束灵巧抓取问题，无需收集负面训练样本；序贯蒙特卡洛与分类器自由引导的组合、以及冻结3D部位接地模型的利用，为处理否定性约束指令提供了可行且高效的方案。

Abstract: Language-driven dexterous grasp models, such as DextER, perform well when instructions specify where to grasp, but we find they fail systematically when an instruction also specifies where not to grasp (e.g., "grasp the handle but avoid the body"). Existing training corpora, DexGYSNet among them, contain virtually no avoidance instructions, and collecting examples for every possible constraint is impractical. Moreover, because every part mentioned during training denotes a contact target, models may interpret a forbidden part as another region to grasp rather than one to avoid. We therefore introduce an inference-time framework for negation-constrained dexterous grasping that requires no negation-specific training examples. Combining Sequential Monte Carlo with classifier-free guidance, our method guides sampling toward the instructed part while pruning candidates headed for the forbidden region, without any negation examples during training. A frozen 3D part-grounding model localizes the forbidden region from the language instruction. To evaluate this setting, we construct NegGrasp, a benchmark of paired positive/negative instructions with constraint-aware metrics that credit a grasp only if it both accomplishes the task and respects the stated constraint. On NegGrasp, our method reduces the violation rate of the strongest baseline from 57.9% to 17.2% while improving both constraint-aware and physical success.

</details>


### [430] [A Wearable Pneumatic Device for Continuous, Closed-Loop, Bidirectional Tactile Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00612)
*Cosima du Pasquier,Aliyah Smith,Serin Huber,Joshua Phelps,Ilana A. Cohen,Ava Chen,Monroe Kennedy,Allison M. Okamura*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套由两个可穿戴气动触觉设备组成的系统，支持连续、闭环、双向的触觉交互。每个设备最多包含十二个与纺织气动气囊相连的压力传感通道，每个通道既可作传感器也可作致动器。系统具备分布式架构，支持持续压力输出、快速动态响应和无线配对，可实现真实时间的触觉压力信号传输。设备级测试显示力带宽超过30Hz，人类研究表明基于压力的指尖反馈能改善遥操作表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有紧凑型气动触觉平台在压力保持、动态响应和双向交互能力上存在局限，尤其在遥操作场景中缺乏统一的触觉传感与反馈一体化方案，难以在实际时间尺度上支撑有感知意义的双向触觉交互。

Method: 设计了两个可穿戴气动触觉设备组成的系统，每个设备含多达十二个纺织气动气囊通道，每个通道通过局部闭环控制既可作致动器（产生稳定皮肤压痕）又可作传感器（测量与环境的触摸交互）。采用分布式架构支持持续压力输出与快速动态响应，两个相同设备通过无线配对实时传输和再现触觉压力信号。通过设备级表征和人类研究评估系统性能。

Result: 设备力带宽超过30Hz，具备快速且良好阻尼的阶跃响应，及优于先前紧凑型气动平台的延长压力保持能力。人类实验表明，基于压力的指尖反馈使遥操作施加压力减少23.1%，任务时长缩短27.4%，主观脑力负荷降低18.8%，尤其在视觉受限条件下效果显著。

Conclusion: 通过在统一的单气动模态中融合触觉传感与触觉反馈，该设备为遥操作中的双向触觉交互提供了实用基础，验证了在感知相关力和时间尺度上支持闭环双向触觉交互的可行性。

Abstract: We present a system of two wearable pneumatic haptic devices that supports continuous, closed-loop, bidirectional tactile interaction at perceptually relevant force and temporal scales. A single device can contain up to twelve pressure sensing channels connected to textile-based pneumatic pouches. Each channel in a device can be used as a sensor, an actuator, or both. As an actuator with integrated sensing, the channel generates stable skin indentation through local closed-loop control. As a sensor, a channel can be mounted (or worn) on any surface, including on a robot gripper or on the human body, and used to measure touch interactions with the environment or a human user. A distributed architecture supports sustained pressure output, rapid dynamic response, and wireless pairing of identical devices in a system to transmit and reproduce tactile pressure signals in real time.
  Device-level characterization demonstrates force bandwidth exceeding 30 Hz, rapid and well-damped step responses, and extended pressure retention compared to prior compact pneumatic platforms. Human studies show that pressure-based fingertip feedback enables discrimination of force and stiffness, improves teleoperated manipulation by reducing applied pressures by up to 23.1% and task duration by up to 27.4%, and lowers subjective mental workload by 18.8%, particularly under visually constrained conditions. By unifying tactile sensing and haptic feedback within a single pneumatic modality, the device provides a practical foundation for bidirectional touch interaction in teleoperation.

</details>


### [431] [DSG: Dynamic 3D Scene Graph Construction for Embodied Agents in Changing Indoor Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00619)
*Ming Liao,Chao Ye,Jianing Fei,Weiyang Lin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了DSG框架，一种动态3D场景图构建方法，通过语义感知的3D高斯场景表示和双视角渲染检测物体变化，并结合多粒度视觉上下文的空间关系推理，在动态室内环境中实现准确的场景图节点更新和关系推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内环境中物体位置频繁变化导致先前构建的场景图与现实不一致，现有方法缺乏可靠的物体变化检测和动态场景图更新能力。

Method: 1) 构建语义感知的3D高斯场景表示，提出基于双视角渲染的物体变化检测方法以实现可靠的场景图节点更新；2) 提出融合多粒度视觉上下文的空间关系推理方法，使大语言模型能够识别更丰富的物体间空间关系；3) 在AI2-THOR上构建动态室内场景图基准Dyn-THOR用于评估。

Result: 在Dyn-THOR、3RScan和真实场景上的大量实验表明，DSG在物体节点构建和空间关系推理方面均持续优于现有方法，显著提升了动态场景图构建的准确性。

Conclusion: DSG通过结合3D高斯场景表示、双视角变化检测和LLM驱动的多粒度空间关系推理，有效解决了动态环境中的场景图一致性问题，验证了该方法在仿真和真实场景中的泛化能力。

Abstract: In indoor environments, object positions frequently change due to human activities or embodied-agent interactions, causing previously constructed scene graphs to become inconsistent with the current scene. To address this issue, we propose DSG, a dynamic 3D scene graph construction framework that detects object changes and performs spatial relationship reasoning. First, we construct a semantic-aware 3D Gaussian scene representation and develop a dual-view rendering-based object change detection method to enable reliable scene graph node updates. Second, we propose a spatial relationship reasoning method that incorporates multi-granularity visual context, enabling a large language model to identify a richer set of interobject spatial relationships. Furthermore, we introduce DynTHOR, a dynamic indoor scene graph benchmark built on the AI2-THOR simulation platform for evaluating scene graph construction in dynamic environments. Extensive experiments on Dyn-THOR, 3RScan, and real-world scenes demonstrate that DSG consistently outperforms existing methods in both object node construction and spatial relationship reasoning, significantly improving the accuracy of dynamic scene graph construction.

</details>


### [432] [AM-Bench: A Modular Simulation Suite and Benchmark for Aerial Manipulation Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00641)
*Yutong Wang,Dongjae Lee,Xiaofeng Guo,Yuanzhu Zhan,Yufei Jiang,Bavin Saravanan,Muqing Cao,Jia Xie,Chenyang Mao,Sebastian Scherer,Junyi Geng,Guanya Shi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出AM-Bench，一个面向多旋翼空中操作（AM）策略学习的模块化仿真套件与基准测试平台，支持跨欠驱动、全驱动和过驱动embodiment的12项任务，涵盖接触、运输和受限交互，并支持配置气动扰动、执行器饱和及标准底层控制器与基线策略学习算法。AM-Bench区别于传统仅强调端到端策略性能的操作基准，支持系统级评估embodiment、控制、扰动与策略选择的交互作用，并通过三项仿真研究和真实世界验证展现诊断价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作学习基准大多聚焦地面支撑系统，不适用于动力学关键型领域如空中操作。AM面临环境扰动、操作器与浮动基座间的耦合动力学以及受限自由度等系统性挑战，任务性能取决于embodiment、低层控制和高层策略的联合设计，但缺少能系统评估这些因素的基准平台。

Method: AM-Bench包含：覆盖欠驱动、全驱动和过驱动系统的代表性embodiment；12项覆盖接触、运输和受限交互的任务；可配置的气动扰动和执行器饱和；标准低层控制器；基线策略学习算法。支持端到端策略评估及embodiment-控制-扰动-策略交互的系统级诊断分析。

Result: 通过三项仿真研究（高层策略、策略-控制接口、embodiment）展示了AM-Bench的诊断能力，并在真实世界中验证了建模效应，同时完成了学习管线的硬件测试。

Conclusion: AM-Bench提供了首个面向空中操作的模块化基准，弥补现有基准在地面支撑之外场景的空白，使研究者能够系统解耦和评估空中操作中embodiment、控制、扰动与策略的协同关系，从而推动AM领域可泛化的策略学习方法发展。

Abstract: Standardized benchmarks have played a central role in advancing robot manipulation learning, yet most focus on ground-supported manipulation systems, which limits their applicability to dynamics-critical domains such as aerial manipulation (AM). AM presents distinct system-level challenges, including environmental disturbances, coupled dynamics between the manipulator and floating base, and constrained degrees of freedom. Consequently, task performance depends jointly on robot embodiment, low-level control, and high-level policy design. We introduce AM-Bench, a modular simulation suite and benchmark for multirotor-based AM policy learning. AM-Bench includes representative embodiments spanning underactuated, fully actuated, and overactuated systems, 12 tasks across contact, transport, and constrained interaction, configurable aerodynamic disturbances and actuator saturation, standard low-level controllers, and baseline policy-learning algorithms. Unlike prior manipulation benchmarks that primarily emphasize end-to-end policy performance, AM-Bench enables system-level evaluation of how embodiment, control, disturbances, and policy choices interact. We demonstrate its diagnostic value through three simulation studies spanning high-level policies, policy--control interfaces, and embodiments, together with real-world validation of modeled effects and a hardware test of the learning pipeline.

</details>


### [433] [Human-robot conversation with multiple participants in noisy public spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00648)
*Divesh Lala,Yogeeswaran Muthukumaran,Vincent Fernandes,Kazushi Kato,Shota Fujiki,Zihao Chi,Masaya Iwasaki,Taiken Shintani,Megumi Kawata,Kazuki Sakai,Koji Inoue,Yuicihiro Yoshikawa,Tatsuya Kawahara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于嘈杂真实环境（如开放公共空间）的音频系统，可同时服务于智能机器人与虚拟化身（avatar）的语音对话场景。该系统在2025年大阪世界博览会上进行了概念验证演示，包含两个场景：一是与机器人ERICA的专注聆听系统，二是配备移动Teleco机器人的对话支持系统（其中一个作为远程操作员的化身）。两个系统均支持多方对话并使用单一多通道麦克风阵列，不仅能增强嘈杂环境中多说话人的语音，还提供空间音频以增强基于化身的对话交互的沉浸感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在开放公共空间等嘈杂真实环境中，自主机器人和化身的口语对话系统需要精心设计以提供增强的语音信号。这些信号既可用于语音识别，也可在化身场景中作为清晰语音传输给远程操作员，因此需要一种能同时满足两种需求的音频系统。

Method: 提出一个基于单一多通道麦克风阵列的音频系统，支持多方对话场景。系统通过多通道信号处理增强嘈杂环境中多个说话人的语音，并提供空间音频形式，以增强基于化身的对话交互的沉浸体验。该系统在2025年大阪世博会上作为概念验证进行了实际部署演示，覆盖两个不同场景：与安卓机器人ERICA的专注聆听系统，以及配备移动Teleco机器人（其中一个作为远程操作员化身）的对话支持系统。

Result: 该系统在2025年大阪世博会上成功展示了概念验证，在真实嘈杂环境（开放公共空间）中同时支持两种应用场景——机器人语音识别/聆听和化身远程对话传输，实现了多说话人的语音增强以及空间音频带来的沉浸式化身交互体验。

Conclusion: 所提出的音频系统展示了如何在单一硬件配置（多通道麦克风阵列）下，同时服务于机器人的语音识别与化身的远程语音传输两个场景，并通过空间音频增强了化身对话的沉浸感，验证了该系统在真实世界嘈杂环境中作为概念验证的可行性。

Abstract: For noisy real-world environments such as those in open public spaces, spoken dialogue systems for both autonomous robots and avatars should be carefully designed to provide enhanced speech signals. These signals can be used either for speech recognition or, in the case of an avatar system, transmitted as clean speech to a remote operator. This work proposes an audio system that can be used for both these scenarios and was demonstrated as a proof-of-concept at the 2025 World Expo in Osaka. The first scenario is an attentive listening system with the android ERICA, and the second is a conversation support system with mobile Teleco robots, with one of them acting as an avatar for a remote operator. Both systems feature multi-party conversation and use a single multi-channel microphone array. We describe how our audio system not only enhances the speech of multiple speakers in a noisy environment, but provides a form of spatial audio which allows for more immersiveness in avatar-based conversational interactions.

</details>


### [434] [Fleets Need a Context Plane: Rethinking Cooperative Perception for Autonomous Drones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00659)
*Liangkai Liu,Xiaoxiao Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"上下文平面"(context plane)这一结构化接口，使无人机编队的协同感知系统能够在运行时根据任务、带宽、编队几何和场景覆盖等多维上下文信号，动态调整每个无人机的计算、共享和融合策略，无需修改或重训练感知模型。实验表明该界面在Jetson AGX Orin上的ROS 2原型中仅消耗约0.01%的数据平面带宽，每次策略决策仅需0.10毫秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有协同感知系统通常在设计时就固定特征共享策略，或仅适应单一上下文信号，这无法满足空中编队在实际飞行中任务、带宽、编队几何和场景覆盖动态变化的需求。作者通过在UAV3D上利用DiscoNet检查点进行定量实验，证明了上下文盲共享的代价，并指出多上下文轴必须联合考虑才能实现最佳性能。

Method: 作者提出"上下文平面"这一受限的结构化运行时接口：每架无人机以10Hz频率发布不超过1KB的描述符，轻量级且可替换的策略根据整个编队的上下文决定每架无人机应计算、共享和融合什么。现有共享方案可被纳入该接口作为固定策略。研究首先通过评估时控制特征交换（无需重训练）在UAV3D上量化上下文盲共享的代价，揭示任务感知共享可与完全共享精度相当但仅需5-10%的字节，且最佳peer选择策略随字节预算变化。

Result: 任务感知共享达到完全共享精度但仅使用5-10%的字节；选择错误的peer选择策略在受限预算下损失高达7.7 AP；两个全场景精度相同的策略在任务区域内相差5.9 AP。在Jetson AGX Orin上的ROS 2原型中，上下文平面仅使用约0.01%的数据平面带宽，每次策略决策耗时0.10毫秒。

Conclusion: 显式的上下文接口能够在低开销下支持运行时自适应，无需修改或重训练感知模型。提出多上下文轴必须联合考虑的设计原则，上下文平面为空中编队协同感知提供了灵活且高效的运行时适应机制。

Abstract: Cooperative perception allows a drone fleet to combine observations from multiple viewpoints. However, existing systems typically fix their feature-sharing policies at design time or adapt to only one context signal. This is a poor fit for aerial fleets, whose missions, bandwidth, formation geometry, and scene coverage can change during flight. We quantify the cost of context-blind sharing on UAV3D by controlling feature exchange at evaluation time using a released DiscoNet checkpoint, without retraining. Mission-aware sharing matches full-sharing accuracy while using only 5-10% of the bytes. The best tested peer selection policy changes with the byte budget, and choosing the wrong policy loses up to 7.7 AP. Moreover, under a constrained budget, two policies with the same full-scene accuracy differ by 5.9 AP within the mission region, showing that multiple context axes must be considered jointly. We therefore propose the context plane, a bounded, structured interface for runtime context. Each drone publishes a descriptor of at most 1 KB at 10 Hz, and lightweight, replaceable policies use the fleet context to decide what each drone computes, shares, and fuses. Existing sharing schemes become fixed policies within this interface. In our ROS 2 prototype on a Jetson AGX Orin, the context plane uses approximately 0.01% of the data-plane bandwidth, and each policy decision takes 0.10 ms. These results show that an explicit context interface can support low-overhead runtime adaptation without modifying or retraining the perception model.

</details>


### [435] [Behavior--Realization Separation for Constrained Physical Human--Robot Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00669)
*Yongyan Cao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将人机物理交互软件中的期望行为指定与受约束实现解耦为独立层次：行为层提供期望接触点加速度，实现层将其转换为受约束的机器人指令，并显式报告期望与实际加速度误差而非隐藏于饱和中。通过滚动时域二次规划实现无记忆仿射行为，实验结果证明行为与实现的分离可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统物理人机交互软件往往将期望行为指定与约束实现耦合在一起，导致约束饱和时误差被隐藏，难以区分行为变化与约束介入带来的影响。

Method: 将系统解耦为行为层（提供期望接触点加速度）与实现层（将其转换为受约束指令）。引入同目标无约束反事实用于分离正则化与约束干预，利用执行数据暴露模型误差。实现层采用滚动时域二次规划，改变行为仅修改目标函数系数(C_θ,G_θ)，机器人指令变量与可行域保持不变。

Result: 平面研究实例化阻抗与导纳行为，同一运行层可在不重建的情况下接受阻抗-导纳-阻抗重分配。在MuJoCo中7自由度Franka FR3上：持续20N推力下，稳态保持工作空间边界在0.1-0.2mm内，对比瞬时削减的阻抗4.4cm与导纳4.7cm超调。降级驱动预算下，全视界扭矩约束保持冻结模型计划可行至2.1e-4 N·m，而仅第一步削减的消融计划超出预算11.329 N·m；在执行的非线性系统上差距缩小但仍优（0.161 vs 0.380 N·m）。

Conclusion: 实验结果作为行为-实现分离的集中验证，证明了该解耦架构在约束处理、在线行为切换与扭矩可行性保障方面的有效性。

Abstract: Physical human--robot interaction software often couples desired-behavior specification with constrained realization; we treat these as separate layers. A \emph{behavior layer} supplies a desired contact-port acceleration $a_k^{\mathrm{id}}=f_θ(e_k,\dot e_k,F_{h,k})$. A \emph{realization layer} converts it into constrained robot commands and reports total desired-versus-realized acceleration error instead of hiding it in saturation. A same-objective unconstrained counterfactual separates regularization from constraint intervention, while plant data expose model error. This paper implements a receding-horizon quadratic program realizing memoryless affine behaviors. Changing the behavior modifies objective coefficients through $(C_θ,G_θ)$ while the robot-command variable and feasible set remain unchanged. A planar study instantiates impedance and admittance; the same running layer accepts an impedance--admittance--impedance reassignment without reconstruction, under its existing rate limit. On a torque-controlled 7-DOF Franka FR3 in MuJoCo, the runtime freezes task-space dynamics per solve and enforces torque feasibility across its horizon. Under a sustained 20~N push, it holds a slack-relaxed workspace boundary to within approximately 0.1--0.2~mm, versus 4.4~cm (impedance) and 4.7~cm (admittance) overshoot from instantaneous clipping. A derated actuator budget then activates the torque constraint: horizon-wide enforcement keeps its frozen-model plan feasible to $2.1\times10^{-4}$~N$\cdot$m, whereas a first-step-only ablation plans up to 11.329~N$\cdot$m beyond budget; on the executed nonlinear plant, where both share the same local-model error, the gap is smaller but still favors horizon-wide enforcement (0.161 vs.\ 0.380~N$\cdot$m). These results are a focused proof of behavior--realization separation.

</details>


### [436] [ADAPT: Agile Diffusion Action Priors for Robust and Steerable Online Text-Driven Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00677)
*Yan Wu,Chenhao Li,Kaifeng Zhao,Gen Li,Marco Hutter,Siyu Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出ADAPT，一个用于交互式、文本条件的人形全身控制的端到端框架，通过扩散模型学习动作先验并结合轻量级残差强化学习策略，实现了从语言指令直接驱动全身动作的闭环控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本到动作（text-to-motion）方法通常先离线生成运动学动作，再交由独立的跟踪器执行，这种分离式管线无法实现端到端的闭环交互控制，尤其在面对不断变化的语言指令时，机器人难以同时保持平衡、自然动作和平滑状态切换。

Method: ADAPT采用端到端闭环控制框架，包含两个关键组件：(1) 从文本标注的人形状态-动作轨迹中学习基于扩散模型的动作先验，使多种动作技能可直接由语言命令执行；(2) 在冻结的扩散控制器之上训练轻量级残差强化学习策略，以提升长时程鲁棒性和平滑的指令切换能力。该扩散策略还可作为可引导的文本条件运动先验，用于下游任务自适应。

Result: 实验证明ADAPT能够实现鲁棒的语言接地技能执行、平滑的交互式指令切换，以及保持风格的下游任务控制。

Conclusion: ADAPT验证了将扩散动作先验与残差强化学习相结合的有效性，为文本条件下的人形全身交互控制提供了一种无需分离式跟踪器的端到端方案，并展示了扩散策略在下游任务中作为可重用运动先验的潜力。

Abstract: We present ADAPT, an end-to-end framework for interactive, text-conditioned humanoid whole-body control. Unlike dominant text-to-motion pipelines that generate kinematic motions for a separate tracker, ADAPT solves language control with an end-to-end closed-loop control framework, where the robot must continuously respond to changing commands while maintaining balance, natural motion, and smooth transitions. ADAPT learns a diffusion-based action prior from text-labeled humanoid state-action trajectories, enabling diverse motion skills to be directly executed from language commands. To improve long-horizon robustness and smooth prompt switching, we train a lightweight residual reinforcement learning policy on top of the frozen diffusion controller. We further show that the same diffusion policy can be reused as a steerable text-conditioned motion prior for downstream task adaptation. Experiments demonstrate robust language-grounded skill execution, smooth interactive transitions, and style-preserving downstream control.

</details>


### [437] [Context-Aware Intelligent Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00682)
*Liangkai Liu,Shuyao Shi,Mingke Wang,Noah T. Curran,Chuan Li,Fan Bai,Kang G. Shin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将上下文情境因素作为下一代智能车辆系统的"一等公民"原则，并将其操作化为整个软件栈中学习、风险评估和闭环控制的统一共享状态。系统综述了跨环境理解、规划与控制、安全与安全、网联车辆四个领域的SOTA上下文感知方法，识别出构建通用上下文引擎的四个关键挑战：多模态上下文融合、时间上下文建模、罕见事件处理与协作式上下文共享。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能车辆除自动驾驶外日益支持上下文自适应应用（如ADAS、舱内监控、车队管理），在精度、延迟、成本与可靠性方面有严格要求。但车辆在资源受限平台上运行于复杂、不确定且快速变化的环境中，现有方法难以满足这些要求，需要将上下文因素作为系统设计的第一类原则来统一处理。

Method: 本文采用系统性综述方法，对SOTA上下文感知方法进行跨四个领域的分类梳理（环境理解、规划与控制、安全与安全、网联车辆），并基于上下文感知设计的趋势分析来提炼技术挑战。

Result: 通过趋势分析识别出构建通用上下文引擎的四大关键技术挑战：(1)多模态上下文融合、(2)时间上下文建模、(3)罕见事件处理、(4)协作式上下文共享。

Conclusion: 本文希望激励未来智能车辆领域发展鲁棒且高效的上下文感知应用，推动上下文作为统一共享状态在软件栈各层级中被系统化地整合与利用。

Abstract: Intelligent vehicles increasingly support adaptive applications beyond driving themselves, ranging from context-aware ADAS and automated driving to in-cabin monitoring and fleet management, all under tight requirements on accuracy, latency, cost, and reliability. Meeting these requirements is challenging because vehicles operate in complex, uncertain, and rapidly changing environments while running on resource-constrained computing platforms. This paper argues that context-situational factors that give meaning to sensor signals and constrain decisions-should be treated as a first-class principle for next-generation vehicle systems, and operationalized as a unified, shared state for learning, risk assessment, and closed-loop control across the software stack. We systematically review state-of-the- art (SOTA) context-aware methods spanning (i) environment understanding, (ii) planning and control, (iii) safety and security, and (iv) connected vehicles. Based on a trend analysis of context-aware design, we identify four key technical challenges in building a general contextual engine for future intelligent vehicles: multi-modal context fusion, temporal context modeling, handling rare events, and collaborative context sharing. We hope this survey will motivate the development of robust and efficient context-aware vehicle applications.

</details>


### [438] [One Print, Many Moves: Monolithic Origami-inspired Folding Actuator for Composable Soft Multi-DoF Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00751)
*Jaehyung Jang,Zhenish Zhakypov,Jasmin Elena Palmer,Melissa Klein,Jee-Hwan Ryu,Allison Mariko Okamura*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出MONORIGAMI设计策略，通过空间编程的刚度各向异性（结合材料厚度和折纸启发的几何图案），将传统软体驱动器的无约束变形转化为精准、可重复、可组合的折叠运动。该设计可通过单材料、单次3D打印完成，无需装配；每个驱动器作为可扩展运动单元，通过链接和定向多个单元可机械编程多自由度轨迹。论文展示了三个应用系统：4自由度VR触觉可穿戴设备、3自由度遥操作操纵杆，以及可水下操作的模块化机械爪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统软体机器人驱动器虽然具有良好的柔顺性，但其不可控的变形导致精度不足，且难以扩展到多自由度系统。现有软体驱动器在精度与可扩展性之间存在长期矛盾，需要一种既能保持材料柔顺性又能实现精确可控运动的设计与制造方案。

Method: MONORIGAMI通过空间编程的刚度各向异性实现可控变形：基于材料厚度的刚度层级，以折纸启发的面-折痕几何图案进行排布，在期望折叠方向保持材料柔顺性，同时在不需要的方向有选择地限制变形。无需额外加固件，采用单材料、单次打印的增材制造工艺。每个致动器作为可组合运动基元，通过力学方式链接和定向多个基元实现多自由度轨迹编程。

Result: 利用同一基础模块展示了三个3D打印的软体多自由度系统，覆盖不同应用领域：(1) 4自由度紧凑型VR触觉可穿戴设备，提供高保真皮肤触觉反馈；(2) 3自由度遥操作操纵杆，提供动觉反馈；(3) 可在水下操作的模块化机械爪，具有几何编码的抓取轨迹。系统验证了模块在紧凑多轴集成、受控物理交互和环境适应性方面的能力。

Conclusion: MONORIGAMI提供了一个通用、可组合、易获取、可靠且可扩展的高精度软体多自由度机器人平台，解决了软体致动器设计与制造中长期存在的精度和可扩展性瓶颈。

Abstract: Conventional soft robot actuators excel in compliance, but their uncontrolled deformations compromise accuracy and hinder scaling to multi-degree-of-freedom (DoF) systems. We introduce a MONOlithic ORIGAMI-inspired soft folding actuator design (MONORIGAMI) that establishes a design strategy based on spatially programmed stiffness anisotropy to preserve material compliance along desired folding directions while selectively restricting deformation in unwanted directions. The actuator leverages stiffness tiers based on material thickness, patterned in an origami-inspired geometry with facets and creases, converting unconstrained soft deformation into accurate, repeatable, and composable folding motions without additional reinforcements. The design is fully 3D-printable through a single-material, single-print process that requires no assembly. Each actuator serves as a scalable motion primitive, and linking and orienting multiple actuators mechanically programs multi-DoF trajectories. Using the same fundamental module, we demonstrate three 3D-printed soft multi-DoF robotic systems spanning distinct application domains: (1) a compact 4-DoF wearable haptic device for high-fidelity cutaneous feedback in virtual reality (VR), (2) a 3-DoF joystick for kinesthetic feedback in teleoperation, and (3) a modular robotic gripper capable of underwater operation with geometry-encoded grasp trajectories. These systems demonstrate the module's capabilities for compact multi-axis integration, controlled physical interaction, and geometry-programmed operation across different environments. Together, these results show that MONORIGAMI provides a general, composable, accessible, reliable, and scalable platform for high-precision soft multi-DoF robotics, addressing long-standing limitations in both soft actuator design and fabrication.

</details>


### [439] [A Compact Robotic Finger with 2-DoF MCP Joint Embedding DoF-Selective Passive Continuously Variable Transmission for Wide Force-Speed Operating Range](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00769)
*JaeHyung Jang,Jee-Hwan Ryu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种紧凑型两自由度机器人手指，其屈曲自由度采用选择性被动连续可变传动（CVT），通过力响应式被动CVT实现宽力-速度工作范围，无需额外执行器、传感器或控制即可实现4.19倍的最大输出力放大。该设计受人类掌指关节功能分化启发，为紧凑型多自由度机器人手提供了可扩展的传动设计策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器人手指在力-速度操作范围内存在折中限制，难以同时实现大输出力和高速度。受人类掌指关节功能分化启发，作者希望在多自由度手掌机构中实现传动差异化，使不同自由度具备不同的传动特性，从而扩展机器人手指的力-速度工作范围，同时保持机构紧凑性。

Method: 提出一种双自由度紧凑型机器人手指，在屈曲-伸展自由度上选择性配置力响应式被动CVT（采用移动滑轮启发的绕线结构），而在外展-内收自由度上保留直接传动。该输出侧被动CVT利用施加在滑轮上的线张力产生的合成为矩，根据负载被动增大屈曲力臂和传动比，无需额外的执行器、传感器或控制系统。

Result: 实验结果显示，在15度至75度的屈曲角测试范围内，最大输出力放大倍数达4.19倍，平均放大3.6倍，通过力臂适配大幅扩展了力-速度工作范围。此外，灵巧的球滚动实验验证了在保持外展-内收功能的同时可实现被动传动适配。

Conclusion: 该研究展示了一种针对紧凑型多自由度机器人手的可扩展传动设计策略，通过自由度特异的传动差异化实现宽工作范围，为未来机器人手的设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: This letter presents a compact two-degree-of-freedom (DoF) robotic finger with a flexion-selective passive continuously variable transmission (CVT) to achieve a wide force-speed operating range. Inspired by the functional differentiation of the human metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joint, the proposed mechanism realizes DoF-specific transmission differentiation by selectively assigning passive CVT to the flexion-extension DoF while preserving direct transmission for abduction-adduction. For a wide force-speed operating range, a force-responsive passive CVT is embedded in the flexion pathway, while direct transmission is preserved for the abduction-adduction pathway. To selectively realize transmission adaptation within a multi-DoF MCP mechanism, an output-side passive CVT employing a moving-pulley-inspired wire-routing structure is introduced. The resultant force generated by the wire tensions acting on the pulley that passively increases the flexion moment arm and transmission ratio according to the applied load without additional actuators, sensors, or control. Experimental results demonstrate a maximum output-force amplification of 4.19-fold and a mean amplification of 3.6-fold across the tested flexion angles ranging from 15 degrees to 75 degrees through moment-arm adaptation, thereby substantially expanding the achievable force-speed operating range. Furthermore, dexterous ball-rolling experiments verify that passive transmission adaptation can be achieved while preserving abduction-adduction functionality. These results demonstrate a scalable transmission design strategy for compact multi-DoF robotic hands.

</details>


### [440] [Non-Prehensile Throwing: A Reinforcement Learning Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00771)
*Abdullah Mustafa,Ryo Hanai,Ixchel G. Ramirez-Alpizar,Floris Erich,Ryoichi Nakajo,Yukiyasu Domae,Tetsuya Ogata*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的非抓取式机器人抛掷方法，利用滑动和滚动接触模式，直接在关节空间中优化轨迹，无需解析接触模型或自定义参数化。该方法在仿真中达到99%成功率，并零样本迁移到UR5e机械臂上，实现97%真实世界成功率，可抛掷重790g、大20x20x28cm的多种物体至最远350cm或180cm高度的目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非抓取式抛掷方法依赖于基于简化的接触模型（如动力抓取）的模型优化和低维轨迹参数化，这限制了解决方案的质量和可达工作空间。对于大型、重型或可变形物体，需要更灵活的抛掷方案，能够利用滑动和滚动等多种接触模式。

Method: 1) 将抛掷问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），以关节状态为状态空间，条件于投掷目标、物体模型和初始位形；2) 在低控制频率下离线规划关节加加速度（joint-jerk）轨迹，然后上采样为平滑的高频速度指令；3) 通过最小加加速度系统辨识减小机器人动力学差距，训练不确定性感知策略以缓解物体建模误差，特别是对动态摩擦的敏感性。

Result: 仿真中达到99%成功率（覆盖数千种构型）且泛化到未见物体；敏感性分析显示对质量不确定性鲁棒，但对动态摩擦高度敏感。零样本部署在UR5e上（末端速度接近物理极限5 m/s），可抛掷重790g、大20x20x28cm的多种物体，目标距离最远350cm或高度180cm，真实世界成功率达97%。

Conclusion: 该方法证明强化学习结合滑动/滚动接触模式能显著扩展非抓取式抛掷的可行性和可达工作空间，且通过合理的sim-to-real设计（系统辨识和不确定性感知训练）可实现可靠的真实世界部署。但结果也揭示了对动态摩擦的高度敏感性是该方法的主要局限，是未来需要重点解决的问题。

Abstract: Robotic throwing enables fast object transport and extends a robot's reachable workspace beyond traditional pick-and-place. While prehensile (grasp-based) throwing works well for graspable items, non-prehensile (grasp-free) throwing is better suited for large, heavy, and/or deformable objects. Existing approaches rely on model-based optimization with simplified contact models (e.g., dynamic grasping) and low-dimensional trajectory parameterizations, which limit solution quality and reachable workspace. We propose a reinforcement learning approach that additionally leverages sliding and rolling contact modes and directly optimizes joint-space trajectories without analytical contact models or custom parameterizations. The Markov Decision Process (MDP) is formulated as a dynamical system that evolves the robot's joint state conditioned on the throwing target, object model, and initial configuration. Joint-jerk trajectories are planned offline at a low control rate and upsampled into smooth, high-rate velocity commands for deployment. For sim-to-real transfer, we minimize the robot-dynamics gap through minimum-jerk system identification and train uncertainty-aware policies to mitigate object-modeling errors, particularly sensitivity to dynamic friction. In simulation, the policy achieves 99% success across thousands of configurations and generalizes to unseen objects. Sensitivity analysis shows robustness to mass uncertainty but high sensitivity to dynamic friction, consistent with the sliding-based release mechanism. Deployed zero-shot on a UR5e operating near its physical limits (5 m/s end-effector velocity), our method throws diverse objects including heavy (790 g) and large (20x20x28 cm) items to targets up to 350 cm distance or 180 cm elevation, achieving a 97% real-world success rate.

</details>


### [441] [Connectivity-Aware Graph Extension for Decentralized Multi-Robot Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00804)
*Béatrice Garcia Cegarra,Elena Vanneaux,Quentin Picard,David Filliat*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于前沿连通性的探索图扩展策略，用于多无人机在间歇通信下的去中心化探索，在低通信率下比现有图扩展方法具有更高的探索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多无人机在未知环境中探索需要在间歇通信下进行协调，去中心化操作是基本假设。现有方法在通信断开和空间布局变化时难以维持稳定的区域划分和探索规划。

Method: 在去中心化框架内，提出一种基于前沿连通性（frontier connectivity）的新型探索图扩展策略，用于扩展探索计划并保持智能体之间的区域划分稳定且对断连和空间布局变化具有鲁棒性。该扩展方法被应用于两种最先进的区域划分方法。

Result: 在仿真中进行了评估，实验表明相比现有的图扩展方法性能更优，在低通信率下具有更高的探索效率。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于前沿连通性的探索图扩展策略在多无人机去中心化探索中显著提升了探索效率，尤其是在通信条件受限（低通信率）和通信中断的情况下表现出更强的鲁棒性与稳定性。

Abstract: Exploring unknown environments with multiple UAVs requires coordination under intermittent communication, making decentralized operation a baseline assumption. We propose, within a decentralized framework, a novel exploration graph extension strategy based on frontier connectivity to extend exploration plans and maintain area partitioning among agents stable and robust to disconnections and changes in spatial layout. The proposed extension method is applied to two state-of-the-art area partitioning methods and evaluated in simulation. Experiments show improved performance over existing graph extension approaches with higher exploration efficiency under low communication rate.

</details>


### [442] [Peg-in-Bench: A Modular Benchmark for High-Precision Robotic Insertion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00906)
*Yosel Delgado,José G. Buenaventura-Carreón,Floris Erich,Roman Mykhailyshyn,Tomohiro Motoda,Koshi Makihara,Yukiyasu Domae*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个可重构的销钉-孔（peg-in-hole）基准测试平台，用于评估高精度插入任务中的任务泛化能力。该基准由3D可打印的模块化组件构成，包括多种销钉几何形状、公差等级和可配置基座结构，能够生成多样化的插入与装配任务，并配有场景生成工具以确保可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高精度插入是机器人操作中的基础挑战，但现有peg-in-hole基准测试依赖固定任务配置，难以评估机器人在不同插入场景下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Method: 设计了一套完全3D可打印的模块化基准组件，涵盖多种销钉几何形状、不同公差等级以及可配置的基座结构。通过改变物体布局、朝向和任务结构，同时在受控物理条件下，系统性地生成大规模多样化的插入和装配任务。此外提供场景生成工具，可输出标准化任务配置和机器可读的任务描述。

Result: 该基准能够生成大量多样的插入与装配任务，支持对未见场景的适应性进行系统性评估，并提供开源仓库（含STL文件与场景生成工具）以保证可复现性。

Conclusion: 该工作为高精度机器人插入任务提供了一个可重新配置、可复现的基准测试平台，填补了现有基准在评估任务泛化能力方面的空白，有助于推动机器人插入操作的研究进展。

Abstract: High-precision insertion remains a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation due to the strict alignment requirements and contact-rich interactions involved. Although peg-in-hole tasks are widely used for evaluation, existing bench- marks often rely on fixed task configurations, limiting their ability to assess robustness and generalization across different insertion scenarios. This paper introduces a reconfigurable peg-in-hole benchmark designed to evaluate task generalization in high-precision insertion. The benchmark consists of a set of fully 3D-printable modular components, including multiple peg geometries, tolerance levels, and configurable base structures that can be combined to generate a large variety of insertion and assembly tasks. By varying object layouts, orientations, and task structures while maintaining controlled physical conditions, the benchmark enables systematic evaluation of adaptation to unseen scenarios. To support reproducibility, we additionally provide a scenario generation tool capable of producing standardized task configurations and machine-readable task descriptions. The scenario generation tool and the STL files of the benchmark pieces are available through the project repository: https://github.com/aistairc/peg-in-bench.

</details>


### [443] [Knowing When to Stop: Adaptive Action Chunking via Internal Cross-Attention Dynamics in VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00908)
*Runze Xu,Xiaolong Shan,Shuang Dai,Yu Wang,Jincheng Yu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于交叉注意力熵的自适应动作分块（adaptive action chunking）方法，通过检测高熵平台期动态调整执行视野，在VLA框架中实现无需训练的推理时截断机制，改善任务成功率并保持高效闭环控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代VLA框架使用固定动作分块执行策略，但固定执行视野在效率和精度之间存在固有矛盾：短分块需频繁推理且可能产生振荡行为，长分块则可能与新观测状态失配。需要一种自适应机制来平衡两者。

Method: 观察到动作专家中动作到观测的交叉注意力随预测视野延长而发散，熵增大趋向平台期，并与更高的动作预测误差相关。基于此提出训练无关（training-free）的截断机制，在推理时检测持续高熵平台期并动态选择执行视野，利用策略中已计算的注意力权重，几乎无额外开销。

Result: 在π0.5和X-VLA上，于RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO及三个真实操作任务中进行评估，相比固定视野和自适应分块基线提高了平均任务成功率，同时保持高效闭环控制。

Conclusion: 交叉注意力动力学可作为VLA中自适应动作执行的有效内部信号，为实现更优的推理效率与动作精度平衡提供了实用途径。

Abstract: Action chunking is a standard execution strategy in modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) frameworks, but fixed execution horizons impose a trade-off between efficiency and accuracy. Short chunks require frequent inference and may cause oscillatory behavior, whereas long chunks can become misaligned with newly observed states. We address this limitation with an adaptive action chunking approach based on internal cross-attention dynamics in the action expert. We observe that, as the prediction horizon extends, action-to-observation cross-attention becomes increasingly dispersed and its entropy rises toward a plateau. This pattern is associated with higher action prediction error and provides an online signal that the current observation offers limited grounding for further open-loop execution. Based on this observation, we introduce a training-free truncation mechanism that detects sustained high-entropy plateaus and dynamically selects the execution horizon during inference. The method uses attention weights already computed by the policy and introduces negligible additional overhead. Evaluations on $π_{0.5}$ and X-VLA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and three real-world manipulation tasks show improved average task success over fixed-horizon and adaptive chunking baselines, while preserving efficient closed-loop control. These results show that cross-attention dynamics can provide a practical internal signal for adaptive action execution in VLAs.

</details>


### [444] [VerNav: Verifier-First Low-Latency Vision-and-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00920)
*Zhixin Wang,Chengzheyi Yao,Leyuan Liu,Xiaosong Zhang,Yongzhao Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VerNav框架，通过验证器优先策略降低LLM-based视觉语言导航（VLN）的决策延迟，用批量动作验证替代逐步自回归生成，仅对不确定决策调用自适应生成器，并采用两阶段对齐方案提升导航性能，在R2R基准上实现每步决策延迟降低10倍以上且保持竞争力的导航表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLN中基于LLM的自回归生成虽能提升指令理解与语义接地推理能力，但每一步的自回归生成会累积大量决策阶段延迟，影响多步导航的实时性。如何在不牺牲导航性能的前提下降低LLM推理延迟是核心挑战。

Method: 提出VerNav框架，包含三个关键设计：(1) 验证器优先架构，用批量动作验证替代每步自回归生成以减少决策延迟，并由基于熵的自适应生成器仅对不确定决策调用并产生紧凑状态证据；(2) VPO（Verifier Preference Optimization）实现静态验证器训练中的局部动作偏好对齐；(3) 步骤级强化微调（step-level reinforcement fine-tuning）在多步导航rollout中利用密集进度奖励进行动态任务执行优化。

Result: 在Room-to-Room（R2R）基准上，VerNav的验证器独占决策路径在代表性LLM-based VLN智能体中取得有竞争力的导航性能，同时将每步平均决策阶段LLM延迟相较于自回归方法降低超过10倍。

Conclusion: VerNav验证了"验证优先、生成兜底"的混合决策范式在LLM-based VLN中的有效性，在保持导航性能的同时大幅降低推理延迟，为低延迟多步具身导航提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to navigate through unseen 3D environments according to natural-language instructions. Explicit reasoning can improve instruction understanding and semantic grounding, but autoregressive generation at every step accumulates large decision-stage latency over multi-step navigation. We propose VerNav, a verifier-first framework for low-latency LLM-based VLN. The verifier reduces decision-stage latency by replacing per-step autoregressive generation with batched action verification, while an entropy-based adaptive generator is invoked only for uncertain decisions to produce compact state evidence. To further improve navigation performance with the verifier, we introduce a two-stage alignment scheme: (i) VPO improves local action-preference alignment in static verifier training, and (ii) step-level reinforcement fine-tuning provides dense progress rewards over multi-step navigation rollouts during dynamic task execution. Experiments on the Room-to-Room (R2R) benchmark show that the verifier-only decision path of VerNav achieves competitive navigation performance among representative LLM-based VLN agents while reducing average decision-stage LLM latency per step by more than $10\times$ compared with autoregressive methods.

</details>


### [445] [ProxPI: Proximal Prior Injection for Sampling-Based MPC under Learned-Prior Mismatch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00941)
*Euncheol Im,Myotaeg Lim,Yisoo Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Proximal Prior Injection (ProxPI)，一种将学习策略先验注入模型预测路径积分(MPPI)控制的新方法。与现有的策略引导MPPI方法将采样分布以策略输出为中心不同，ProxPI保留以无先验目标(nominal)为中心的采样，并通过软邻近代价(soft proximity cost)将策略信息融入优化器。理论分析和实验证明ProxPI在策略分布内任务中能达到现有方法的性能，同时在策略分布外(不匹配先验)情况下能让优化器逃离错误策略，恢复到vanilla MPPI的性能水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的策略引导MPPI方法通过以策略输出为中心的暖启动(warm-start)来注入学习先验，但当学习先验与任务不匹配(out of distribution)时，这种居中采样会限制探索范围，使优化器被困在不适解的邻域内，无法向任务最优解恢复，导致性能严重退化。作者希望设计一种既能在分布内保持先验注入的性能优势，又能在分布外鲁棒恢复的方法。

Method: ProxPI保留nominal-centered的MPPI采样方式，不直接以策略输出居中采样分布，而是通过一个soft proximity cost（软邻近约束/代价项）将策略输出融入优化目标中。这样采样仍然围绕标称参考展开，策略仅作为优化目标中的一个吸引子。作者从理论上证明：re-centering on prior（以先验为中心）会在每次更新中丢弃优化器的修正量，而nominal-centered采样能保留修正量并收敛到任务代价与先验共同确定的解集；同时指出该失败机制无法通过增大rollout预算来消除。实验部分包括仿真和真实机器人实验，在in-distribution和out-of-distribution任务中验证了方法性能。

Result: 仿真和真实机器人实验表明，ProxPI在策略分布内(in-distribution)任务中的性能与现有prior-injection方案相当，而在策略分布外(out-of-distribution)任务中，ProxPI能够使优化器逃离不准确的政策，恢复到vanilla MPPI水平的性能。理论分析还揭示了re-centering on prior方法的固有限制——每次更新中会丢失优化器修正，且更大的rollout预算不能弥补这一缺陷。

Conclusion: 通过将先验注入方式从"重定心采样分布"改为"软代价约束"，ProxPI在保留学习策略先验优势的同时，克服了策略-任务不匹配时性能急剧退化的问题。该方法在理论与实践层面均被验证能够提供分布内的高效先验利用与分布外的鲁棒恢复能力，是一种更稳健的策略引导MPPI方案。

Abstract: Combining learned policies with model predictive control can leverage learned task priors while retaining online adaptation to new objectives and constraints, but performance degrades when the policy is out of distribution. In policy-guided model predictive path integral (MPPI) control, a policy-centered warm-start approach centers the sampling distribution on the policy output. When the prior is mismatched, centering the sampling distribution on the policy output restricts exploration around an unsuitable solution and prevents recovery toward the task optimum. We propose Proximal Prior Injection (ProxPI), which retains nominal-centered MPPI sampling and incorporates the policy through a soft proximity cost. This matches the in-distribution performance of existing prior-injection schemes while enabling the optimizer to escape an inaccurate policy and recover vanilla MPPI-level performance. We theoretically show that re-centering on the prior discards the optimizer's correction at every update, whereas nominal-centered sampling retains it and converges to a solution set by both the task cost and the prior, and that this failure is not removed by a larger rollout budget. Simulations and real-robot experiments demonstrate robust performance under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks.

</details>


### [446] [HitMem: Hierarchical Temporal 3D Memory with Multi-Modal Context-Aware Retrieval for Dynamic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00950)
*Ruijie Tang,Chenye Zou,Guoquan Wu,Jun Wei,Wei Chen,Jiaxin Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HitMem是一个分层时序3D记忆框架，通过轻量拓扑图整合语义与空间信息，利用时间衰减机制调控记忆活性，并设计多模态上下文感知检索机制（默认过滤+两阶段检索）解决动态环境中对象位移引发的记忆-观测冲突，在Dyna-THOR基准上显著提升对象重定位精度、降低探索成本并增强任务执行性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3D记忆框架大多基于静态世界假设，在物体被人类活动或未观测事件移动后，智能体会遭遇记忆-观测冲突，通常需要昂贵的几何重计算或低效的全局再探索来解决，缺乏对动态环境中记忆时效性和重定位效率的考虑。

Method: HitMem采用分层时序3D记忆框架：(1)通过连续感知将语义与空间信息统一为轻量拓扑图，捕获支撑关系；(2)时间衰减机制动态调节记忆活跃度以减轻陈旧表征影响；(3)多模态上下文感知检索机制默认基于语义、空间和时间记忆特征过滤候选，检测到物体位移时激活两阶段专用检索——融合外部智能体轨迹推得的空间约束与基于类别亲和力的语义常识，高效识别高概率候选区域。

Result: 在作者构建的Dyna-THOR基准上进行的大量评估表明，HitMem显著提高了对象重定位精度、降低了探索成本，并增强了动态环境中的任务执行性能。

Conclusion: HitMem通过统一分层时序记忆表征与多模态上下文感知检索，有效解决了动态场景中对象位移带来的记忆失效问题，在不依赖昂贵几何重计算或全局再探索的情况下实现了高效且准确的对象重定位，为具身智能体在动态环境中的长期任务执行提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Executing long-term tasks in dynamic environments requires embodied agents to maintain robust and adaptive 3D scene representations. However, most existing 3D memory frameworks rely on static world assumptions. When objects are displaced by human activities or unobserved events, agents encounter memory-observation conflicts and often require costly geometric recomputations or inefficient global re-exploration. To address this, we propose HitMem, a hierarchical temporal 3D memory framework with a multi-modal context-aware retrieval mechanism. Through continuous perception, HitMem unifies semantic and spatial information into a lightweight topological graph that captures support relationships, while a temporal decay mechanism dynamically regulates memory activeness to mitigate the impact of stale representations. In addition, the multi-modal context-aware retrieval mechanism defaults to filtering candidates using integrated semantic, spatial, and temporal memory features, and activates a specialized two-stage retrieval process when object displacement is detected. This process combines spatial constraints inferred from external agent trajectories with semantic common sense grounded in class affinities, efficiently identifying high-probability candidate regions. Extensive evaluations on our constructed Dyna-THOR benchmark demonstrate that HitMem significantly improves object relocation accuracy, reduces exploration costs, and enhances task execution performance in dynamic environments.

</details>


### [447] [Accelerating Reinforcement Learning via MPC Solver-Gradient Guidance for Weights-varying MPC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01061)
*Baha Zarrouki,Arslan Thobani,Jasper Hoffmann,Mattia Piccinini,Rudolf Reiter,Felix Jahncke,Sébastien Gros,Davide Scaramuzza,Johannes Betz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SG-RL（Solver-Gradient Guided Reinforcement Learning），一种将可微MPC求解器梯度作为辅助指导融入RL框架的方法，用于MPC代价权重的在线自适应。在PPO中通过四种模块化算法注入求解器梯度指导，在两个全尺寸自动驾驶赛车平台上相比PPO最多减少70.6%样本量，相比GB-PL基线闭环回报提升至少54%，并可零样本泛化到未见环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MPC中代价函数权重塑造闭环行为，但固定参数化在环境变化时往往次优，需要上下文相关的在线自适应。学习这样的策略很困难，因为行为隐式依赖数值MPC解，对策略参数产生非线性、可能非光滑的长期依赖。这造成偏差-方差权衡：RL优化实测闭环回报但样本效率低；GB-PL利用可微MPC的低方差求解器梯度优化预测轨迹上的替代损失，但在模型失配下有偏差。因此需要一种兼具两者优点的策略学习方法。

Method: SG-RL以采样得到的闭环回报为目标，利用有界的求解器梯度作为辅助指导来提升稳定性和样本效率。在PPO框架中实现了四种模块化算法，分别将求解器梯度指导注入到：(1) actor更新缩放、(2) 策略损失、(3) 优势估计、(4) 价值函数学习中。

Result: 在两个具有刻意模型失配的全尺寸自动驾驶赛车平台上，SG-RL在达到PPO最优闭环回报时最多节省70.6%的样本；在闭环回报上比GB-PL基线至少提升54%；并能零样本泛化到未见过的环境中。

Conclusion: SG-RL有效弥合了RL与GB-PL之间的差距：既保留了RL以实测闭环回报为目标的低偏差优点，又通过求解器梯度指导获得样本效率提升，为MPC代价权重在线自适应提供了稳定且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: In Model Predictive Control (MPC), cost-function weights shape closed-loop behavior, yet changing conditions often make fixed parametrizations suboptimal and motivate context-dependent online adaptation. Learning such policies is difficult because behavior depends implicitly on numerical MPC solutions, producing nonlinear, potentially nonsmooth, long-horizon dependencies on policy parameters. This creates a bias-variance tradeoff: Reinforcement Learning (RL) optimizes realized closed-loop return from environment samples but is sample-inefficient, whereas Gradient-Based Policy Learning (GB-PL) uses low-variance solver gradients from differentiable MPC to optimize surrogate losses on predicted trajectories but can be biased under model mismatch. We propose Solver-Gradient Guided Reinforcement Learning (SG-RL), a solver-sensitivity augmentation for RL-based online MPC cost-weight adaptation. SG-RL keeps sampled closed-loop return as the objective and uses bounded solver-derived gradients as auxiliary guidance to improve stability and sample efficiency. We instantiate SG-RL in Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with four modular algorithms that inject solver-gradient guidance into actor-update scaling, policy loss, advantage estimation, and value-function learning. On two full-scale autonomous racing platforms with intentional model mismatch, SG-RL reaches PPO's best closed-loop return with up to 70.6% fewer samples, outperforms GB-PL baselines by at least 54% in closed-loop return, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen environments.

</details>


### [448] [Adaptive Depth-Map-Guided Bundle Adjustment for Correspondence-Free Multi-View Point Cloud Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01089)
*Yiran Zhou,Yingyu Wang,Shoudong Huang,Liang Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应的分层深度图引导的捆绑调整框架（ADM-BA），用于无特征对应的多视角点云配准。该方法通过全局2.5-D网格自适应维护多个深度假设，将原始深度观测直接投影到全局地图形成深度约束，并在冲突单元使用基于softmax的层分配隐式建立对应关系，联合优化传感器位姿与分层深度图。在自采工业数据集上验证了重建精度、鲁棒性和低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则的钢废料机器人加工需要密集3-D测量以替代危险切割工作单元中的人工目视评估，重建误差会直接传播到下游测量与规划。现有基于特征提取和数据关联的多视角配准方法在光滑金属表面、重复结构、遮挡和部分重叠场景下容易产生错误对应，导致位姿估计不准确和重建畸变。

Method: 提出自适应分层深度图引导的捆绑调整框架。场景表示为全局2.5-D网格，每个单元可自适应维护多个深度假设；原始深度观测直接投影到全局地图形成深度约束，无需显式特征对应；在多个表面产生冲突深度值的网格单元处，采用基于softmax的层分配将每个观测与兼容的深度假设关联；构建非线性最小二乘问题联合优化传感器位姿和分层深度图，对应关系由深度图表示和投影模型隐式诱导。

Result: 在自采集工业数据集上实验表明，该方法在具有挑战性的工业场景中实现了一致的竞争性重建精度，同时保持了鲁棒性和低计算成本，并已开源代码。

Conclusion: 通过无对应关系的深度图引导捆绑调整，该方法有效地解决了工业切割场景中光滑金属表面等困难条件下的多视角配准问题，为下游测量与规划提供了可靠的三维重建地图，且具有实际部署的可行性。

Abstract: Robotic processing of irregular steel scrap requires dense 3-D measurement to replace manual visual assessment in hazardous cutting workcells. The reconstructed map is used to estimate piece dimensions, boundary geometry, feasible preheating and cutting regions, and collision-aware torch paths. The reconstruction errors therefore propagate directly to downstream measurement and planning. Existing multi-view registration methods commonly rely on feature extraction and data association to establish correspondences between views. In workcells with smooth metallic surfaces, repeated structures, occlusions, and partial overlaps, however, wrong correspondences may be established, leading to inaccurate pose estimation and distorted reconstruction. This paper presents an adaptive layered depth-map-guided bundle adjustment framework for correspondence-free multi-view point cloud registration. The scene is represented by a global 2.5-D grid, where each cell can adaptively maintain multiple depth hypotheses. Raw depth observations are directly projected into the global map to form depth constraints without explicit feature correspondences. At grid cells where multiple surfaces produce conflicting depths, a softmax-based layer assignment links each observation to compatible depth hypotheses. The resulting nonlinear least-squares formulation jointly refines sensor poses and the layered depth map, with correspondences implicitly induced by the depth-map representation and projection model. Experiments on self-collected industrial datasets show that the proposed method achieves consistently competitive reconstruction accuracy while maintaining robustness and low computational cost in challenging industrial scenarios. We release the open-source code implementation at: https://github.com/YiranZhou-Robotics/ADM-BA.git

</details>


### [449] [DNC-IMM: Early Lane-Change Intention Recognition via Neural Calibration Based on Driving Context Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01120)
*Woong-Chan Byun,Seung-Hyun Kong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种双神经校准交互多模型（DNC-IMM）方法用于早期车道变更意图识别。该方法利用神经网络对传统IMM的转移概率矩阵和测量似然进行双重校准，在保留IMM概率结构和可解释性的同时提升对驾驶情境的适应性。在highD数据集上的实验表明，该方法能可靠地在车道跨越前识别变更意图，在2-3秒的较早预测时间窗口表现尤为突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 早期识别车道变更意图对于自动驾驶和高级驾驶辅助系统的前瞻性决策至关重要，传统方法在适应复杂驾驶情境方面存在不足，需要在保持可解释性的同时提升识别性能。

Method: 提出DNC-IMM框架：使用神经网络编码驾驶上下文信息（目标车辆运动、与周围车辆的间隙、相对速度），并用该网络分别校准IMM的转移概率矩阵和测量似然；最终意图由校准后的IMM模式后验概率判定，而非依赖独立的直接分类器。

Result: 在highD数据集上的实验表明，该方法能在车道跨越之前可靠识别车道变更意图，且在2-3秒的较早预测时域上表现尤为突出。

Conclusion: DNC-IMM结合了神经网络的情境适应能力和传统IMM的贝叶斯概率结构，实现了早期、精准且可解释的车道变更意图识别，为自动驾驶前瞻性决策提供了有效支持。

Abstract: Early recognition of lane-change intention is essential for proactive decision-making in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. This paper proposes a Dual Neural-Calibrated Interacting Multiple Model (DNC-IMM) that improves adaptability to driving context while preserving the probabilistic structure and interpretability of a conventional IMM. The proposed method encodes driving-context information, including target-vehicle motion, gaps to surrounding vehicles, and relative velocities, with a neural network that calibrates both the transition-probability matrix and measurement likelihoods. The final intention is determined from the calibrated IMM mode posterior rather than from a separate direct classifier. Experiments on the highD dataset demonstrate that the proposed method reliably recognizes lane-change intentions before lane crossing and provides particularly strong performance at the earlier 2-3 s prediction horizons.

</details>


### [450] [On Global Regulatability of Robot Manipulators by Classical PID](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01207)
*Cheng Zhao,Jingru Zhu,Lei Guo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了一类具有向量相对度（各通道相对度分量可能不同）的不确定MIMO非线性系统的扩展PID（EPID）控制。开发了逐通道EPID控制器，每个控制输入的PID项导数阶次根据该通道相对度选取。在适当增长条件下构造了满足预设初始状态边界、不确定性和参考信号的可行EPID参数集，并证明该参数集中任意选择都能保证闭环系统半全局稳定并实现设定点调节，从而验证了强耦合不确定MIMO系统（含飞行控制系统）中逐通道独立调参的工程实践合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PID型控制文献对MIMO系统的向量相对度各分量可能不同的情况关注有限，而实际工程（尤其飞行控制）中广泛采用逐通道独立调参的做法缺乏严格理论支撑。本文旨在填补这一空白，为不确定MIMO系统中的通道式PID参数设计提供理论基础。

Method: 针对具有良定义向量相对度（分量可跨通道变化）的不确定MIMO非线性系统，设计逐通道EPID控制器：每个通道的控制输入由对应跟踪误差的比例、积分和导数项构造，导数阶次依据该通道相对度选取。在未知非线性满足增长条件的前提下，构造由预设初始状态边界、不确定性及参考信号所确定的可行EPID参数集。

Result: 证明了从构造的可行参数集中任意选择EPID参数，均可保证闭环系统半全局稳定性并实现期望的设定点调节。该结果表明EPID参数可逐通道独立设计。

Conclusion: 逐通道EPID参数独立设计在强耦合且不确定的MIMO系统（包括飞行控制系统）中具有严格的理论正当性，验证了工程上通道逐通道调参的常见实践。

Abstract: This paper studies a class of uncertain multi-input multi-output (MIMO) nonlinear systems using extended PID (EPID) control. We focus on systems possessing a well-defined vector relative degree whose components may vary across channels, a setting that received limited attention in the existing literature on PID-type control. We develop a channel-wise EPID controller, where each control input is constructed from the proportional, integral, and derivative terms of the corresponding tracking error, and the highest derivative order is selected according to the relative degree of that channel. Under suitable growth conditions on the unknown nonlinearities, we construct an admissible set of EPID parameters specified by prescribed initial-state bounds, the uncertainties and the reference signal. We show that any parameter choice from this set guarantees semiglobal stability of the closed-loop system and achieves the desired setpoint regulation. These results indicate that the EPID parameters can be designed independently for each channel, justifying the common engineering practice of channel-by-channel tuning in strongly coupled and uncertain MIMO systems, including flight control systems.

</details>


### [451] [EmbodiedSkills: A Unified Framework for Orchestrating, Training, and Deploying VLA Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01281)
*Wei Wang,Wenqiao Zhang,Yutong Lin,Yuqian Yuan,Tianwei Lin,Jinhao Mao,Zhenxuan Fan,Mingjian Gao,Yang Dai,Wentong Li,Zheqi Lv,Zheng Dong,Yingjie Niu,Jiaqi Zhu,Jun Xiao,Chao Li,Yueting Zhuang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出EmbodiedSkills，一个将每个技能决策视为"执行提案"的统一框架，运行时在执行前检查前提条件并在执行后验证结果，通过共享的可执行技能接口连接高层技能选择、低层VLA执行和动作后验证。该框架在RoboTwin 2.0的50个任务上平均成功率达86.20%，在LIBERO的四个套件上平均成功率达97.40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能直接将视觉观察和语言指令映射为机器人动作，但长时程任务需要的不只是动作预测——代理必须协调感知、规划、执行、进度验证和恢复等过程。仅靠动作预测或模型生成的技能决策本身，无法保证所提出的操作在当前状态下有效，也无法保证其结果会被验证。这推动了EmbodiedSkills框架的提出。

Method: EmbodiedSkills将每个技能决策视为一个执行提案（execution proposal）：运行时在执行前检查其前提条件（prerequisites），并在执行后验证结果（verify outcome）。通过一个共享的可执行技能接口将高层技能选择、受限的低层VLA执行和动作后验证统一到单一代理循环中。该接口保持固定，低层VLA策略可以被替换或调整而无需改变代理循环。接口还将规划、执行、验证和恢复事件记录为结构化轨迹，为各组件提供监督信号，并支持在交互式反馈可用时进行可选的在线适应。框架基于Qwen3-VL和OpenPI/pi0.5实例化，在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO上进行了实验验证。

Result: 任务自适应的低层VLA策略在RoboTwin 2.0的50个任务上平均成功率达86.20%，在LIBERO的四个套件上平均成功率达97.40%。在四个依赖记忆的RMBench任务上，相同的任务自适应执行方法平均成功率仅为12.5%。框架提供了一个可训练、可检查的代理层，将策略转化为闭环具身系统。

Conclusion: EmbodiedSkills证明了通过"前提检查-执行-结果验证"的执行循环和固定可执行的技能接口，可以将VLA策略转化为可靠、可替换、可训练的闭环具身代理系统。然而，在依赖记忆的长时程任务（RMBench）上表现不佳（12.5%），表明当前方法在记忆依赖场景下仍存在显著局限。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but long-horizon tasks require more than action prediction. An agent must coordinate perception, planning, execution, progress verification, and recovery as the physical state evolves. An action prediction or a model-generated skill decision does not, by itself, guarantee that the proposed operation is valid in the current state or that its outcome will be verified. We propose EmbodiedSkills, a unified framework that treats each skill decision as an execution proposal: the runtime checks its prerequisites before execution and verifies the outcome afterward. A shared executable-skill interface connects high-level skill selection, bounded low-level VLA execution, and post-action verification within a single agent loop. Because this interface remains fixed, low-level VLA policies can be replaced or adapted without changing the agent loop. The interface also records planning, execution, verification, and recovery events as structured trajectories, which provide supervision for individual components and can support optional online adaptation when interactive feedback is available. We instantiate EmbodiedSkills with Qwen3-VL and OpenPI/pi0.5 on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO. Task-adapted low-level VLA policies achieve an average success rate of 86.20% across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and 97.40% across the four LIBERO suites. These results establish the execution performance of the task-adapted low-level VLA policies used in EmbodiedSkills. On four memory-dependent RMBench tasks, the same task-adapted execution approach achieves 12.5% average success. The framework provides a trainable and inspectable agent layer for turning these policies into closed-loop embodied systems.

</details>


### [452] [Integrating Traffic Noise Emission Modelling into Variable Speed Limit Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01339)
*Jiawen Meng,John Pravin Arockiasamy,Alexey Vinel*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种噪声感知的可变限速（VSL）框架，将聚合交通状态估计与简化的CNOSSOS-EU排放指标整合，通过基于阶段性控制器动态调整限速级别以应对实时交通噪声排放变化。24小时仿真评估显示，该方法相比无限制交通条件降低2.9 dB(A)的接收端等效声级，同时相较于永久低速限速方案保持更高的平均车速，验证了将环境绩效指标纳入运营速度控制的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 道路交通噪声是重大环境挑战，但现有速度管理策略大多是静态的，无法响应交通噪声排放的短期变化。虽然可变限速（VSL）系统已被广泛用于安全和拥堵缓解，但交通噪声很少被作为明确的运营控制目标。因此需要一种能将噪声指标纳入实时速度控制的框架。

Method: 该框架整合了聚合交通状态估计与基于简化CNOSSOS-EU的排放指标，采用具有时变参考阈值的阶段性控制器，根据估计的排放状况动态调整离散限速级别。评估采用经经验高速数据标定的微观交通仿真，并在多个随机实现下进行复现实验。

Result: 在24小时评估期间，自适应策略相对无限制交通条件将接收端等效声级降低2.9 dB(A)，同时比永久低限速方案保持约11.3 km/h更高的平均车速。周期分析显示限速降低仅在排放接近标定目标时选择性激活。交通稳定性指标显示速度变异性较无限制运行适度增加，但制动力强度显著低于统一低速限速执行。

Conclusion: 研究结果证明了将环境绩效指标纳入运行速度控制的可行性，为传统基于基础设施的噪声缓解措施提供了实用的补充方案。

Abstract: Road traffic noise remains a major environmental challenge, yet most speed management strategies are static and do not respond to short-term variations in traffic noise emissions. Although variable speed limit (VSL) systems are widely deployed for safety and congestion mitigation, traffic noise is rarely treated as an explicit operational control objective.
  This paper proposes a noise-aware VSL framework that integrates aggregated traffic-state estimation with a simplified CNOSSOS-EU-based emission indicator. A stage-based controller with time-varying reference thresholds dynamically adjusts discrete speed-limit levels in response to estimated emission conditions. The framework is evaluated using microscopic traffic simulation calibrated with empirical motorway data and replicated across multiple stochastic realisations.
  Over a 24-hour evaluation period, the adaptive strategy reduces the receiver-based equivalent sound level by 2.9 dB(A) relative to unrestricted traffic conditions, while maintaining an average vehicle speed approximately 11.3 km/h higher than a permanently imposed low-speed regime. Period-wise analysis shows that speed reductions are activated selectively when emission levels approach calibrated targets, rather than enforcing a constant intermediate limit. Traffic stability indicators reveal moderate increases in speed variability compared with unrestricted operation, but substantially lower braking intensity than under uniform low-speed enforcement.
  These results demonstrate the feasibility of integrating environmental performance indicators into operational speed control, providing a practical complement to conventional infrastructure-based noise mitigation measures.

</details>


### [453] [Scalable Rao-Blackwellized Online Planning for High-Dimensional POMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01351)
*Jiho Lee,Nisar Ahmed,Kyle Hollins Wray,Zachary Sunberg*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文扩展了Rao-Blackwellized在线POMDP框架，通过混合连续-离散信念表示来提升高维状态空间下的规划性能，并在机器人搜索救援任务中与FastSLAM 2.0集成验证，实验表明与纯采样方法相比，在同等计算预算下用更少的粒子和规划模拟即可获得更高的累积奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人系统在部分可观测、高维状态空间中在线规划面临挑战。现有采样型POMDP求解器虽能处理大规模或连续域，但随着信念维度增加，蒙特卡洛估计的高方差导致性能显著下降，需要更高效的方法来降低采样方差。

Method: 将Rao-Blackwellized在线POMDP框架扩展到高维设置，采用混合连续-离散信念表示；在基于树的规划过程中，对边缘化的状态分量进行解析不确定性传播，从而减少价值估计中的采样诱导方差。框架与FastSLAM 2.0集成，应用于机器人搜索救援任务。

Result: 在同等计算预算下，所提出的规划器相比纯采样方法使用显著更少的粒子和规划模拟即可获得更高的累积奖励，展示了混合信念表示在高维在线决策中的有效性。

Conclusion: 具有可处理充分统计量的结构化高维机器人问题可以有效利用RB-POMDP框架实现计算可行的在线决策，为复杂部分可观测环境下的实时规划提供了新路径。

Abstract: Online planning under uncertainty remains a fundamental challenge for robotic systems operating in partially observable environments with high-dimensional state spaces. While sampling-based POMDP solvers enable approximate decision-making in large or continuous domains, their performance degrades as belief dimensionality increases due to the high variance inherent in Monte Carlo-based estimation. In this work, we extend the Rao-Blackwellized online POMDP (RB-POMDP) framework to improve its generalizability in high-dimensional settings through hybrid continuous-discrete belief representations. By analytically propagating uncertainty associated with marginalized state components during tree-based planning, the proposed approach reduces sampling-induced variance in value estimation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this framework in a robotic search-and-rescue task by integrating it with FastSLAM 2.0. Experimental results show that the proposed planner achieves higher cumulative rewards using significantly fewer particles and planning simulations than purely sampling-based methods under equivalent computational budgets. These results suggest that structured high-dimensional robotic problems admitting tractable sufficient statistics can be effectively leveraged within the RB-POMDP framework for computationally feasible online decision-making.

</details>


### [454] [Obstacle-Aware Autonomous Coverage and Navigation for Outdoor Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01384)
*Leonardo Gargani,Matteo Frosi,Matteo Matteucci*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的ROS 2户外覆盖架构，结合覆盖规划、RTK-GNSS+EKF鲁棒定位和Nav2执行，并通过行为树任务管理器协调多目标执行与自动充电对接，在仿真和真实实验中实现93.1%-96.1%的覆盖面积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 户外长时间自主覆盖任务面临多重挑战：开放空间中定位漂移、杂乱环境中障碍物、急转弯操作的控制器可行性以及持续自主与能量管理问题，现有方案缺乏统一的端到端解决方案。

Method: 提出统一ROS 2架构：(1) 双天线RTK-GNSS+EKF融合保证位置和航向精度；(2) 在成熟覆盖规划器上增加三种控制器感知优化；(3) 行为树任务管理器协调多目标执行、分层恢复、成本感知目标管理和自主充电对接。

Result: 通过仿真和真实场景（多种几何形状和障碍物密度的户外区域）验证，该架构在不同区域能可靠完成覆盖任务，覆盖计划区域面积的93.1%至96.1%。

Conclusion: 所提出的栈能够可靠地完成不同区域的户外覆盖长时任务，有效解决了定位漂移、障碍物、控制器可行性和能源管理等综合挑战。

Abstract: Long-duration outdoor coverage with autonomous platforms remains challenging beyond classical planning: deployments face localization drift in open spaces, obstacles in cluttered sites, controller feasibility in turn-heavy maneuvers, and persistent autonomy with energy management. We propose a unified ROS 2 architecture for outdoor coverage that combines coverage planning, robust localization, and Nav2-based execution. A dual-antenna RTK-GNSS fused in an EKF keeps the robot pose, both position and heading, accurate across long missions; three controller-aware refinements are added to a mature coverage planner; a Behavior-Tree mission manager coordinates multi-goal execution, layered recovery, cost-aware goal management, and autonomous docking for return-to-charge. We validate the stack through simulation and real-world trials across multiple outdoor areas with varying geometries and obstacle densities. Overall, these results show that the proposed stack can reliably complete outdoor coverage missions across varied areas, sweeping 93.1% to 96.1% of the planned coverage area.

</details>


### [455] [Autonomous robotic bridging using distributed swarm control without inter-agent communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01394)
*Vishwaak C. Thamaraiselvan,Cody L. Lundberg,Michail Theofandis,Suhas Chelian,Nicholas R. Gans*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了SCARAB（具备蜂群能力的自主机器人士兵架桥系统），通过分布式蜂群控制和多模态传感实现自主定位、编队和抵达目标位置，用于替代当前的Improved Ribbon Bridge，实现不可预测、分散式渡河作战。系统无需GPS或RF通信即可运行（但在非对抗环境下可用），并通过基于物理引擎的仿真在存在水流和风的环境中验证了多艘无人水面艇（USV）的系统性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前军用架桥系统（Improved Ribbon Bridge）存在物流负担大、作战可预测性高等缺点，不利于军队进行不可预测、分散式的渡河作战。作者希望开发一种自主蜂群架桥技术，以提高船员生存能力并减小后勤足迹。

Method: SCARAB采用分布式蜂群控制算法和多模态传感技术，使各智能体（USV）能够在无GPS和RF通信的条件下自主定位，加入编队并共同前往目标位置。通过基于物理引擎的仿真，在含水流和风的动态环境中模拟系统运行。

Result: 通过物理引擎仿真，证明了多艘USV能够在存在水流和风的干扰环境下实现自主定位、编队与协同抵达目标位置，验证了系统的可行性。

Conclusion: SCARAB系统展示了自主蜂群架桥技术的潜力，能够在无GPS/无通信的对抗环境中执行分布式渡河任务，有望替代传统架桥方案并减少后勤负担；未来可进一步应用于军民两用场景，如洪灾救援等。

Abstract: We describe SCARAB--Swarm-Capable Autonomous Robotic Aquatic Bridging. Using distributed swarm control and multi-model sensing of agents and docking targets, agents can localize themselves, join into formations and proceed to desired target locations. Our technologies would eventually allow the Army to perform unpredictable, dispersed river crossings, enhance crew survivability, and minimize the logistics footprint compared to the current Improved Ribbon Bridge. Our methods operate without GPS or RF communications, though these can be used in non-contested environments (e.g., civilian disaster relief for flooding, etc.). We demonstrate our system via physics-engine-based simulation of several agents using unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) in the presence of currents and wind.

</details>


### [456] [Evaluating Multimodal LLMs as Generalist Vision-Language-Action Agents for Drone Control: Commanding, Approaching, Tracking and Searching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01404)
*Jaewoo Park,Minyoung Lee,Sukmin Seo,Moonbin Yim,Hyunwook Yoon,Dohoon Ryu,Daehee Kim,Myungseo Song,Jihyuk Byun,Seunggyu Chang,Taeho Kil,Jiseob Kim,Bado Lee,Geewook Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出DroneCATS基准与DroneCATS-Agent架构，将多模态大语言模型直接嵌入无人机控制环并仅通过提示词声明完整动作空间，系统评估模型在接近目标、跟踪移动目标、视角外搜索和多机编队等任务中的表现，发现小型开放模型在导航上并不逊色于前沿模型，但常因过早或缺失声明到达而失败，核心差距在于动作协议的纪律性而非空间感知或飞行能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将MLLM接入无人机控制的研究日益收窄模型的决策空间（如仅做单一坐标预测），作者希望拓宽模型自主决策范围，探究MLLM在真实具身控制（无人机）中的极限能力，并识别边缘部署场景下性能最先崩坏的环节。

Method: 提出DroneCATS基准（将模型作为自变量）与DroneCATS-Agent架构（MLLM为可替换组件）；模型通过纯提示词声明动作空间，无需微调或函数调用模式，被赋予偏航搜索、不确定时推理和自主声明到达等能力；评估覆盖四类核心能力，模型规模从2B到前沿闭源/开源模型。

Result: 即使在最简单的具身设定中，所有模型均远未解决该任务；小型开放模型在导航进入成功半径方面往往比前沿模型更可靠，但会过早或不声明到达导致整局失败；多机编队进一步放大此差距——小模型会盲目将单一坐标复制到不同视角。空间感知保持稳定，但动作协议（protocol）崩坏。

Conclusion: 可部署边缘模型与前沿模型的本质分界不在导航精度，而在于维持已声明协议并发出正确终止动作的纪律性；开放问题是在机载计算成本约束下弥合此差距，DroneCATS即用于度量这一距离。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are strong perceivers of images and video. We ask how far that reach extends into acting: dropping an MLLM directly into a drone's control loop, with its entire action space declared solely in the prompt. Recent systems approach this setting but increasingly narrow the model's decision-making. We widen it back. We introduce DroneCATS-Agent, an architecture where the MLLM is a swappable component, and DroneCATS, a benchmark treating the model as the independent variable. Beyond merely flying toward a pixel, our agent entrusts the model to yaw and search, deliberate when unsure, and self-declare arrival---all without fine-tuning or function-calling schemas. Evaluating frontier and open models across four core capabilities---approaching a visible target, tracking a moving one, searching outside the initial view, and commanding a multi-drone fleet---reveals that even the simplest embodied settings are far from solved. Crucially, to identify what breaks first at the edge, our roster scales down to 2B parameters. The findings expose a stark paradox: it is not the flying that fails. Small open models often navigate into the success radius more reliably than frontier models, yet lose the episode by declaring arrival prematurely or not at all. Multi-drone commanding amplifies this divide, with small models failing by blindly copying a single coordinate across distinct views. Viewed as vision-language-action agents, the models' spatial perception holds up, but their action protocol does not. What separates a deployable edge model from a frontier model is not navigation, but the discipline to sustain a declared protocol and emit the correct terminating action. The open problem is closing this gap at onboard compute costs---yielding a fast model that plans persistently and knows exactly when it is done---and DroneCATS is built to measure that distance.

</details>


### [457] [Vision-Based Leader-Follower Formation Control for Cooperative UAVs in GPS-Degraded Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01420)
*Deekshitha Angadi,Naveena Budda,Vikas Agarwal,Rojesh Arunkumar Mulasa,Ravi Killamsetty,Mohamed Samshad,Narsimlu Kemsaram*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于前视RGB-D相机的视觉协同编队框架，运行在跟随无人机上，通过轻量级YOLO检测器结合深度信息估计领航无人机相对位姿，实现GPS失效时的编队保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多无人机协同编队依赖于可靠的相对感知能力，当绝对定位传感器（如GPS）退化或失效时，跟随无人机需要替代方案来维持编队和安全执行任务。

Method: 使用前置RGB-D相机，通过轻量级YOLO检测器在专用无人机数据集上训练并在机载部署，预测领航无人机边界框，之后通过针孔相机模型将边界框与深度信息融合以估计相对位姿，位姿估计结果提供给领航-跟随位置控制器，并在GPS或外部定位不可用时可作为备用方案。整体实现为ROS节点。

Result: 在基于XTDrone的物理多无人机仿真中（含传感器噪声和通信丢失）评估了检测精度、运行时和编队保持误差，结果表明框架能以合理计算开销维持稳定的领航-跟随编队。

Conclusion: 该框架为将视觉协同编队控制扩展到真实多无人机系统提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Cooperation in multi-UAV systems requires reliable relative perception so that follower vehicles can maintain formation and continue their mission safely even when absolute positioning sensors degrade or fail. This paper presents a vision-based cooperative formation framework running on a follower UAV that uses a front-facing RGB-D camera to detect, track, and localize a leader UAV in real-time. A lightweight YOLO-based detector is trained on a dedicated drone dataset and deployed onboard to predict leader bounding boxes, which are then fused with depth information via a pinhole camera model to estimate the leader's relative pose. These estimates provide a leader-follower position controller and can also be used as a backup when GPS or external localization is unavailable. This framework is implemented as a set of ROS nodes and evaluated in a physics-based multi-UAV simulation built on XTDrone, with sensor noise and communication dropouts. We evaluate detection accuracy, runtime, and formation-keeping error under nominal conditions and under simulated failures of the positioning sensors. The results show that the proposed framework maintains stable leader-follower formations with reasonable computational cost and provides a practical basis for extending vision-based cooperative formation control to real-world multi-UAV systems.

</details>


### [458] [Does Imitation Learning Preserve Temporal Robustness in Dexterous Manipulation? An Expert-Learner Comparison Across Task Execution Speeds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01453)
*Clinton Enwerem,John S. Baras,Calin Belta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出ParcelStow评估框架，用于度量模仿学习策略相对专家在任务执行速度维度上的时间鲁棒性。实验表明，尽管专家和ACT策略在标称速度下均达到100%任务成功率，但随速度提升，专家成功率最高降至84%，而ACT降至53%，说明同等的标称成功率并不保证执行速度鲁棒性的保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的灵巧操作模仿学习策略评估通常关注场景、物体或指令的变体，很少考察任务执行速度变化对策略性能的影响，因此"学习者相对于被模仿的专家保留了多少时间鲁棒性"这一问题仍是开放的。

Method: 作者构建了ParcelStow接触密集任务（抓取、重定向、插入包裹），在相同任务条件、初始状态采样和速度放大因子下对比脚本专家与ACT策略。演示覆盖抓取后各操作阶段的速度范围，并从阶段级（如插入错位与力闭合）和不同参数初始化等多个维度进行分析。

Result: 标称速度下专家与ACT均达100%成功率；在演示的最大速度下专家成功率为84%而ACT仅53%。两个不同初始化的ACT策略衰减幅度为34和48个百分点，而专家仅16个百分点。阶段分析显示ACT在最大速度下47次失败中有35次为插入错位；在相对运动交接下ACT抓取均通过重定向与自由空间传递，但仅64%完成整体任务（专家为95%）；所有414次无力闭合的抓取均任务失败。

Conclusion: 标称任务成功率的相等并不意味学习者在跨执行速度上保留了专家性能。速度维度应作为模仿学习策略鲁棒性评估的重要指标，且力闭合对接触密集任务的完成至关重要。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation policies learned by imitation are typically evaluated for robustness to variation in scenes, objects, or instructions, but their performance across task execution speeds is less often examined. This leaves open how much temporal robustness a learner retains relative to the expert it imitates. We compare an expert and learner under the same task conditions, initial-condition draws, and speedup factors. We instantiate the evaluation in ParcelStow, a contact-rich task in which the robot acquires, reorients, and inserts a parcel. The demonstrations span the speedup range for the manipulation phases after parcel acquisition. A scripted expert and an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy trained from the expert's demonstrations both achieve 100 percent task success at nominal speed. Their success rates diverge within the demonstrated range: at its maximum, expert success is 84 percent and ACT success is 53 percent. Two ACT policies with different parameter initializations show similar degradation, decreasing by 34 and 48 percentage points from nominal speed to the maximum demonstrated speed, compared with 16 points for the expert. Stage-level analysis shows that 35 of ACT's 47 failures at the maximum demonstrated speed are insertion misalignments. Under the relative-motion handoff, every ACT acquisition retains the parcel through reorientation and transfer in free space, but only 64 percent complete the overall task, compared with 95 percent after expert acquisition. Across all evaluated policies and speeds, none of the 414 acquisitions without force closure completes the task. Equal nominal task success therefore does not imply preservation of expert performance across execution speeds. Code, data, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/coenwerem/parcelstow.

</details>


### [459] [A System for Fast, Resilient, and Adaptable Loco-Manipulation Behaviors on Humanoid Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01518)
*Duncan Calvert,Luigi Penco,Dexton Anderson,Tomasz Bialek,Arghya Chatterjee,Beomyeong Park,Robert Griffin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套机器人本地、运行时可编辑的行为编排与运行时系统，面向人形机器人在人类空间中执行体力密集、危险和重复性任务的需求。该系统将面向对象的可变形模板（Affordance Templates）、树状组织结构、运行时可编辑的感知模块以及全身控制器相结合，支持行为快速创建、适配、扩展与组合。在Unitree H1-2和Alex平台上演示了六个任务变体，包括34秒完成推门穿越和45秒在人类干扰下按颜色分拣六个球，并与近期学习方法竞争性相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人在人类建造的空间中执行工作时，需要协调运动、全身动作、感知、接触以及操作者监督等多方面能力。现有的行为系统难以支持快速行为创建和运行时适配，因此需要一个能够克服这些挑战的行为架构来实现能力、速度和可靠性的提升。

Method: 该系统的行为架构由三部分构成：(1) 面向对象的可变形模板（Affordance Templates），提供语义约束；(2) 树状结构提供行为组织与逻辑；(3) 运行时可编辑的感知模块（行为场景与原始场景动作）。操作者界面与机器人持续同步以支持运行时编排、监控与修复。底层动作原语通过全身控制器执行，支持并发身体运动和行走。

Result: 系统在Unitree H1-2和Alex两个平台上的六个任务变体上进行了演示：推门穿越耗时34秒，在人为干扰下将六个球按颜色分拣耗时45秒。定时编排实验表明，从零创建新的移动操作行为以及对现有行为进行适应可在数小时内完成。与文献中近期学习方法对比，该系统具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 作者认为行为架构本身可以成为能力、速度和可靠性的主要使能因素，而运行时可编辑性则是实现行为快速创作、适配、扩展和组合的关键。

Abstract: There is tremendous value in humanoid robots taking on physically demanding, hazardous, and repetitive work in spaces built for humans. However, a useful robot for these spaces must coordinate locomotion, whole-body motion, perception, contact, and operator supervision. We present a robot-local, runtime-editable behavior authoring and runtime system that addresses these challenges. We argue that behavior architecture can be a primary enabler of capability, speed, and reliability, and that runtime editability enables fast behavior creation, adaptation, extension, and combination.
  Our behavior architecture combines object-centric Affordance Templates, a tree structure that provides organization and logic, and runtime-editable perception through a behavior scene and primitive scene actions. Our operator interface remains continuously synchronized to the robot for runtime authoring, monitoring, and repair. Action primitives execute through a whole-body controller that supports concurrent body motions and walking.
  Demonstrations of our system cover six task variants on Unitree H1-2 and Alex. We execute a push door traversal in 34 seconds and sort six balls by color in 45 seconds under human disturbance. Timed authoring sessions show scratch creation of new loco-manipulation behaviors and adaptation of existing ones in hours. Comparison against the literature finds our approach to be competitive with recent learned systems.

</details>


### [460] [SG-AMP: Scene-Graph-Guided Active Perception and Semantics-Aware Motion Planning for Pepper Plants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01579)
*Rohit Menon,Shiva Rudra Lolla,Niklas Mueller-Goldingen,Gokul Chenchani,Ribana Roscher,Maren Bennewitz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SG-AMP系统，将稳健深度补全与输入条件不确定性、持久全景映射、植物场景图推理以及语义感知主动视角运动规划相结合。该系统不仅检测不确定的已观察区域，还通过场景图显式推断未观察的辣椒-果柄连接关系，并引导近距感知向这些区域进行。在辣椒数据上，感知网络实现55.27%语义mIoU、38.67% PQ和40.62mm深度RMSE；输入条件不确定性使NYUv2上NLL从-1.6518改善至-1.6925，AUSE从0.0102降至0.0087。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动感知系统通常仅关注不确定区域的探索，却忽略了场景中未观察的目标结构关系（如辣椒与果柄的附着关系），导致感知效率受限。作者希望将场景语义推理引入主动规划，以超越"仅探索未观察区域"的局限。

Method: SG-AMP由四个核心模块组成：(1) 稳健深度补全网络融合输入条件不确定性估计；(2) 持久全景映射维护环境语义表征；(3) 植物场景图推理生成对象间语义关系假设（特别是未观察的辣椒-果柄附着关系）；(4) 语义感知主动视角运动规划，依据期望信息增益选择候选视角，并利用类别依赖的运动代价区分受保护结构（辣椒、果柄、茎）与条件性可穿越的叶片。

Result: 在辣椒数据上：语义mIoU达55.27%，PQ为38.67%，深度RMSE为40.62mm。不确定性建模方面，在NYUv2数据集上输入条件不确定性将负对数似然(NLL)从-1.6518改善至-1.6925，AUSE从0.0102降至0.0087，验证了不确定性估计的有效性。

Conclusion: SG-AMP证明了将场景图级的未观察关系假设纳入主动感知规划的有效性，为农业机器人（特别是辣椒采摘场景）中的高效感知-规划闭环提供了新范式，同时验证了输入条件不确定性在深度补全任务中的量化价值。

Abstract: We present SG-AMP, integrating robust depth completion with input-conditioned uncertainty, persistent panoptic mapping, plant scene-graph reasoning, and semantics-aware active view-motion planning. Beyond inspecting uncertain observed regions, the scene graph explicitly hypothesizes unobserved pepper--peduncle attachments and directs close-range sensing toward them. Candidate views are selected according to expected information gain, while class-dependent motion costs distinguish protected peppers, peduncles, and stems from conditionally traversable foliage. On pepper data, the perception network achieves $55.27\%$ semantic mIoU, $38.67\%$ PQ, and $40.62\,\mathrm{mm}$ depth RMSE, while input-conditioned uncertainty improves NYUv2 NLL from $-1.6518$ to $-1.6925$ and AUSE from $0.0102$ to $0.0087$.

</details>


### [461] [Facet-0: A Robotic Foundation Model for Contact-Rich Precise Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01596)
*Haoyuan Deng,Haichao Liu,Wenkai Guo,Yuan Ling,Zaijia Yang,Yuanjiang Xue,Haosheng Sun,Liangzi Wang,Ziwei Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Facet-0是一个面向亚毫米精度机器人装配的基础模型，通过联合动作-力/力矩（wrench）预测的方法，统一了多模态表示学习与强化学习后训练。系统在ManuFacet-1K（1000小时力同步数据）上训练，在五个亚毫米装配任务上达到82%的平均成功率，而最强基线仅为15%，定位精度0.5mm，指令延迟50ms。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界机器人装配需要在亚毫米公差下同时满足空间精度、柔顺交互以及对接触失败的鲁棒性，而现有方法难以同时建模动作后果与接触交互，缺乏能预测动作接触结果并据此价值判断的系统。

Method: Facet-0提出"联合动作-力主张"（joint action-wrench proposal）：将因果力历史与视觉-语言语义及运动学状态对齐，用流匹配（flow matching）生成动作块及其预期的腕部力/力矩曲线。训练阶段采用分布式Action-Wrench Critic以区分任务进展相似但接触结果不同的动作；阶段感知奖励和接触选择性信用分配引导策略优化关注关键交互。针对部件特定动力学，使用轻量有界actor复用冻结表示进行机上适应，RL仍定义在可执行的笛卡尔动作空间上，辅助力头保持预测性的非指令动作-接触耦合。

Result: 基于三个实施例和多个制造单元的1000小时力同步数据集ManuFacet-1K训练后，有界任务适应系统在五个亚毫米计算机装配任务上达到82%平均成功率（最强基线为15%），实现0.5mm定位精度和50ms指令延迟。

Conclusion: 通过将接触后果预测与价值评估深度融合进机器人基础模型的架构和训练流程中，Facet-0验证了"预测并价值化动作接触后果"这一范式可以显著提升亚毫米装配任务的成功率，为力敏感型机器人操作基础模型提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Real-world robotic assembly at sub-millimeter tolerances demands spatial precision, compliant interaction, and robustness to contact failures. We present Facet-0, a robotic foundation model that predicts and values the contact consequences of its actions. Facet-0 unifies multimodal representation learning and reinforcement learning (RL) post-training around a joint action-wrench proposal: a causal wrench history is aligned with vision-language semantics and kinematic state, and flow matching generates each action chunk together with the future wrist-wrench profile it is expected to induce. Deployment rollouts train a distributional Action-Wrench Critic to distinguish motions with similar task progress but different contact outcomes, while phase-aware rewards and contact-selective credit concentrate policy improvement on decisive interactions. To accommodate part-specific dynamics, a lightweight bounded actor reuses the frozen representation for on-robot adaptation; RL remains defined over executable Cartesian actions, while an auxiliary wrench head preserves predictive, non-commanded action-contact coupling. Trained on ManuFacet-1K, a 1,000-hour force-synchronized corpus spanning three embodiments and multiple manufacturing cells, the bounded task-adapted system reaches 82% mean success on five sub-millimeter computer-assembly tasks, compared with 15% for the strongest baseline, with 0.5 mm placement accuracy and 50 ms command latency.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [462] [One Faithful Pass Over the Cuckoo's Nest](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00383)
*Kristina Šekrst*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文论证了一个结构性矛盾：使思维链（CoT）推理忠实透明的对齐安全目标，与CoT在原则上可能被视为有意识叙述的条件在结构上不相容。对齐干预改变了意识检测框架所需测量的特征，两个领域尚未直接面对这一方法论后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该论文旨在揭示两个看似独立的研究方向之间的深层张力：一方面，对齐社区致力于让CoT推理忠实、透明以保障安全；另一方面，基于叙述理论的意识检测框架将"不透明性"视为意识构成性特征。作者希望指出这两个方向在同一架构变量上产生了相反的拉力，且双方都未正视这一冲突的方法论后果。

Method: 本文采用哲学分析与经验证据综合的方法：先援引叙述意识理论确立"部分不透明内部叙述是意识构成条件"的前提；再引用近期经验研究表明LLM的CoT在很大程度上是事后合理化的、因果上被旁路的不透明过程；最后通过逻辑推演论证两个目标在结构上的不相容性，并导出方法论后果。
